九龙至尊.source:
<nobr>质变-九龙至尊</nobr>：
龙炎弹弹道数固定为9，小幅降低龙炎弹射程，龙炎弹伤害提高1300%
九龙至尊.full_english:
Ascend: Supreme Fire:
Dragon attacks fire exactly 9 projectiles, have slightly reduced range, and deal 1300% more damage.

伙伴一起.source:
<nobr>质变-伙伴一起</nobr>：
伤害统一排名第一位的称为伙伴，小冰机每次攻击时，若伙伴为植物且存在于场上，则在伙伴位置额外释放一次攻击
伙伴一起.full_english:
Ascend: Partnership:
The unit ranked first in total damage is the Partner. Whenever Gatling Icicle-shroom attacks, if the Partner is a plant currently on the field, releases one additional attack at the Partner's position.

冰天雪地.source:
<nobr>质变-冰天雪地</nobr>：
当一个僵尸被冰神西瓜直击命中10次后，释放寒冰冲击波，对附近僵尸造成大量伤害
冰天雪地.full_english:
Ascend: World of Ice:
After Maelonstorm directly hits a zombie 10 times, releases an ice shockwave that deals heavy damage nearby.

噬化万军.source:
<nobr>质变-噬化万军</nobr>：
战神吞噬僵尸后，将在每行生成一只幻化战神僵尸为你作战
噬化万军.full_english:
Ascend: Summoner:
After Cherrizilla devours a zombie, summons one hypnotized Cherrizilla Zombie in each lane to fight for you.

聚能弹道.source:
<nobr>质变-聚能弹道</nobr>：
极大幅度减小子弹发射偏转角度，大幅提高龙炎弹射程，龙炎弹耗能-2
聚能弹道.full_english:
Ascend: Focused Trajectory:
Greatly reduces projectile spread, greatly increases Dragon attack range, and reduces its energy cost by 2.

aliases.english:
Ascend: Summoner:
After Cherrizilla devours a zombie, summons one hypnotized Cherrizilla Zombie in each lane to fight for you.

zombie_fields.source:
平平无奇的僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>50</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270</color>
<color=#3D1400>小贴士：</color><color=red>僵尸默认每0.5秒啃咬一次。血量低于临界值时死亡。临界值一般为韧性的1/3，载具、巨人僵尸和雕像的临界值为0</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Regular Garden-variety zombie.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>50/0.5 (biting)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>普通僵尸讨厌他名字里的“普通”这个字眼。他不认为自己是什么不配拥有姓名的敌人抑或是随处可见的普通尸体。他是一个独立的个体，该死的，他打算做出点不普通的事，即使这会杀了你。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Zombie hates how his name makes him seem like an ordinary, well, zombie. He doesn't think of himself as some unnamed enemy or just another common corpse. He's an individual, damn it! And he's going to do something extraordinary, even if it kills you.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
手中的摇旗标志着一大波僵尸来袭。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>默认在旗帜波出场。移速略快于普通僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Flag Zombie marks the arrival of a huge pile or "wave" of zombies.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Only appears in flag waves by default, slightly faster than regular Zombies.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>毋庸置疑的是，旗帜僵尸喜爱脑子，但在私下里他也迷恋旗帜。或许是因为旗帜上也画着脑子吧，这很难说。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Make no mistake, Flag Zombie loves brains but somewhere down the line he also picked up a fascination with flags. Maybe it's because the flags always have brains on them. Hard to say.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
装备着路障的僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+370（一类）</color>
zombie_fields.english:
His traffic cone headpiece makes him twice as tough as normal zombies.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 370 (Type 1)</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>路障僵尸其实并不知道路障是什么东西，它只是觉得这玩意很像冰激凌筒，发现啃不动之后就顺手搁到了头上。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The Conehead Zombie has no clue what a traffic cone is. To him, it looks like an ice cream cone, and when he finds out it can't eat it, he just sticks it on his head.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
借助撑杆和助跑，越过遇到的首个植物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等，跳跃后变为极慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>越过遇到的首个植物（会被高大植物阻挡），然后失去撑杆</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Pole Vaulting Zombie vaults with a pole.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Jumps over the first plant he runs into. Can be blocked by tall plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>一些僵尸渴望更进一步、追求更多，这促使着他们跨越普通、成就非凡。那边那个撑杆僵尸就是如此。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Once the best high jumper in his town, Pole Vaulting Zombie's career took a turn the day he forgot to set up the cushions behind the high jump stand.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
装备着铁桶的僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+1100（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>铁桶可以被磁力菇吸取</color>
zombie_fields.english:
His bucket hat makes him extremely resistant to damage.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 1100 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Bucket can be removed by Magnet-shrooms.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>几曾何时，本来只是个油漆工的铁桶僵尸因其创新的铁桶策略被誉为僵尸中的天才。几年过去了，僵尸们怀疑他还有什么秘密的杀手锏。江郎才尽还是暗藏绝技？谁知道呢？
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Once upon a time, Buckethead Zombie, who was merely a painter, was hailed as a genius among zombies for his creative use of a bucket. Years have passed, and now the zombies wonder if he still has some secret killer tricks up his sleeve. Is he running out of ideas, or is he hiding something? Who knows?</color>

zombie_fields.source:
最讨厌别人打断他读报。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+200（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>失去报纸后移速x2.5，攻速x1.5</color>
zombie_fields.english:
His newspaper provides limited defense.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 200 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Travels normally at first, but speeds up after losing his newspaper (movement speed ×2.5, attack speed ×1.5).</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>你真不能怪他这么暴躁，他就差这么一点就完成这个纵横字谜了（第23号纵向词是“Brains（大脑）”），这也是为什么他把报纸反过来拿。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"You can't fault him for being frustrated; he was just about to finish the crossword puzzle (vertical word number 23 is 'Brains'), which explains why he was holding the paper upside down."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
舞王身边的优秀舞者，也是个撑杆运动员。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>跑步入场，越过遇到的首个植物，然后在周围召唤4个伴舞撑杆僵尸。被阻挡时不会召唤</color>
zombie_fields.english:
After vaulting over, summons his Backup Pole Vaulters.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Summons 4 Backup Pole Vaulters after jumping. Does not summon if the jumping is blocked.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>舞王撑杆僵尸的体育成绩在僵尸界平平无奇，在伴舞撑杆僵尸们的建议下走了偶像路线，现在与Michael Jackson合作的流行乐《Just Brains》正在爆火。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Dancing Pole Vaulter's athletic skills are average by zombie standards. On the advice of the Backup Pole Vaulters, he decided to pursue the idol path. Now, his pop song "Just Brains," a collaboration with Michael Jackson, is becoming a hit.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
优秀舞者身边的伴舞，也是个撑杆运动员。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有撑杆僵尸的特点</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Climb over a plant.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Jumps over the first plant he runs into. Can be blocked by tall plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>曾经伴舞撑杆四兄弟是孤儿从小没人陪伴，久而久之就有了扭曲的性格，在僵尸学院到处欺凌别人。直到有一天他们看到了在舞台上的舞王撑杆在欢快的舞动着，他们的内心仿佛受到洗礼，从这天起他们四兄弟和舞王撑杆一起在舞台上展示着自己。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The four brothers, once troubled orphans, developed twisted personalities and bullied others at the Zombie Academy. One day, they saw Dancing Pole Vaulter performing joyfully on stage, and it changed them. From that moment, they joined him in performing on stage together.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
手持铁门的僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+1100（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>铁门可以被磁力菇吸取</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Can block bullets coming from the front.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 1100 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Screen Door can be removed by Magnet-shrooms.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>铁门僵尸曾经是一个fbi特遣队员，他的脾气暴躁但有一颗正义的心，从不和劫匪商量，直接拆门进去拯救人质。他变成僵尸后善良的内心依然没变，他看到有一群僵尸绑架了一个小鬼僵尸焦急的想破门进去，但由于僵尸们知道他的性格所以提前在门上涂上了胶水，导致他不能把手从门上拿下来。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Screen Door Zombie, once an FBI task force member with a bad temper but a righteous heart, never negotiated with robbers—he'd just break down doors to save hostages. After becoming a zombie, his kind heart stayed the same. When he saw zombies kidnapping a little ghost zombie, he tried to break in, but they coated the door with glue, trapping his hand.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
职业橄榄球员，装备着橄榄帽。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+1400（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>橄榄帽可以被磁力菇吸取</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Runs super fast.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 1400  (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Football Helmet can be removed by Magnet-shrooms.

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>橄榄球僵尸是僵尸中的体育明星，他在球场上驰骋的英姿受到很多僵尸的崇拜，好多公司都想雇佣橄榄球僵尸。不过他对工资的要求也太高了吧，年薪一万个脑子？
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Football Zombie is a sports star among zombies, admired by many for his heroic presence on the field. Many companies want to hire him, but his salary demands are steep—an annual pay of 10,000 brains.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
向传奇舞王迈克尔·杰克逊致敬！经典太空步入场。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>太空步入场，在周围召唤4个舞王撑杆僵尸。有伙伴死亡时，在4个前进舞步后召唤，补齐4个伙伴。啃咬时不会召唤</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Leads the charge with his ultimate dance moves.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Summons 4 Dancing Pole Vaulters at a time, keeps summoning if a Dancing Pole Vaulter dies. Does not summon while eating.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>黑色的西装，黑色的帽子，他不从事殡葬行业，他只是个舞者，一个很酷的舞者，你可以叫他Michael Jackson。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Black suit, black hat—he's not here for a funeral. He's just a dancer, and you can call him Michael Zombie.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
可在水路行进的普通僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Can swim in water lanes.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>只有特定的僵尸才能成为鸭子救生圈僵尸，不是每只僵尸都能胜任。有些救生圈有点漏气，他们却处理不了，脱身后永远放弃了对脑子的渴求。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>It takes a certain kind of zombie to be a Ducky Tuber. Not every zombie can handle it. Some crack. They can't take it. They walk away and give up on brains forever.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
可在水路行进的路障僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+370（一类）</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Can swim in water lanes.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 370 (Type 1)</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>都说差生文具多，但是鸭子救生圈路障僵尸并不这么认为，毕竟他不想承认他是个差生。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>They say bad students always have fancy stationery, but Ducky Tube Conehead doesn't agree. After all, he refuses to admit he's one of them.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
可在水路行进的铁桶僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+1100（一类）</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Can swim in water lanes.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 1100 (Type 1)</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>鸭子救生圈铁桶僵尸本不想带上那个漏气的游泳圈的，但是没办法，谁叫他戴着那个容易生锈的铁桶呢。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Ducky Tube Buckethead never wanted to wear that leaky float ring… but what can he do? That rusty bucket on his head isn't exactly waterproof.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
海豚外形的潜水艇，驾驶员是个潜水僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
zombie_fields.english:
The zombies' premier vehicle against water plants.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Moves fast and sinks any plant it comes to contact with, dealing 500 Damage to anti-crush plants.

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>根据仿生学原理制造出的强大海豚机甲，威武、霸气、是僵尸们梦寐以求的战争兵器。“现在只要解决海草缠住螺旋桨的问题就可以了。”埃德加博士这样说道。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The formidable Zombarine, designed based on bionic principles, is both majestic and intimidating—a coveted war weapon for zombies. "Now we just need to tackle the issue of seaweed getting tangled in the propeller," said Dr. Edgar.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
有学问的僵尸，最讨厌别人打断他阅读。

<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>400</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+1100（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>持有书籍时本体无敌，不会因冻结值增加进入寒冷状态。失去书籍后短暂无敌（免疫新的控制效果），然后移速x10，攻速x3</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Deals huge damage alongside his sturdy books.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>400</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720 +1100 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Short-term invincibility and increased speed (movement speed ×10, attack speed ×3) after his book is broken.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>学者僵尸是学术界的权威，你可以经常在图书馆见到他的身影，他真的很喜欢读书，因此在读书时被打扰会令他怒不可遏，随后这位老先生就会让你明白什么叫做“知识就是力量”。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>As a leading authority in the academic realm, Scholar Zombie is frequently seen in the library. His passion for reading runs deep, and disturbing him while he reads can spark his fury. This old gentleman will make sure you understand the true meaning of "knowledge is power."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
其实是Zomboni牌造冰车。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫寒冷、冻结、定身。出场时速度较快，逐渐减速到正常速度。会持续留下冰道</color>
zombie_fields.english:
The Zomboni applies ice, steam and pressure to your plants.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to Chill and Deep Chill.

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>雪橇车僵尸的车技很好，毕竟能从滑冰场开到草地的僵尸已经不多见了，他总是这么安慰着自己，然后去交罚款。他开的不是Zamboni牌浇冰机，而是Z公司出品的Zomboni牌浇冰机。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The zombie driving is an excellent driver, especially considering that few zombies can navigate from the ice rink to the grass field. Now, he must go pay the fine. The ice machine he operates isn't a Zamboni; it's a Zomboni produced by Company B.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
潜伏在水中悄悄靠近。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>潜水时不会被平射子弹伤害。靠近植物时浮出水面</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Snorkel Zombie can swim underwater.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Submerges to avoid straight-firing projectile attacks.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>潜水僵尸的面罩破了，但这并不阻碍潜水僵尸在水中潜潜浮浮，不是因为潜水僵尸那套被称为“沉冒蓬”的潜浮技巧，而是因为潜水僵尸不需要呼吸空气。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Snorkel Zombie may have a broken mask, but that doesn't hinder his ability to dive and float in the water. His so-called "sinking" isn't due to his diving skills; he simply doesn't require air to breathe.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
滑雪爱好者改装的雪橇车，平地速度很慢。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>2700</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫寒冷、冻结、定身。在冰道上移动速度更快</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Only appears when there's ice on the field.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>2700</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Moves very fast when on top of ice. Immune to Chill and Deep Chill.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>这辆车是经过滑雪运动爱好者们改造的，可以轻松于雪地和冰面上行驶，甚至能比在草地上开得更快。不过目前有个缺陷，那就是只有在冰道上才能发动起来。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>This car, designed by ski enthusiasts, drives smoothly on snow and ice, even achieving higher speeds than on grass. Unfortunately, it has a flaw: it can only be started on icy surfaces.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
骑乘海豚，越过遇到的首个植物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>快，失去海豚后变为慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>越过遇到的首个植物（会被高大植物阻挡），然后失去海豚</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Dolphin Rider Zombies use dolphins to bypass your defense.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Jumps over the first plant he runs into. Can be blocked by tall plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>海豚骑士是位海豚饲养员并兼职在水族馆进行表演，而他骑着的海豚其实也是个僵尸，只是这只僵尸海豚对脑子没有兴趣罢了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Dolphin Rider Zombie is a part-time performer and dolphin keeper at an aquarium. The dolphin he rides is a zombie, but unlike typical zombies, this "zombie dolphin" has no desire for brains.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>三叉戟僵尸原本只是个普通的标枪运动员，退役后成为渔民，但他试图下河捕鱼后发现自己并不会游泳，就这么沉入了河底，再次上岸后就发现自己变成现在这个样子了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Trident Zombie was originally just a regular javelin thrower who became a fisherman after retiring. However, when he went to the river to fish, he sank because he couldn't swim. When he came ashore, he realized he had become what he is now.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
钻石制成的套娃，里面有什么呢？

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>2000+3000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防具损坏时退场，生成黄金套娃僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Is this.. a Conehead Zombie? 

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>2000 + 4400 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Turns into a Gold-box Zombie upon losing its armor.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>钻石套娃僵尸，今晚将会开启它们那闪耀的银色世界。它们的眼睛是夜空中最明亮的星辰，金色的光辉仿佛流淌在时间的河流中，照亮了前方不确定的道路。每当我轻轻拆开盒盖，就像是打开了通往另一个世界的神秘门扉。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Tonight, Diamond-box Zombies will unveil their dazzling world. Their eyes shine like the brightest stars in the night sky, and the golden light appears to flow like a river through time, illuminating the uncertain path ahead. Each time the lid of the box is gently opened, it feels like unlocking a door to another realm.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
黄金制成的套娃，里面有什么呢？

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>2000+1350（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防具损坏时退场，生成白银套娃僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Is this.. a Conehead Zombie? 

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>2000 + 2200 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Turns into a Silver-box Zombie upon losing its armor.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>金色的盒子下面还有其他颜色的盒子，你猜猜更里面的盒子是什么材质的？
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"Underneath the golden box, other boxes in different colors await. Can you guess what the box inside is made from?"</color>

zombie_fields.source:
白银制成的套娃，里面有什么呢？

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>2000+720（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防具损坏时退场，生成路障僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Is this.. a Conehead Zombie? 

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>2000 + 1100 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Turns into a Conehead Zombie upon losing its armor.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
玩偶匣在转动中发出美妙的音乐，啊？！

<color=#3D1400>爆炸伤害：</color><color=red>100万</color>
<color=#3D1400>范围：</color><color=red>3x3（半径1.5格的圆）</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>有概率自爆，释放玩偶匣爆炸，秒杀范围内的植物</color>
zombie_fields.english:
This zombie carries an explosive surprise.

<color=black>Explosion Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>1 Million</color>
<color=black>Explosion Radius: </color><color=#4B0082>1.375 Tiles (≈ 3×3)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Will sometimes explode and insta-kill surrounding plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>玩偶匣僵尸其实是个精神病人，但马戏团还是接受了他的入职申请，不要好奇他的玩偶匣里装着的是什么，那东西保证会吓你一大跳。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Although Jack-in-the-Box Zombie is a mental patient, the circus welcomed his application. Be wary of what's in his toy box; it's sure to scare you.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
在空中悄悄地潜入防线。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+20（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行（持有气球）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>不会被大部分地面植物攻击。飞行时本体不会受到伤害</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Balloon Zombie floats above the fray, immune to most attacks.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 20 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color><color=#4B0082>Medium Fast</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Cannot be damaged by most plants while flying.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>作为基洛夫的创造者之一，气球僵尸总是被问为何会把气球绑在自己身上。“那是我智慧造就的结论。”其实只是气球不小心缠上去了而已。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Balloon Zombie, one of the Zomppelin creators, frequently gets asked why he's tied balloons to himself. His usual reply is, "That was my conclusion." However, the truth is that the balloons simply got tangled by chance.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
慢速飞行，向下方的植物投下玩偶匣炸弹。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>500</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>受到三叶草效果会被缓慢击退约半格。每3秒向下方投下炸弹，造成玩偶匣爆炸伤害。被磁力仙人掌、究极杨桃大帝子弹击中10次后坠机</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Drops deadly bombs as it flies over your plants.

<color=black>Bomb Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>500</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Drops Jack-in-the-Box Bombs every 3s to the plant directly below. Can be pushed back half a tile by Blovers. Crashes if hit 10 times with Magnet Cactus or Magnetar projectiles.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>飞艇是埃德加博士的最新力作，它出现后很快成为了僵尸们的得力助手，僵尸们都在猜测到底是谁有机会驾驶这架强大的武器。也许是小鬼，也许飞艇本身就是一只僵尸？
“气球而已。”埃德加博士说道，“僵尸也要与时俱进。我正在考虑把我的飞艇也变成无人机。”这样他就不会在被植物打败时露出狼狈模样了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The Zomppelin, Dr. Edgar's latest creation, is quickly becoming the zombies' trusted ally. Speculation abounds about who will pilot this powerful weapon—perhaps the imp or even the airship itself? "It's just a balloon," Dr. Edgar remarked. "Zombies need to keep up with the times. I'm even considering turning it into a drone to avoid embarrassment when defeated by plants."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
骑乘白鲸越过三个植物，然后开始逃跑。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极快，失去白鲸后变为慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>遇到首个植物时，大跳约3格远（不会被高大植物阻挡），然后失去白鲸，开始反向前进</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Jumps forward three tiles and turns back, attacking your plants from behind.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Cannot be blocked by tall plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>白鲸骑士骑乘的白鲸拥有超强的跳跃能力，海豚骑士非常羡慕、一直希望能借过来骑一次，但总是被雪人骑士拒绝。
“白鲸骑士根本控制不了他的白鲸。”埃德加博士说道，“他总是想躲到我的身后，但白鲸会载着他往反方向前进。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The white whale that Yeti Zombie rides has impressive jumping skills. Dolphin Rider Zombie is quite envious and has always wanted to borrow it for a ride, but Yeti Zombie refuses each time. "Yeti Zombie has no control over his white whale," Dr. Edgar said. "He always wants to hide behind me, but the white whale ends up going the other way."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
挖掘地道潜入到你的身后。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>不会被地上植物攻击。通常会挖掘到一行最左侧出土，然后调转方向。在地下时，会被磁力菇吸取矿镐，或被具有矿工南瓜特性的南瓜阻挡，此时会提前出土。在地下会触发出土的土豆雷</color>
zombie_fields.english:
This zombie digs to bypass your defenses.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Tunnels underground and appears on the left side of the lawn. Vulnerable to Magnet-shrooms and fully-armed Potato Mines.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>很久以前，矿工很讨厌磁力菇，因为这让他的生活工具老是被没收，而现在呢，矿工更讨厌矿工南瓜。“我的头老是被撞到，这让我更难受。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>A long time ago, Digger Zombies despised Magnet-shrooms for constantly confiscating their tools. Now, they hate Miner Pumpkins even more. "My head keeps getting hit, which makes me feel even worse," he laments.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
拥有精密的翼片调节系统，不怕三叶草！

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+500（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行（持有气球）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>飞行时，本体不会受到伤害且免疫三叶草效果。落地后，获得2200韧性的一类防具（该防具被磁力菇吸引后死亡）。被击杀时掉落铁桶</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Bucknut-copter Zombie is immune to Blovers!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 500 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color><color=#4B0082>Medium Fast</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to Blovers. Gains a Type 1 Bucknut Helmet with 2200 Toughness upon touching ground.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“朋友们，你们听过柏林飞艇的故事吗，我就是从那台机器得到了灵感……”所有僵尸都想躲着铁桶坚果气球僵尸，倒不是因为他总是把飞艇的故事喋喋不休讲个不停，而是因为，它气球上的螺旋桨实在是太吵了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"Friends, did you know about the Berlin airship? It inspired my design..." All the zombies want to hide from Bucknut-copter Zombie, not only because he talks too much about the airship, but also because the noise from his balloon's propeller is unbearable.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
要结束了吗？嘿嘿——还没完！

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+370（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>有概率自爆，释放玩偶匣爆炸。此后仍存活且移速翻倍。死亡时若持有玩偶匣，则有概率释放玩偶匣爆炸并变为玩偶匣僵尸，存在时间越长概率越高</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Clown-in-the-Box Zombie may also explode after his death!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720 + 370 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Becomes violent after exploding, doubling his speed. Upon defeat, has a chance to explode and transform into a Jack-in-the-Box Zombie. The longer it is on the lawn, the higher the chance.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>自爆是每一位小丑僵尸的终极艺术，而小丑王更是其中的佼佼者。“小丑王从不会摘下他的面具，更不会放下他手中的礼盒！”这句口号极大的鼓舞着僵尸们的士气。这导致小丑王死前一定会引爆他的礼盒，不然他就把两个都弄没了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>For every clown zombie, self-destruction is the highest form of art, and Clown-in-the-Box Zombie excels above all. "Clown-in-the-Box Zombie will never take off his mask or let go of the gift box in his hand!"</color>

zombie_fields.source:
精准地投掷篮球攻击后排植物。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>60/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>850</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>向本行最左侧的植物投掷篮球，投完25个后前进</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Catapults basketballs to attack your plants.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>60/3s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>850</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Throws basketballs at the leftmost plant in its lane. When all 25 basketballs are used, moves forward and crushes plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>没人知道投篮车僵尸是怎么精准调节投掷力度的，只知道要是看到他，你最好赶快捂住你的脑袋。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Nobody knows how Catapult Zombie manages to throw with such precision, but one thing's for sure—if you see him, cover your head quickly!</color>

zombie_fields.source:
能多次跳过你的防线。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>快，失去跳杆后为慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>持有跳杆时免疫冻结、定身、换行。跳过植物，可以被高坚果阻挡。跳杆可以被磁力菇吸取</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A zombie that can leap over your defenses.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Can jump over plants. The Pogo Stick can be removed by Magnet-shrooms.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>跳跳僵尸喜欢弹跳，他认为跳向空中的过程最为接近飞行。不过他生前有没有人提醒过他，别在屋顶上用弹跳杆？
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Sproing! Sproing! Sproing! That's the sound of a powerful and effective zombie doing what he does best.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
扶梯可以让僵尸翻越植物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+720（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>靠近坚实植物后放置扶梯，僵尸可以走上扶梯翻越植物。扶梯所在格的植物不能被手套移动，且融合或死亡时移除扶梯。放置的扶梯会被灰烬伤害移除。所有扶梯都可以被磁力菇吸取</color>
zombie_fields.english:
This zombie uses a ladder to bypass obstacles.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720 + 720 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Can use the ladder to ignore plant defenses. Laddered plants cannot be moved by the Glove. Ladders can be destroyed by Cremators. Ladder can be removed by Magnet-shrooms.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>扶梯僵尸听网上说，只要拿着梯子，扮作工人，任何地方都能进去。于是他买了梯子，穿上工服，准备靠这个穿过植物防线。
“没人跟他说他的僵尸皮肤很显眼吗？”豌豆射手说，“我确定我们不会请一个僵尸来维修屋子。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english:
<align=left><color=black>Ladder Zombie heard online that with a ladder and some work clothes, he could sneak past any defenses. Armed with a ladder and dressed like a worker, he sets out to conquer the plant defenses.
Peashooter's comment: "Didn't anyone tell him that his zombie skin is way too noticeable...?"</color>

zombie_fields.source:
利用弹韧的西瓜跳杆，一次越过较长距离。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+1100（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>在原地蓄力5秒后，大跳约4格远（不会被高大植物阻挡）。此效果只能触发一次，在左半场时不会触发</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>保护伞类融合植物</color>
zombie_fields.english:
This zombie charges up and leaps into your defenses!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 2200 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>If in the right side of the lawn, charges up for 5s, then performs a big jump (about 4 Tiles long). Only does this once.
<color=black>Weakness: </color><color=#4B0082>Umbrella Fusions</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“炮弹不太可能两次炸在同一个弹坑内！《弹坑理论》是这么写的。”瓜跳僵尸边说边摆弄着他的瓜皮帽。但是没有僵尸告诉他，红绿配色在尸群里有点过于显眼了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Quote: "It's highly unlikely for shells to explode in the same crater twice! This is what 'Crater Theory' states." Melon Pogo Zombie says while adjusting his melon peel hat. However, no one told him that his red-and-green color scheme stands out a bit too much in a crowd of zombies.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
体型庞大的巨人僵尸能砸扁你的植物！

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>巨型</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>本体半血后扔出小鬼僵尸。砸击碾压植物，对防碾压植物伤害500，对地刺王系列植物伤害50，对魅惑僵尸伤害1800</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A massive, slow-moving zombie that crushes everything in its way with its enormous size.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Giant zombie. Throws an Imp upon reaching half health. Deals 500 Damage to anti-crush plants, 50 Damage to Spike Rocks and 1800 Damage to hypnotized zombies each slam.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>巨人僵尸就像很多大型动物一样，庞大体型的代价是羸弱的智力。大脑？植物？他通通不能理解，也并不在意，他只懂得前进，也只会一直前进，前进。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The Gargantuar is like a massive, clumsy beast, its size an advantage at the cost of intelligence. It doesn't understand plants or brains; it only knows how to move forward, relentlessly. </color>

zombie_fields.source:
凭借高额血量而暴走进攻的巨人僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>巨型</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有巨人僵尸的所有特点</color>
zombie_fields.english:
The enraged Gargantuar crushes everything in its path with terrifying strength.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Inherits all traits from regular Gargantuars.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>虽然红眼巨人僵尸在战场上大杀四方，赤红的眼睛让所有参与者恐惧。但红眼巨人僵尸还有个小秘密：自身眼红只是每天睡眠不足。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Although the Giga Gargantuar wreaks havoc on the battlefield, its blood-red eyes instilling fear in all who face it, there's a little-known secret: the monster is perpetually irritable due to chronic sleep deprivation.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
潜藏在巨人僵尸背上，会被巨人僵尸投掷到你的防线之内！

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>空中的小鬼僵尸可以被伞类植物大招击飞</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Small and sneaky, Imp loves to squeeze into tight spaces, making him agile and harder to target.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>While in the air, can be flung out of the screen by the Ultimate moves from some Umbrella fusions.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>小鬼僵尸天生喜欢钻进各种狭窄的空间，这样会让他更有安全感。因此，无论在哪里看见小鬼僵尸，都请不要见怪。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Imps enjoy sneaking through tight spaces, often causing mischief. Don't be surprised if you see one bouncing around unexpectedly!</color>

zombie_fields.source:
以沉重而迟缓的步伐碾压植物。即使摧毁了它的脑袋，也别掉以轻心！
<color=blue>《植物娘大战僵尸》联动僵尸</color>

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000（前2/3属于机械头颅）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>巨型，碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫魅惑、寒冷、冻结、红温、蒜毒、定身、余烬。可以碾压地刺类植物，或对地刺王类植物造成一次性的150伤害。失去机械头颅不会死亡</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>磁力菇类植物（机械头颅会被其吸取）</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Another invention by Dr. Gargantuar, full-metal and will stomp on your defenses without hesitation.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Giant zombie. Immune to most status effects.
<color=black>•</color> Crushes plants, deals 500 Damage to anti-crush plants and 150 Damage to Spike Rocks. Deals 1000 Damage to hypnotized zombies every second.
<color=black>Weakness: </color><color=#4B0082>Magnet-shroom</color>

zombie_fields.source:
更坚韧的机械巨人僵尸。
<color=blue>《植物娘大战僵尸》联动僵尸</color>

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000（前2/3属于机械头颅）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>巨型，碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有机械巨人僵尸的所有特点</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>磁力菇类植物（机械头颅会被其吸取）</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A latest creation by Dr. Gargantuar, this machinery of doom slowly approaches with steady steps.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Inherits all Traits from regular Mecha Gargantuars.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
滚动的保龄球，动力来自小鬼僵尸和重力势能。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫黄油和中毒。滚动前进，在斜坡上加速，撞到植物后换行并减速，碰到保护伞时停下。碾压血量不足1000的植物，否则造成1000伤害。蓝眼/红眼状态死亡时，生成冰球/火球和5个小鬼僵尸。黄眼状态死亡时掉落机械碎片</color>
<color=#A86A44>冰球/火球：</color><color=red>存在30秒，碾压非坚实植物。碾压被抵抗、被坚实植物阻挡（会对其造成500伤害）、阻挡30发子弹、受到火爆辣椒/寒冰菇效果时提前消失</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>保护伞类融合植物</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A rolling bowling ball on the zombies' side.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Switches lanes when hitting plants, speeds up on slopes. Slows down after switching lanes.
<color=black>•</color>Crushes plants that has less than or equal to 1000 Toughness, and deals 1000 damage to tougher plants.
<color=black>•</color> When the Mecha-nut Zombie has red or blue eyes, spawns a fireball or ice ball respectively, and 5 Imps upon death.
<color=black>•</color> When its eyes are yellow, spawns a Mecha-nut Fragment instead.
<color=black>•</color> The balls can crush plants, block up to 30 bullets, and last 30 seconds. Can be countered by Ice-/Fire-based plant fusions.
<color=black>Weakness: </color><color=#4B0082>Umbrella Fusions</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>启动保龄球可是个麻烦的事——首先要加好油、上好润滑，然后还得把它搬到弹射装置上，之后才能启动。小鬼可搬不动保龄球，这些都是巨人帮忙干的。。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Mecha-nut Zombie doesn’t have time for small talk—literally. With every turn, crash, and slope-assisted sprint, it’s all about momentum. "Gotta keep rolling, gotta keep crushing," it mutters in a tinny, robotic voice, steam hissing from its joints. Plants unlucky enough to be in its path? Flattened. But even machines have limits—when it finally grinds to a halt, the Imps inside spill out, ready to pick up where their rolling fortress left off.

zombie_fields.source:
被变为银质雕像的僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>200</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>不会移动</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>不会被承伤、不会被伞类大招击退。出场15秒后，会快速损失血量直至死亡。死亡时掉落1000金钱</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A zombie turned into a silver statue.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>200</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Immobile. Cannot have damage to itself redirected. Cannot be knocked back by Umbrella ultimates.
<color=black>•</color> Starts to rapidly lose HP 15s after appearance.
<color=black>•</color> Drops 1 Diamond (1k Coins) upon death.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>用纯银包裹的僵尸，在花园纪念品店只售卖两枚银币。“很明显，里面包裹的僵尸降低了纯银涂层的价值。”埃德加博士评价道。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>A zombie wrapped in pure silver, sold in the garden souvenir shop for just two silver coins. "Obviously, the zombie inside lowers the value of the pure silver coating," comments Dr. Edgar Zomboss.

zombie_fields.source:
被变为金质雕像的僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>300</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>不会移动</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>不会被承伤、不会被伞类大招击退。出场15秒后，会快速损失血量直至死亡。死亡时掉落3000金钱</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A golden zombie statue, a symbol of wealth!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>300</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Immobile. Cannot have damage to itself redirected. Cannot be knocked back by Umbrella ultimates.
<color=black>•</color> Starts to rapidly lose HP 15s after appearance.
<color=black>•</color> Drops 3 Diamonds (3k Coins) upon death.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>用黄金包裹的僵尸，比起作为纪念品店售卖、它在砸金蛋活动中更受欢迎。“用豌豆砸开它。普通奖品是钱币和钻石，而隐藏大奖是一个僵尸。”埃德加博士介绍道。虽然目前依然没有人开出隐藏大奖。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>A zombie wrapped in gold. Compared to being sold as a souvenir, it is more popular in the Golden Egg Smash event. "Smash it open with peas. Common rewards are coins and diamonds, while the hidden grand prize is a zombie," explains Dr. Edgar Zomboss. So far, no one has obtained the hidden grand prize.

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>武装巨人僵尸非常喜欢他最经常玩的游戏内一款名为“骑士”的皮肤，所以他斥巨资为自己量身订购了一款中世纪铠甲，不过当他想脱下来这铠甲时就脱不下来了......然后他就获得了骑“尸”的永久皮肤。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The Armored Gargantuar is a big fan of a skin called 'Cavalier' from his favorite game. So, he spent a fortune custom-ordering a set of medieval armor tailored just for him. However, when he tried to take it off, he found it was stuck for good... And that's how he ended up with a permanent 'Cadavelier' skin.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
僵王博士驾驶无畏者机甲，统御着所有的僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>45000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>通常状态下无法被选中，仅在俯身时会被攻击或受到伤害。死亡时，使场上其他僵尸死亡，结束本轮关卡</color>
<color=#3D1400>[站立模式]
①</color><color=red>会抬脚踩扁最右侧4列2×4范围的地面植物</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>在右半场随机位置放置随机僵尸，放置4~7次。结束后，切换为俯身模式</color>
<color=#3D1400>[俯身模式]</color>
<color=red>等待数秒后，吐出一颗冰球/火球。冰球/火球会向左滚动，秒杀接触的植物，只能被火爆辣椒效果/寒冰菇效果消除。结束后，切换为站立模式，并进行一次特殊攻击</color>
<color=#3D1400>[特殊攻击]
①</color><color=red>在第2~4列随机位置空降3只蹦极僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>血量低于50%时，改为砸下车辆，秒杀2×3范围的植物</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Dr. Zomboss rules them all.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>60000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Drops a trophy upon defeat. Incoming damage is capped at 5000 before reduction. Immune to most status effects, except Chill, Freeze, and Enflamed. Has multiple attack modes:
<color=black>•</color> Deploys regular zombies on the right half of the lawn.
<color=black>•</color> Stomps on plants in the rightmost 4 columns.
<color=black>•</color> Releases rolling ice and fireballs that crush plants in a lane.
<color=black>•</color> Drops 3 Bungee Zombies on the left half of the lawn.
<color=black>•</color> At half health, starts to throw campers that crush all plants in a 2x3 area.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>僵王博士乔治·埃德加只花了两年就获得了死亡学博士学位。在迅速掌握死亡学的技术后，他制造了一只恐怖的僵尸机器人（无畏者），并着手建立起一个独裁的地方势力。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Edgar George Zomboss achieved his Doctorate in Thanatology in only two years. Quickly mastering thanatological technology, he built his fearsome Zombot and set about establishing absolute dominance of his local subdivision.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
从天而降偷取你的植物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>从天而降偷取一株植物，优先偷取罩壳植物</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>进阶空降：拥有90%减伤，可能会在第四列及其右侧空投究极僵尸（钻石盲盒和领袖除外）</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Descends from the sky and steals a plant. Prioritizes Pumpkins.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Weakness: </color><color=#4B0082>Umbrellas</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifier:
</color><color=#4B0082>Gains a 90% damage reduction, and can now drop Ultimate zombies as close as column 4 (excluding Diamond Mystery-boxes and Mini-bosses).</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>蹦极僵尸最爱冒险。毕竟，如果你不再活着，那再体验次死亡又有何妨呢？
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Bungee Zombie loves to take risks. After all, what's the point of being dead if you don't live a little?</color>

zombie_fields.source:
击败奖杯僵王博士，夺回一切！

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>45000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有僵王博士的特点。血量低于50%时，砸下的车辆还会清空传送带</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合要素及场景：</color><color=red>僵王博士+奖杯。在关卡[僵王博士的复仇]中，击败<BOSS>僵王博士，拾取奖杯时，两者会产生融合
*在这种场景中，你的锤子和手套会被封印。奖杯僵王博士血量首次低于2/3时，解锁锤子；血量首次低于1/3时，解锁手套</color>
zombie_fields.english:
I'm watching you every step of the way.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>60000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Inherits all traits from Dr. Zomboss. Additionally, disables player's gloves and mallet on appearance. Mallet is unlocked at 2/3 health. Gloves are unlocked at 1/3 health. Thrown campers also clears the conveyor belt.</color>
Fusion Recipe: <color=#4B0082>Dr. Zomboss + Trophy</color>

zombie_fields.source:
身边环绕着厚重的寒气，一段时间后会逃跑。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出场一段时间后反向前进。会冻结3x3范围内的植物。进化模式中，有概率携带拼图礼盒出场</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Yeti Zombies can sometimes run away.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Freezes plants in a 3x3 area around it. Jalapenos, Torchwoods and Ice-shrooms are immune to this effect. May carry Puzzle pieces in Odyssey: Evolved.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>关于雪人僵尸的资料很少，除了他的名字、出生日期、社保号、受教育程度、工作履历以及喜爱夹心三明治（烤牛肉味）。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Many details about Yeti Zombie remain shrouded in mystery. His past? Classified. His motives? Unknown. The only things on record? His name, birth date, social security number, education, work history… and an unwavering passion for roast beef sandwich sandwiches.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
皮糙肉厚，但惧怕樱桃辣椒。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>8888+8888（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>樱桃辣椒、烈焰爆竹会对年兽额外造成15倍伤害</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Nian Zombies have very strong armor.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>8888 + 8888 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Weakness: </color><color=#4B0082>Pepper Popper deals 15× Damage to Nian Zombies.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>为了过新年，僵尸方派出了富有浓厚过年气息的年兽僵尸，“看看我这身新买的衣裳，是不是很像舞狮，好看极了，我现在就去给植物们拜年！”年兽僵尸如是说到，但植物们太客气了，经过一番“推谢”后，年兽僵尸被扫地出门。
</color>
zombie_fields.english:
<align=left><color=black>To celebrate the New Year, the zombie party sends out Nian Zombie, the embodiment of festive spirit.

"Look at my new clothes! Don't I look just like a lion dancer? Pretty nice, right? Now, time to give my New Year's greetings to the plants!"

Unfortunately for him, the plants were too polite. After a flurry of cheerful "thank yous", Nian Zombie found himself promptly swept away, whether he liked it or not.

zombie_fields.source:
居于雪原的射击者，会发射雪球冻结你的植物。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>20</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1。每5秒发射1个白雪球，对3×3范围的植物施加5秒攻击冻结。白雪球不会被保护伞弹走，且会对魅惑僵尸施加等级1寒冷状态，赋予20冻结值</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Snowball Launcher Zombie can attack your plants with snowballs and freeze them.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>20/5s</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to Chill and Freeze. Vulnerable to Deep Chill.
<color=black>•</color> After appearing, it will continually launch snowballs at plants, which will deal 20 damage and explode upon impact, freezing plants for 5s in a 3×3 range. Snowballs inflict 20 Cryo points to hypnotized zombies affected.</color>
<color=black>Weakness: </color><color=#4B0082>Umbrella Rind</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“打雪仗了！”刚从雪地里醒来的雪枪僵尸向着四周发射雪球。“就这样看着他吗？”“是的，我想知道他多久才会发现。”不一会，又一颗雪球砸了下来：“第14次”
</color>
zombie_fields.english:
<align=left><color=black>"Snowball fight!" Snowball Launcher Zombie wakes up from his icy slumber, flinging snowballs wildly in every direction.

"Should we tell him?"
"Nah, let's see how long it takes him to figure it out."

SMACK!—Another snowball lands.

"That makes fourteen."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
居于雪原的持盾者，会弹开平射子弹并回敬雪球。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+2200（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1。在右半场时，可以每1.35秒长推盾牌，将平射子弹反弹为白雪球，每发消耗盾牌20耐久。优先用盾击造成非啃咬伤害</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A shieldbearer from the snowy plains, he deflects straight-firing projectiles and returns them as snowballs.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720 + 2200 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to Chill and Freeze. Vulnerable to Deep Chill.
<color=black>•</color> Raises shield every 1.35s to reflect straight-firing projectiles as snowballs. Takes 20 damage when reflecting and does not block the projectile. Delivers shield bashes instead of biting when holding the shield, dealing 50 damage.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>雪盾僵尸曾是战场上精锐的士兵，如今退役后是墓园打雪仗比赛的蝉联冠军。他非常珍惜这面为他带来荣耀的盾牌，总是摸一摸看有没有损坏，或许他受伤退役也和这个习惯有关。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Frost Legion Shieldbearer was once an elite soldier on the battlefield. Now retired, he’s the reigning champion of the graveyard snowball fight tournament. He treasures the shield that brought him so much glory, constantly checking it for scratches—though some say that very habit might be what got him injured and retired in the first place.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
居于雪原的投叉者，会扔出雪叉冰封植物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1。拥有三叉戟僵尸的特点。雪叉在伤害后会施加冰封</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Throws snow harpoons that glaciate your plants.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to Chill and Freeze. Vulnerable to Deep Chill.
<color=black>•</color> Inherits traits from Trident Zombie. Snow harpoons are not attracted by Umbrellas and glaciate plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>正在举办的第五届墓园冰奥会上，雪叉僵尸表现亮眼。他打算用比赛的奖金为自己和弟兄们购入一辆新的雪橇车，以及预约一次奢侈的脚底按摩，弥补地刺带来的损失。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>At the ongoing 5th Undead Olympics Winter Games, Frost Legion Harpooneer hogs all the spotlight. He plans to use his prize money to buy a new sled for himself and his crew—and maybe treat them to a luxurious foot massage to make up for all the damage from stepping on Spikeweeds.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
超越时间与空间，世界之外的力量。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>20</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+200（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每1.5秒发射一颗超时空豌豆。每6秒，从传送门中随机召唤1个普僵/路障/铁桶/铁门僵尸。被击杀时掉落时空碎片</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A force beyond time and space, drawn from the edges of reality itself.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>20/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 200 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Fires chrono peas at your defense. Every 6s, randomly summons a regular, Conehead, Buckethead, or Screen Door zombie from the portal. Drops a Chrono Core upon death.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>超时空豌豆射手僵尸手里的门到底是什么？没有僵尸知道，也不想知道，但当看见老伙计们陆续从门里钻出来的时候，他们很愿意上前问问里面有没有新鲜的脑子。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>What exactly is behind the portal held by the Chronoporter Zombie? No zombie really knows — nor do they care to find out. But when their old pals start crawling out one after another, they're more than happy to step up and ask if there's any fresh brains inside.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
下雪了！移动时制造雪花，稍后反向离场并召唤雪人小队。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>冻结下方植物。出场后减速，速度为0后反向移动，离场时召唤雪人小队：雪盾、雪枪、雪叉僵尸各1个</color>
zombie_fields.english:
It's snowing! This chilly guest drifts in with flurries, freezes plants, and leaves with backup.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to Blover. Creates snowflakes while moving, freezing plants below. Slows down over time — when speed reaches zero, reverses direction. Upon exit, summons a Frost Legion Squad: one each of Shieldbearer, Snowball Launcher, and Trident Thrower Zombies.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>雪人飞碟每一次起飞前，都要花上半个小时清理积雪和冰块，然后把藏在角落里的雪兽拎出来。“要让这个冰坨子飞起来，每次都要耗费大量的燃料。”驾驶员愤愤道。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Before every liftoff, the crew of the Freezer Disc spends half an hour clearing snow and ice — and dragging out the Snowfurs hiding in the corners. "Getting this frozen lump off the ground eats up a ridiculous amount of fuel," the pilot grumbles.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
用冰块当作护具的雪原僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+370（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A legionnaire zombie wearing an iceblock helmet.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>500 + 370 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to Chill and Freeze. Vulnerable to Deep Chill.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“在寒冷的雪原，更要注意保暖工作。事实上，冰块也是很好的保温材料。”冰块僵尸骄傲地向其他僵尸推荐自己的方法，但没人尝试。他似乎没有发现，冰块的隔音效果同样很好。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"In the freezing Snowy Plains, keeping warm is essential. In fact, ice makes a great insulator," Blockhead Zombie proudly tells the others—but no one takes his advice. He doesn't seem to notice that ice is also a great soundproofing material.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
会碾压植物的雪原生物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A hostile creature native to the snowy plains.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to Chill. Moves very slowly, crushes plants, but does not directly attack.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>对雪兽的生物分类研究一直没有进展。毕竟你不能指望这些缺少脑子的僵尸有太高的学识，他们当中的大多数甚至无法准确区分雪兽和披着雪兽皮的雪人僵尸。好在埃德加博士给出了绝妙的区分方法：“看起来更聪明的那个是雪兽。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Research into the biological classification of Snowfurs has seen little progress. After all, you can't expect zombies—who lack brains—to be academically sharp. Most can’t even tell a real Snowfur from a Yeti Zombie in a Snowfur pelt. Thankfully, Dr. Edgar offered a brilliant method: 'The smarter-looking one is the Snowfur.'</color>

zombie_fields.source:
雪原生物之王。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Apex of the snowy plains.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to Chill. Moves very slowly and crushes plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>雪兽王相比其他雪兽，拥有更强的力量、更重的尾巴、更高的智慧；但是决定他成为族群领袖的，还是他出众的弹跳力，帮助族群寻找到了雪瀑布的源头。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Stronger, wiser, and with a heavier tail than other snow beasts, what truly made him leader was his remarkable leap — guiding his kin to the source of the frozen waterfall.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
使用随机材质的矿镐破坏你的前排。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+1400（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>50（非啃咬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击会为坚实植物累计挖掘进度，达到100%后强制秒杀，挖掘进度=(攻击次数×挖掘值)/植物血量。出场时随机获得挖掘能力不同的镐子，针对不高于特定韧性的植物时，挖掘值×5。
金镐：挖掘值150，韧性4000
铁镐：挖掘值50，韧性16000
钻石镐：挖掘值100，韧性32000</color>
<color=#3D1400>坚实植物：</color><color=red>坚果类、南瓜类、汉堡王、冻梨</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Wields a random pickaxe to mine through your defense.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>50 (non-biting)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720 + 1400 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Attacks accumulate mining progress against defensive plants, insta-killing the plant when it reaches 100%. 
<color=black>•</color> Mining progress = (number of attacks × pickaxe damage) / plant HP.
<color=black>•</color> On appearance, randomly receives a pickaxe with different pickaxe powers. When targeting plants with Toughness below their pickaxe powers, pickaxe damage is multiplied by 5.
<color=black>•</color>Pickaxe Types:
	Gold Pickaxe: 150 damage | 4000 power
	Iron Pickaxe: 50 damage | 16000 power
	Diamond Pickaxe: 100 damage | 32000 power
<color=black>•</color> Defensive plants: Nuts, Pumpkins, Burger Blaster, Pearmafrost.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“我不要在这个世界生活，”勘探者僵尸从单调的生活中得不到一点快乐，他只想挖掘足够的黑曜石造出传送门，离开这个地方。且不说传送门的另一端更加危险单调，他根本就没有点亮传送门的可能——僵尸界唯一已知的点火工具正在神秘的金字塔里。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"I don’t want to live in this world," Miner Zombie laments, finding no joy in his monotonous life. He just wants to dig up enough obsidian to build a portal and leave. Not to mention that the other side of the portal is even more dangerous and monotonous, he has no chance of lighting the portal at all. The only known ignition tool is guarded deep inside ancient pyramids found in only two locations of the world, where torch-bearing zombies roam.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
阅读被打扰时会发怒，然后…回家再取一份报纸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+720（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>失去报纸后速度大增，并掉转方向前进，在右侧离场后，取得新的报纸并恢复至满状态重新入场。因魅惑而离场不会触发该效果</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Gets angry when his reading is interrupted... then goes home to fetch another tabloid.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720 + 720 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>After losing his tabloid, greatly increases speed and reverses direction. Upon exiting on the right, spawns a brand new Dolphinhead Newspaper Zombie. This does not trigger if he's hypnotized.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“以前他的梦想是成为美人鱼，但负责给他整容的医师把应该给他的上下半身搞反了。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>He once dreamed of becoming a mermaid, but the surgeon who was supposed to fix him got his top and bottom halves completely mixed up.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
会爆炸的炮弹。

<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>命中时造成爆炸。炮弹受到1000伤害后会被消除。雷鸣机械潜艇僵尸发射的炮弹可被三叶草效果吹飞</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Me bomb. Me explode.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Can only be targeted by anti-air attacks. Missiles fire by Boomers can also be blown away by Blovers.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
为展示最爱的头盔款式，精巧地在场上来回穿梭。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+1400（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有头盔时无视植物阻挡。前进至第一列或后退至离场时，回满血量并换上新的头盔，然后掉转方向移动</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Moves across the field with nimble strides, eager to show off his stylish helmet.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720 + 1400 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Ignores plant collision while wearing his helmet. Upon reaching the first column or the edge of the lawn, he restores all HP, equips a new helmet, and reverses direction.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>这家伙在橄榄球赛场上简直如鱼得水。等会，这是个比喻，我没让你们真的往赛场里灌水！
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>This guy moves like a fish in water on the football field. Wait! It's supposed to be a metaphor! Who said you could flood the lawn!?</color>

zombie_fields.source:
雪兽幼崽，因喜爱翻滚而容易夭折。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>300</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1，免疫冻结。滚动前进，碰到植物时造成等同于自身血量的伤害，然后死亡。有1/3的概率闪避伤害</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A baby Snowfur that loves to tumble, but rarely survives it.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>300</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to Chill. Rolls forward. Upon hitting a plant, deals damage equal to its current HP, then dies.
<color=black>•</color> Has a 1/3 chance to evade any damage.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>尽管年龄还小，但小雪兽已经有了大志向。它要像大雪兽一样威风地称霸雪原，而不是和小鬼僵尸这样的小不点搭档。它逃出了军营准备闯荡一番，却不小心跑到了植物的阵地上……哎哟！
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Though just a cub, Furling has big dreams — to dominate the tundra like the mighty Elder Snowfur, not hang around with mischievous Imp Zombies. It ran off from camp to make a name for itself… and accidentally rolled into the plants' territory. Oof!</color>

zombie_fields.source:
报复心强烈，被弹走后会卷土重来，投下盲盒巨人。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>仅在旗帜波出场。被击杀时掉落200阳光和3000金钱。首次被保护伞类弹走后，在第四列或更右侧空投一个盲盒巨人僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Carries valuables but also mystery-boxes!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Only appears in flag waves.
<color=black>•</color> If bounced away by an Umbrella Leaf, returns shortly after to drop a Mystery Gargantuar on the right side of the lawn. Can be bounced away again and won't return a second time.
<color=black>•</color> Drops 3 Diamonds and 200 Sun if defeated.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>对财宝的渴求让贪欲蹦极僵尸克服了恐高和内向，他追求更高、更快、夺取更多的财宝。最近，他又沉迷上了开盲盒。
</color>
zombie_fields.english:
<align=left><color=black>Living it large after a recent heist, Burglar Bungee Zombie bought a new suit to flaunt their wealth. Not all heists are successful, but where a heist is failed, Burglar Bungee Zombie leaves a "present" for the unsuspecting lawns that believe one Umbrella is enough to save the day.

-Written by Hazy</color>

zombie_fields.source:
召唤分身石像，为自身伴舞。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出场3秒内太空步入场，随后在附近（塔防模式为原地）生成4个韧性500的伴舞石像</color>
<color=#3D1400>伴舞石像：</color><color=red>不会移动。存在15秒后会自动破损，并根据剩余血量生成1个相同韧性的沙滩舞王僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Michael is on vacation with a newfound passion for uncovering stone statues from lost coastal civilizations!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Summons 4 Dancing Statues with 500 HP. If not destroyed after 15s, each Statue breaks and spawns a Beach Michael with HP equal to the statue's remaining HP.
<color=black>•</color> In non-TD modes, Statues appear in the same spots where a regular Michael would summon Dancing Pole Vaulters.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>沙滩舞王即将举办他的第一场演出，为此他借走了白舞王的演出设备。“演出结束我就还回去。现在，你们俩搬音响，你们俩搬麦克风，嘿！快点！动起来，不要像石像一样呆站着！”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Beach Michael Zombie is unmatched when it comes to unearthing hidden relics. Always coming first in competitions, many other zombies look up to his talent. Only Dr. Edgar Zomboss finds it unsettling that every relic looks unnervingly similar to Beach Michael Zombie, though.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
为沙滩舞王伴舞的诡异石像。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>500</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>不会移动</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>存在15秒后会自动破损，并根据剩余血量生成1个相同韧性的沙滩舞王僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Hm.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>500</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Breaks and spawns a Beach Michael with HP equal to the statue's remaining HP 15s after being summoned.
<color=black>•</color> In non-TD modes, Statues appear in the same spots where a regular Michael would summon Dancing Pole Vaulters.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>沙滩上有时会出现一些奇怪的石像。是远古僵尸文明的造物？还是小沙兽调皮堆起来的雕塑？其实是跟随沙滩舞王彻夜练习舞蹈、以至于被潮汐卷起的沙子包裹住的学徒。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Moe moai kyee~.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
精锐橄榄球员，向前翻滚拿下首攻。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+1400（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>首次啃咬后进行翻滚，向前无视植物移动2.7格</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Can perform dodge rolls.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720 + 1400 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082> Upon first contact with a plant, rolls two tiles forward ignoring obstacles.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>旗帜橄榄球队长在球类运动上有过人的天赋，他学习任何动作都非常快，尤其是带球过人这个动作。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"We both wear football uniforms and carry banners. But I can roll, and he can't." Acrobat Football Zombie compared himself seriously to the Giga Football-nut Zombie and confidently concluded he was stronger. This confidence helps - now he runs faster to escape the Giga Football-nut Zombie's pursuit.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
如风滚草般移动，小身形利于躲避。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>300</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>有1/3的概率闪避伤害。滚动前进，接触植物时造成等同于自身血量的伤害，然后死亡。滚动时，有2/3的概率无视并直接穿过植物，最多无视3次</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Moves like a tumbleweed; its small size makes it harder to hit.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>300</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Rolls forward, ignoring plants 2/3 of the time (each can ignore a maximum of 3 plants). When colliding with a plant, deals damage equal to its own health and dies. Has a 1/3 chance to evade any damage.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>小沙兽曾经也是一只小雪兽的,由于他出去玩时到了沙滩,沾上了一堆沙子,就变成了小沙兽。“至于为什么有时植物不理他,是因为我用沙子掩护自己,让他们看不见我!”小沙兽自豪地说。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Tumbling used to be a Furling. One day, it went out to play and got covered in sand at the beach, transforming it into the Tumbling. "Sometimes plants ignore me because I use sand as camouflage!" it thought to itself.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
骑着小鸡，小鸡快速进场啄食植物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>500</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>移动速度和啃咬速度极快。（小鸡）死亡时，一个小鬼僵尸会从鸡背上滚落至场上</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Rides a chicken that dashes forward to peck plants.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>500</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Moves and pecks extremely fast. When the chicken dies, an Imp falls from its back onto the field.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>《冒险者笔记》第一条：鸡是最危险的生物；第二条：不要试图用任何方式攻击一只鸡；第三条：如果有一只鸡向着你高速移动，祈祷自己有一个跑得慢的队友……
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>What would you rather fight? 10 Zombie-sized Chicken or 100 Chicken-sized Zombies? Well, fret not if you don't know, they are now coming at you together!</color>

zombie_fields.source:
乘骑着战马冲击植物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫击退。撞到植物后需要在原地停顿修整约3秒</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Rides a warhorse to charge at plants.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color><color=#4B0082>Extremely Fast</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to knockback. Tramples and crushes the first plant on collision. Pauses for about 3s to recover afterwards before charging again.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>彼得从小就喜欢看骑士小说，长大后，他加入了埃德加博士的骑兵团，在战场上英勇冲杀，没有什么能阻止他，尽管缺少甲胄、尽管怕疼、尽管背上还要背着一个累赘——是的，彼得是一匹僵尸马。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Peter loved reading knight stories as a child. When he grew up, he joined Dr. Edgar's cavalry, bravely charging across the battlefield. Nothing could stop him — not lacking armor, not fearing pain, not even carrying a burden on his back. Yes, Peter is a Zombie Horse.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
驾驭着铁骑稳步推进，情势不利时，会更加激进进攻。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>80</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>本体1800+战马1400（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>仅在旗帜波出场。免疫击退。每1.5秒发射4发铁豌豆。本体会在血量首次低于50%时在每行召唤1个僵尸马骑士作为团员，并为其提供66%减伤。如果本体在骑乘战马时被击杀，掉落橄榄帽。战马死亡（失去二类防具）时，保留本体血量，变为机枪黑橄榄僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Calls reinforcements and goes berserk when his horse dies. 

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>80×4/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1800 (self) + 1400 (horse, Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Only appears in flag waves, immune to knockback.
<color=black>•</color> Summons a Zombie Horseman in every lane when body HP drops to 50%.
<color=black>•</color> While alive, provides a 66% damage reduction to the summoned Horsemen.
<color=black>•</color> The horse can trample plants and protects the rider like Type 2 Armor.
<color=black>•</color> If the horse dies first, the Captain dismounts as a Giga Buckshot Commando, and starts to fire Iron peas every 0.1s. If the Knight Captain dies while mounted, drops a Football Helmet.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>杰德和他的爱马竖毛是七大洲僵尸橄榄球联赛的超级巨星，依靠竖毛的速度和他高价从植物那里买来的橄榄球发球器，他们所向披靡。虽然这种操作严重犯规，甚至他发射的也不是橄榄球，但无人在意，只要他先瞄准仅有的几个懂橄榄球的裁判就好了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Jed and his horse Spiky are superstars in the Seven Undercontinents Zombie Football League. With Spiky's speed and Football launchers he bought at high prices from plants, they sweep through the field. Even though this is a serious foul, and the projectiles aren't even footballs, no one cares as long as he targets the few referees who actually understand football first.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
驾驶快艇在水上飞驰，碰瓷植物后弃船逃逸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>撞到植物后自毁，并提前将驾驶员（小鬼僵尸）弹射至附近地面</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Skims across water at high speed; collides with plants and ejects the driver before self-destruction.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color><color=#4B0082>Fast</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Crushes the first plant on collision, ejects an Imp onto the nearby land and self-destructs.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>很难相信这么小的快艇居然能出现严重的漏水问题，这就是图便宜不托付给机鱼公司制造的后果。不过没关系，制造方还有优秀的补救措施：将快艇改造为低空飞行器！燃油用量高了点也没关系，制造方还有优质燃油出售。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Hard to believe such a small speedboat could have serious leaks. What else do you expect when you don't commission Gfish Corps? But no worries — the manufacturer has an excellent fix: convert it into a hovercraft! Fuel consumption is higher, but premium fuel is also available.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
扶梯上附着的诅咒，会悄无声息地摧毁植物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+1350（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>搭梯时，施加[10%×(植物血量+韧性)/2]层诅咒。咒梯每1秒为诅咒层数不为0的植物施加100层诅咒。咒梯仅能被拥有“万磁王”词条的磁力菇王吸取</color>
<color=#3D1400>诅咒状态：</color><color=red>使满血植物受伤。层数不为0时，每0.1秒增加1层。植物血量低于层数时，立即死亡。治疗会优先抵消等量层数，再回复血量</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Wields a wooden ladder imbued with a lifelink curse that will silently destroy plants.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720 + 1350 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> After placing the Lifelink Ladder, apply [0.1 × (Plant HP + Toughness)/2] curse stacks. The ladder applies 100 curse stacks to plants whose curse stacks are zero.
<color=black>•</color> The Lifelink Ladder can only be attracted by a Tesla Magnet that has its 2nd Modifier unlocked.

<color=black>Curse: </color>Damages a plant at full health. When stacks are not zero, increases by 1 stack every 0.1 seconds. If the plant's HP is lower than the stack count, the plant dies immediately. Healing first cancels an equal number of stacks, then restores HP.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“强者从不抱怨环境，而我也从不依赖梯子！”咒梯僵尸稳稳地抓着扶梯。“手中的梯子是我的防御工具，而放下的梯子依旧是我的抗伤利器！”说罢他放下扶梯，聆听着坚果破碎的声音。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"The strong never complain about their environment, and I never rely on ladders!" says Lifelink Ladder Zombie while gripping the ladder. "This bad boy in my hand is a defensive tool, and the one I set down is still my weapon against damage!" He sets down the ladder and listens to nuts cracking.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
会招来僵尸的恶之花，能像墓碑一样顶替植物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>300</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：①</color><color=red>只会在地图右5列出场，尽可能在空地出场，否则随机顶替一格植物</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>不会被承伤</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>能吸收经过的植物方子弹，每吸收1发子弹流失0.1倍韧性的血量</color>
<color=#3D1400>④</color><color=red>出场10秒后，随机召唤一只植物僵尸，此后每15秒召唤1只。死亡时召唤1只并掉落僵尸肥料</color>
<color=#3D1400>⑤</color><color=red>对其使用肥料时，消失并掉落1张惊喜礼盒卡牌</color>
<color=#3D1400>僵尸肥料：</color><color=red>火封一格植物。5秒内未使用时，也会随机对场上一株主位植物使用。无法对免疫火封的植物使用</color>
<color=#3D1400>火封：</color><color=red>巨型植物、火系植物、超级机械坚果免疫火封。期间不可与植物交互。吸收25发子弹或受到肥料效果后解除。僵尸方解除火封时，将原植物变为僵尸火红莲</color>
zombie_fields.english:
An evil flower that summons zombies and can replace plants like a gravestone.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>300</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Appears only in the 5 rightmost columns of the lawn. Prefers empty tiles; otherwise replaces a random plant.
<color=black>•</color> Cannot be shoveled or moved with gloves. Ignored by Zombies.
<color=black>•</color> Absorbs plant-side projectiles that pass through it, taking 30 damage each time.
<color=black>•</color> 10s after appearance, summons a random Zombotany; summons another every 15s thereafter, and once more upon death.
<color=black>•</color> Also drops Zombie Fertilizer on death.
<color=black>•</color> When fertilized, drops a Plant Giftbox and disappears.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>没有人知道他为什么出现在僵尸聚集的地方、也没有人知道他为什么能召唤源源不断的僵尸。有人说他是火红莲的墓碑，也有人说他是植物中的叛徒。僵尸火红莲把一切都埋藏在心底，或许他曾经解释过，但没有人能听懂。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>No one knows why she appears among the undead, nor how she can summon endless waves of zombies. Some say she is the gravestone of Endoflame; others call her a traitor among plants. Whatever the truth, Necroflame keeps it buried deep within. Perhaps she once tried to explain, but no one could understand.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
用自爆火焰烧掉本行的魅惑僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出场一段时间后自爆，释放一行火焰，只对植物方僵尸造成1800伤害</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Burns Hypnotized Zombies in her lane.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Self-destructs after some time, releasing a row of flames that deals 1800 damage only to Hypnotized Zombies in her lane.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>第一次参加魅惑僵尸选美大赛的魅惑辣椒僵尸就得到了所有评委的一致好评、强势夺冠，无论是植物评委还是僵尸评委，都称赞她又“魅”又“辣”。除了部分参赛的魅惑僵尸离奇失踪外，这简直是一场完美无缺的精彩比赛。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>On her first appearance at the Hypnotized Zombie Beauty Pageant, Hypno Pepper Zombie won unanimous praise from all judges and took the first place with ease. Both plant and zombie judges called her 'hot' and 'spicy'. Aside from a few mysteriously missing contestants, it was a flawless event.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
用矿镐将植物转化为魅惑僵尸，再用自爆火焰将其烧掉。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1500</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>矿镐未被吸取时，攻击会将非坚实植物转化为植物方的随机植物僵尸，或赋予坚实植物500挖掘值。如果成功挖掘到底线出土，一段时间后会像魅惑辣椒僵尸一样自爆</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Uses her pickaxe to convert plants into Hypnotized Zombies, then burns them with a self-destruct flame.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1500</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> If pickaxe hasn't been removed, attacks convert non-defensive plants into random hypnotized zombotanies, or apply 500 mining progress to defensive plants.
<color=black>•</color>On reaching the backline and emerging, she will self-destruct like the Hypno Pepper Zombie after a short delay, releasing a row of flames that deals 1800 damage only to Hypnotized Zombies in her lane.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>魅惑辣椒矿工僵尸擅长绕后偷袭，用自己被赋予了魔力的镐子把植物转化成僵尸。不过这些僵尸都是正义的伙伴，会看不惯偷袭的行径而反水，殊不知，他们其实也在偷袭偷袭的人。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Hypno Pepper Digger excels at sneaking behind defenses, using her magically infused pickaxe to convert plants into zombies. But those newly made zombies are righteous at heart: they dislike ambush tactics and will turn against her… unaware that they are also 'ambushing the ambusher'.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>体脂率高的僵尸更容易浮在水上，但坚信自己是海神后裔的三叉戟巨人僵尸宣称这是海神的眷顾。不过，以他的体型，直接踏着水底行走似乎也不是什么难事……
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Zombies with higher body fat float more easily, but the Trident Gargantuar Zombie, convinced he is a descendant of the legendary Pozeidon, claims in his case it is divine favor. That said, with his size, walking straight along the bottom of the water would not be difficult either…</color>

zombie_fields.source:
跳远能力优秀，充分助跑后更能完美跨越障碍。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>快，跳跃后变为极慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>遇到首个植物时，向前翻越3格，然后失去撑杆。出场后开始助跑加速。如果助跑时间超过8秒，则翻越时不会被高大植物阻挡</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Excels at long-distance jumps, and with sufficient run-up can flawlessly clear obstacles.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>When encountering the first plant, vaults forward 3 tiles and then loses the pole. Begins accelerating for a run-up upon entering the field. If the run-up lasts more than 8s, the jump becomes unblockable by tall plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>强大的爆发力是冠军撑杆僵尸取胜的秘籍，只要助跑时跑得更快，起跳时就能够跳得更远，但他似乎忘记了撑杆跳比的是跳高而不是跳远。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Powerful burst strength is Olympic Pole Vaulting Zombie's secret to victory. As long as he runs faster during his approach, he can leap farther when taking off - though he seems to have forgotten that pole vaulting is about jumping high, not jumping far.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
会根据面临的进攻强度换上不同颜色的队服。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+1400（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出场15秒后，如果仍佩戴橄榄帽，则变为（红色）橄榄球僵尸，否则，变为无视植物阻挡的黄色橄榄球僵尸。如果出场3秒内就被击杀，则变为韧性较高、橄榄帽不会被吸取的黑橄榄僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>磁力菇类植物（橄榄帽会被其吸取）</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Changes into different-colored uniforms based on incoming damage intensity.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 1400  (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>After 15s on the field, if he is still wearing his football helmet, he becomes a regular Football Zombie. Otherwise, he becomes a Rush Football Zombie that ignores plant. If defeated within 3s of appearing, he instead becomes a Giga Football Zombie with high toughness whose helmet cannot be removed by Magnet-shrooms.
<color=black>Weakness: </color><color=#4B0082>Magnet-shroom</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>无色橄榄球僵尸的职业生涯从未有过一次败绩，这是众多橄榄球僵尸难以到达的高度，而他取胜的方式也十分简单，只需要在对手胜利的时候换上对方的队服就行了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The Chameleon Football Zombie has never lost a single match in his entire career — an achievement most Football Zombies can only dream of. His secret to victory is surprisingly simple: whenever the opponent is about to win, he just switches into their uniform.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
以精巧的步伐避开植物前进。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+1400（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>无视植物阻挡</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>磁力菇类植物（橄榄帽会被其吸取）</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Advances by nimbly circumventing blocking plants.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 1400  (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Ignores plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>比起强硬地突破对手的防守，黄色橄榄球僵尸更擅长利用自身的敏捷直接越过对方，而令他困惑的是，哪怕他能够轻松越过无数道防守，他也依旧无法越过那个看着毫不起眼的除草机。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Rather than smashing through defenses head-on, the Rush Football Zombie excels at using his agility to dash straight past them. What confuses him most is that, despite effortlessly bypassing countless defenses, he still can't get past that seemingly harmless lawn mower.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
用撑杆打开时空乱流，翻越到意想不到的地方。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+1100（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>翻越植物时传送向3×3范围内的随机一格。被击杀时，掉落时空碎片</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Uses its pole to open a temporal vortex and leap into unexpected places.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720 + 1100 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color><color=#4B0082>Medium</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>When vaulting over a plant, it will teleport randomly on a tile within a 3x3 area. Drops a Chrono Core upon death.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>依靠自己独有的传送能力，超时空撑杆僵尸可以轻易挑战任何高度的撑杆跳，并且能百分百越过横杆。现在唯一令他头大的问题是，他经常落在观众席上。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Thanks to its unique ability to teleport, Chronovaulter Zombie can easily tackle pole vaults of any height and clears the bar 100% of the time. The only problem giving him a headache right now is that he often lands in the stands.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
指导着撑杆跳远，教材被毁则会喝令学员并亲身上前指挥。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+720（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢，破报后变为中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>使本行的撑杆类僵尸的跳跃距离增加1格。破报后，距离提升幅度增加至1.5格，并在本行召唤一只撑杆僵尸。距离提升效果取较大值且不可叠加</color>
zombie_fields.english:
