Trains Pole Vaulting Zombies. If his manual is destroyed, he'll start barking orders and personally step in to lead.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720 + 720  (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color><color=#4B0082>Slow; Medium Fast after manual is destroyed</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Increases the jump distance of all pole-vaulting zombies in his lane by 1 tile. After his manual is destroyed, this bonus increases to 1.5 tiles and he summons a Pole Vaulting Zombie in the same lane. This buff is unstackable and always uses the larger value if multiple are active.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“别走好吗，”多么感人的一句话啊，可惜是从撑杆教练僵尸嘴里说出来的。每名撑杆僵尸都能猜到他接下来会说什么。“别走好吗，都跑起来！”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"Don't walk away," what a touching phrase… unfortunately it's coming from the Coach Zombie. Every pole vaulter already knows what he'll say next: "Don't walk away, start running!"</color>

zombie_fields.source:
深信铁制品的防护力，还会通过报纸向同僚分享经验。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+1100（一类）+1100（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢，破报后变为中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出场时，自身和本行其他种类的读报僵尸获得50点护甲。破报后，该加成提升至100点</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>磁力菇类植物（铁桶会被其吸取）</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Firmly believes in the protective power of metal, and shares his "expertise" with others through his magazine.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 1100 (Type 1) + 1100 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>On spawn, grants 50 DR Value to himself and all other Newspaper Zombies in the same lane. After his magazine is destroyed, this bonus increases to 100.</color>
<color=black>Weakness: </color><color=#4B0082>Magnet-shroom</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>花园的手推车、爆米花机和铁桶读报僵尸有什么共同点？他们都像铁一样硬，都用着红色油漆，都很老，而且动起来都会嘎吱嘎吱响。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>What do lawn mowers, popcorn machines, and Buckethead Newspaper Zombies have in common? They're all tough as steel, painted red, very old — and they all creak when they move.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
外表呆萌的雪原生物，但在适宜的环境中会变得危险。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快，滑行时变为快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压（滑行时）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1。跳跃前进，落地时对范围内植物造成100伤害2次。若在冰道上，滑行前进。若在暴风雪下，无需冰道也可滑行</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Cute on the outside, but dangerous in their preferred environment.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to Chill. Hops forward, dealing 100 damage twice to plants upon landing. On ice trails, slides forward and crushes plants. During blizzards, can start sliding even without ice.</color>
<color=black>Weakness: </color><color=#4B0082>Bamblock</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>它们实际上是一群真正的企鹅，在雪原屡建奇功，因此博士赐予了它们僵化美瞳和“僵尸”的称号。说真的，如果它们明白“僵尸”是什么意思，一定会拒绝接受这份赏赐。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>They're actually real penguins who achieved great feats in the Antarctic, so Doctor Zomboss rewarded them with zombie-style contact lenses and the title of "zombie". Honestly, if they understood what that meant, they'd probably refuse.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
居于雪原的普通僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A basic zombie that inhabits the tundra.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to Chill and Freeze.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>雪原僵尸认为自己和雪原外那群僵尸不同，他的胸口有着被雪原冻出的伤疤，这是冒险家的标志。但是他却从来不敢脱下棉袄把伤疤展示出来，因为他害怕再被冻出第二道。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Frost Legionnaire Zombie believes he's different from those outside the frozen wastes. The frostbite scar on his chest is, to him, proof of his status as an adventurer. Still, he never dares take off his coat to show it: he's afraid of getting a second one.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
用层叠的冰块当作护具的雪原僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+1100（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A tundra zombie that uses layered ice as armor.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 1100 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to Chill and Freeze.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>放心，就算内层的冰块全部融化，他也不会脑子进水的。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Don't worry, even if all the inner ice melts, he's not going to get water in his brain — he has got none of that left!</color>

zombie_fields.source:
企鹅中的王者，会自己创造适宜族群的环境。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1440</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快，滑行时变为极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压（滑行时）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1。跳跃前进，落地时对范围内植物造成500伤害2次。若在冰道上，滑行前进。若场景为雪原，出场时使场上立即出现暴风雪效果，且在暴风雪下，无需冰道也可滑行</color>
zombie_fields.english:
The king among penguins, capable of creating favorable conditions for its kind.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1440</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to Chill. Hops forward, dealing 500 damage twice to plants upon landing. On ice trails, slides forward and crushes plants. If on a Snow map, triggers a blizzard immediately upon spawning; during blizzards, can start sliding even without ice.</color>
<color=black>Weakness: </color><color=#4B0082>Bamblock</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>滑得最快的僵尸企鹅将会被推举为僵尸帝王企鹅，它在族群中主要负责探路，大多数僵尸企鹅都只敢踩它踩过的坚实冰面。但作为最不缺食物的僵尸企鹅，僵尸帝王企鹅几乎都重到只能在暴风雪中滑动。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The fastest-sliding penguin is chosen as the Emperor Penguin. It leads the waddle, scouting safe paths, most penguins only dare step where it has already walked. As the best-fed among them, it's usually so heavy that when it slides an avalanche usually ensues.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
头戴坚固且绝缘的复合防具。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+1470（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Wears a sturdy and insulating aluminum helmet.

<color=black>Toughness: </color>270 + 1470 (Type 1)
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Slow</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>他对磁力菇无法吸取他的防具这件事很是高兴，但又有些不解，毕竟银灰色又坚硬的东西就是铁，这可是僵尸的常识。什么？铝是什么东西？
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Tinfoilhead Zombie is delightfully ecstatic that Magnet-shroom can't absorb his armor, but at the same time he's a bit puzzled — after all, silver-gray and hard things are Iron. That's just common sense for us zombies! "Aluminium? What is that?"</color>

zombie_fields.source:
能踏破防线的庞然大物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>巨型</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫击退。攻击时碾压植物，并向前推动脚边的非boss僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A behemoth that can easily trample your defenses.

<color=black>Toughness: </color>6000
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Slow
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Giant zombie. Immune to knockback. When moving forward, crushes plants and pushes non-mini-boss zombies beside its feet forward.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>它在踩扁了一位研究员之后逃离了大象研究所，并找到了新的家。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black></color>

zombie_fields.source:
滚入植物群里，不断弹射造成损伤。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>100</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫蒜毒、定身、换行。在斜坡上加速。碰到植物时造成伤害，然后换行</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Rolls into the plant ranks, repeatedly bouncing and dealing damage.

<color=black>Toughness: </color>1350
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>100 (Non-bite)</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium Fast
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to poison and stuns. Gains speed on slopes. Damages plants on contact, then changes lanes.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>植物中流传着一个传说：在某些特殊的日子，被僵尸啃咬的坚果会逐渐变成渴望脑子的僵尸。经过植物们的验证，他们得到了两个消息。坏消息是，传说是真的；更坏的消息是，他们发射的豌豆没能消灭对方，反而让这些本来无法行动的僵尸遍地乱滚。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>A rumor circulates among plants: on certain special days, nuts bitten by zombies will gradually transform into brain-hungry zombies. After investigating, the plants received two pieces of news. The bad news: the rumor is true. The worse news: they failed to destroy them, and instead sent these once-immobile zombies rolling all over the battlefield.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
更强劲的僵尸保龄球。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>2700</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>200</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫蒜毒、定身、换行。在斜坡上加速。碰到植物时造成伤害，然后换行</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A stronger Zombie Bowling Ball.

<color=black>Toughness: </color>2700
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>200 (Non-bite)</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium Fast
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to poison and stuns. Gains speed on slopes. Damages plants on contact, then changes lanes.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>如果说谁最讨厌地刺，红眼僵尸保龄球一定榜上有名。看他泛红的眼睛就知道，他在地上滚动时，没少被地刺戳中眼睛。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>If there is one zombie who hates Spikeweed, Red-Eyed Zombie Bowling Ball is definitely among them. Just look at his bloodshot eyes — you can tell he has been poked in the eyes countless times by spikes while rolling across the ground.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
会撑杆跳的橄榄球员。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+1400（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>越过遇到的首个植物（会被高大植物阻挡），然后失去撑杆</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A Football zombie that also pole-vaults.

<color=black>Toughness: </color>720+1400 (Type 1)
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium Fast
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Vaults over the first Plant he encounters (blocked by Tall Plants), then loses his pole.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>没有谁知道撑杆橄榄球僵尸为什么要拿着撑杆参加橄榄球比赛，但根据他的解释，那似乎是因为他想要用撑杆躲开那匹穿着球衣的马。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>No one knows why Pole-Vaulting Football Zombie brings a pole to a football game, but according to him, it's because he wants to use it to jump over that horse wearing a jersey.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“滴滴……哔……滴滴”，失落的科技造物仍然巡逻在这片土地，守卫着文明的安眠。你看，他们来了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"Beep beep... boop... beep beep." The lost machines of an ancient civilization still patrol this land, guarding the slumber of a long-forgotten age. Look, here they come.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
绿色信号标示了坚韧的屏障。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>500+500（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>50（非啃咬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1。拥有失落机关的特点。拥有的屏障能提供400点护甲，并使本体免疫伤害。拥有绿色信号，被破坏时会眩晕4秒并失去屏障</color>
zombie_fields.english:
The green signal marks its sturdy barrier.

<color=black>Toughness: </color>500 + 500 (Type 2)
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>50 (Non-bite)</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Slow
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082> Inherits the traits of Lost Automaton. Its force shield provides 400 DR Value and makes the Automaton itself immune to damage. It has a green signal. When the signal is countered, it is stunned for 4s and loses its force shield.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>维持一个能量盾牌、相比较其他机关而言需要更多的能量，因此盾构型机关的充能舱也比其他机关更大一点，里面经常会有小雪兽嬉戏打闹。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Maintaining a force shield requires more power than most other automatons, so the Force Shield Automaton has a slightly larger charging chamber. Furlings can often be found playing and tumbling around inside.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
红色信号标示了锐利的臂刃。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>500+500（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>400（非啃咬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1。拥有失落机关的特点。拥有红色信号，被破坏时会眩晕4秒并失去臂刃</color>
zombie_fields.english:
The red signal marks its powerful vibroblade.

<color=black>Toughness: </color>500 + 500 (Type 2)
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>400 (Non-bite)</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Slow
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082> Inherits the traits of Lost Automaton. Its force shield provides 400 DR Value and makes the Automaton itself immune to damage. It has a red signal. When the signal is countered, it is stunned for 4s and loses its vibroblade.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>它捕捉到了远处的异响，红色的光芒自其残存的程序中亮起，劈砍已是它唯一保留的本能。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>It detected an unusual sound in the distance. A red glow lit up within its remaining programs, and slashing was the only instinct it had left.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
红色信号标示了无视地形的滑行能力。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>100（非啃咬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快，滑行时变为快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压（滑行时）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1。滑行出场。成功碾压植物后，场上立即出现暴风雪效果。拥有红色信号，被破坏时退出滑行并眩晕4秒</color>
zombie_fields.english:
The red signal marks its ability to glide across terrain without obstruction.

<color=black>Toughness: </color>1350
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>100 (Non-bite)</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium, fast when sliding
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082> Immune to Chill. Enters the field while gliding. Successfully crushing a plant immediately causes a Blizzard effect to appear on the field. It has a red signal. When the signal is countered, it stops gliding and is stunned for 4s.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>这个生物的诞生在企鹅文明内部引发了巨大的争议。大家都在争论：该把他视为同类中的一员，还是看作某种——比如说——科技与鸟类的结合体？又或者，他纯粹只是个机器人，因而根本不属于他们的社会？不过，有一点大家倒是达成了共识：这家伙看起来简直酷毙了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The creation of this creature sparked a major debate among penguin society. Should he be considered one of their own, or some kind of... say... fusion of technology and bird? Or perhaps he's simply a robot, and therefore has no place in their society at all? There is one thing everyone agrees on, though: this guy looks incredibly cool.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
绿色信号下迅速冲锋，信号失灵后躲入尸群等待恢复。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>快，信号损坏时变为中等</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>50（非啃咬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有绿色信号，被破坏时眩晕4秒，再过6秒后恢复信号，期间无视植物缓慢后撤</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Charges rapidly while its green signal is active, then hides among the zombie horde when the signal fails.

<color=black>Toughness: </color>1350
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>50 (Non-bite)</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Fast, medium when retreating
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082> Has a green signal. When the signal is countered, it is stunned for 4s. After another 6s, the signal is restored. During the restoration, it ignores plants and slowly retreats.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>在古文明衰落消亡之前，这种雪兽非常受雪原居民喜爱。人们往往会聚在一起，把它围在中间，以获得更好的移动信号。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Before the ancient civilisation declined and vanished, these mechanical Snowfurs were beloved by the inhabitants of the tundra. People would often gather around one, surrounding it to receive a stronger "mobile" signal.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
寄宿在冰块里的微小生物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>200</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>移动无视植物阻挡。难以被非低矮植物的子弹命中</color>
<color=#3D1400>破冰而出：</color><color=red>由敌方破坏冰块时，会生成雪蟹</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A tiny creature that lives inside blocks of ice.

<color=black>Toughness: </color>200
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium Fast
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Ignores plants when moving. Difficult to target due to its low height. When an Ice Block is destroyed by the enemy on the Snow Night map, a Snow Crab is spawned.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>雪蟹并不是传统意义上的螃蟹，它们以冰为居所，用抵御低温的绒毛代替了甲壳，偶尔还会与邻居交换适合自身大小的冰块。在雪原烹冰煮水时最好把它们挑出来，飘着绒毛的雪蟹汤可没有想象中那么好喝。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Snow Crabs aren't crabs in the traditional sense. They make their homes in ice and use insulating fuzz to keep out the cold instead of a shell. They even occasionally trade blocks of ice with their neighbours to find one that better fits their size. When boiling water or cooking with ice on the tundra, make sure to pick them out first. A pot of Snow Crab soup with fuzz floating in it isn't nearly as appetising as you might think.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>雪行鸟是一种非常狡猾的生物，它们出了名地喜欢捉弄它们见到的生物——比如偷走豌豆子弹、把僵尸困在某处，甚至劫持研究基地的机关设备。它们最恶作剧的一次是伪装成已经灭绝的样子；直到今天，究极Z教授还在为自己竟然被一群鸟给耍了而耿耿于怀。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Snowbeaks were once thought to be extinct, until a population was discovered living in the tundra. The discovery baffled researchers, who had no idea how the dodo's descendants had survived in such an inhospitable environment. It was eventually found that this unusual branch of dodo bird had somehow evolved the ability to photosynthesise, using its tail to absorb and store sunlight. Professor Cherryz was particularly fascinated by the discovery, though he still hasn't quite gotten over being fooled by their supposed extinction.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
红色信号标示了射击能力。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>500</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>50（非啃咬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1。发射白雪球攻击，每第三发子弹变为2倍攻击力的红色信号弹，无法被西瓜保护伞反弹。拥有红色信号，被破坏时眩晕4秒并失去射击能力</color>
<color=red>*信号弹被反弹后可破坏3×3范围的同色信号</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A red signal marks its shooting ability.

<color=black>Toughness: </color>500
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>50 (Non-bite)</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Slow
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082> Inherits the traits of Lost Automaton. Fires Snowballs at plants that freeze plants. Every third projectile becomes a Red Signal Projectile with 2× Attack that cannot be reflected by Umbrella Rind/Aegis Umbrella (can be reflected by Shield-shrooms), but does not freeze plants. It has a red signal. When the signal is countered, it is stunned for 4s and loses its shooting ability.</color>
<color=red>*Reflected Signal Projectiles can counter signals of the same color in a 3×3 area.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>远古智械的监督者，曾经常用于清除发生故障的其他智械，这套标记与清除的流程在几百年前十分稳定，而现在用于清除其他目标时也相当高效。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Once a supervisor of ancient intelligent machines, it was commonly used to identify and eliminate other automata that had malfunctioned. This mark-and-clear procedure was highly reliable hundreds of years ago, and it remains remarkably effective when used against other targets today.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
发射豌豆攻击你的植物。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>20</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每1.5秒发射一颗豌豆</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Shoots peas to attack your plants.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>20/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>豌豆射手僵尸远处的作战能力经常让植物闻风丧胆，但僵尸那边却人心惶惶，仅仅是以为在他前面作战的僵尸总是会以为他会在后面打到自己。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The ability of Peashooter Zombie to engage from a distance often frightens the plants. However, the real panic lies with the zombies, who fear that those fighting in front of him will be targeted from behind.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
发射粉樱桃攻击你的植物。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>40</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>500</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每1.5秒发射一颗粉樱桃</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Shoots cherry bullets to attack your plants.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>500</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>樱桃射手僵尸是一个17岁的高中生，脖子上顶着一个植物脑袋，他最喜欢的水果是樱桃，由于生在教皇世家，僵尸们称他为“绿色法皇。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Cherryshooter Zombie is a 17-year-old high school student with a plant head growing from his neck. His favorite fruit is cherries, and due to his papal family background, the zombies affectionately refer to him as the "Leaf King."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
发射爆炸樱桃攻击你的植物。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每6秒发射一颗爆炸樱桃</color>
<color=#3D1400>僵尸爆炸樱桃子弹：</color><color=red>对植物伤害1000，十字形无衰减溅射，坚果类（难度4及以下）和南瓜类可以防止产生溅射。对魅惑僵尸效果同植物的爆炸樱桃子弹</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Shoots explosive cherries to attack your plants.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>1000/6s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>超级樱桃射手僵尸刚刚听了The Runaways的歌曲《Cherry Bomb》，这或许就是他如此激情澎湃的原因吧。只是没人知道他是怎么学会用嘴来放烟花的。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Explode-o-shooter Zombie loves listening to "Cherry Bomb" by The Runaways, which might explain his fiery passion. However, no one knows how he learned to ignite fireworks with his mouth.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
就是一个会动的坚果。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+1100（一类）</color>
zombie_fields.english:
It's a moving nut.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 1100 (Type 1)</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>坚果僵尸在被植物攻击后头上并没有一个个的弹坑，反而是被啃咬的痕迹，接受采访的坚果僵尸如是的说道：“可能是我的战友们饿了吧。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Following an assault by the plants, Wall-nut Zombie displayed bite marks on his head instead of bullet holes. When interviewed, he said, "Perhaps my comrades were simply hungry."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
因为阅读被打断而十分愤怒，吐出大量爆炸樱桃。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1500+200（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有读报僵尸的特点。失去报纸后，每0.75秒发射1颗爆炸樱桃子弹</color>
<color=#3D1400>僵尸爆炸樱桃子弹：</color><color=red>对植物伤害1000，十字形无衰减溅射，坚果类（难度4及以下）和南瓜类可以防止产生溅射。对魅惑僵尸效果同植物的爆炸樱桃子弹</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Goes into an explosive cherry barrage when his newspaper is broken.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>1000 (explosive cherries)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1500 + 200 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Becomes temporarily invincible after its newspaper's broken, then proceeds to shoot explosive cherries every 0.75s.</color>
<color=black>Explosion Range: </color><color=#4B0082>Cross Splash, can be absorbed by Wall-nuts and Pumpkins at Difficulty 4 or lower.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>樱桃读报僵尸最喜欢的水果是樱桃，就连他的报纸都是樱桃口味的，而他手中的报纸也是唯一能抑制他的暴怒的东西。樱桃读报僵尸总是在读报纸时吃樱桃，而在读完报纸之后他会上演一场川剧变脸，随后把之前吃掉的樱桃都吐出去。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>This zombie's favorite fruit is cherries, and even his newspaper is cherry-flavored. The newspaper he holds is the only thing that can temper his rage.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
盒子里面是什么呢，应该没人知道。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+370（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防具损坏或本体死亡时退场，召唤随机的非究极僵尸，血量随机为0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8/1/1.2倍。防具损坏时有1%概率开出随机词条，然后冷却60秒，盲盒类僵尸共用冷却</color>
zombie_fields.english:
No one knows what's hiding inside the box.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 370 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> After the box falls off, spawns a random non-Odyssey zombie with 20/40/60/80/100/120% of the original zombie's Toughness.
<color=black>•</color> There is a 1% chance that a random Odyssey Modifier will drop when its box is dropped, up to 1 per minute.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
铁桶坚果也能动起来？

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+2200（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防具被磁力菇吸引后死亡。被击杀时掉落铁桶</color>
zombie_fields.english:
It's a moving Buck-nut.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 2200 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Drops a Bucket when killed by projectiles.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>为什么铁桶坚果僵尸的头这么铁？其实是因为大家都说吃核桃补脑，但是他没注意到他吃的核桃含铁量太高。不过情况也许没那么糟，至少现在他练成了铁头功。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Why is Buck-nut Zombie's head made of iron? It's because everyone said that eating walnuts nourishes the brain, but he didn't realize that the walnuts he consumed were packed with too much iron. However, it might not be so bad—at least now he has developed an iron head.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
喜欢吃爆浆樱桃，已经吃习惯了。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+1100（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>受到所有的樱桃爆炸伤害减半</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Has a slight resistance against explosive bullets.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 1100 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Takes 150 maximum damage from Cherry Bombs, and receives half the damage from explosive cherry projectiles.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>真男人从不回头看爆炸，至少樱桃坚果僵尸就从不回头，因为它一般都是用脸接炸弹的。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Real men never turn around to watch explosions, and Cherry-nut Zombie certainly fits the bill, as he often catches bombs with his face.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
发射高伤害的铁豌豆子弹。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>80</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>被击杀时掉落铁桶。每1.5秒发射一颗铁豌豆，会击退魅惑僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Fires high-damaging bullets.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>80/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Fires iron peas at your defense, which can knock back hypnotized zombies. Drops a Bucket when killed by projectiles.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>铁桶豌豆僵尸去年抽了塔罗牌，他的塔罗牌的暗示是「The Emperor」，从那之后他就发现自己可以随随便便射出铁子弹了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Last year, Buckshooter Zombie drew a tarot card that read "The Emperor." Since then, he has been able to shoot iron peas at will.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
相当抗打的橄榄高坚果僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+4400（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防具被磁力菇吸引后死亡，被击杀时掉落橄榄帽</color>
zombie_fields.english:
High-armor zombie that can also run very fast.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 4400 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Drops a Football Helmet when killed by projectiles.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>橄榄高坚果僵尸原本只是一只普通的橄榄球僵尸，直到有一天他一头创在了正在撒肥料的坚果身上。
“我也不知道怎么回事这家伙还就长我头上了，闷死我了要……”橄榄高坚果僵尸如是说道。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Football-nut Zombie was once just an ordinary Football Zombie, until one day he collided with a nut that was spreading fertilizer. "I don't know how this guy ended up on my head; it's suffocating me!" lamented Football-nut Zombie.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
金色的盲盒，里面也许有更加神秘的东西？

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+720（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防具损坏或本体死亡时退场，召唤随机的满血非究极僵尸。防具损坏时有1%概率开出随机词条，然后该效果冷却60秒，盲盒类僵尸共用冷却</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A golden one!? I wonder what's inside this Mystery-box...

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 720 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>After the box falls off, spawns a random non-Odyssey zombie with full Toughness. Also has a chance to unlock an Odyssey Modifier when defeated, up to 1 per minute.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
无惧严寒，但辣椒火焰是其弱点。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+2200（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1。免疫寒冰菇效果。受到的火爆辣椒效果会转化为1/3倍韧性的真实伤害</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A sturdy zombie that can also nullify the Chill effect from ice projectiles.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 2200 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to chill and freeze. Receives true damage equal to 1/3 of his max HP when affected by a Jalapeno.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>关于寒冰高坚果僵尸的脑袋，僵尸界众说纷纭，有人认为他是为了隔绝这个冷漠的世界，也有人认为这涉及埃德加博士的疯狂实验。但只有他自己知道，这个头套在他吃下某个蓝色蘑菇之后就出现在自己头上。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Frost-nut Zombie's head has sparked numerous opinions in the zombie world. Some say he aims to distance himself from the cold world, while others suspect it relates to Dr. Edgar's wild experiments. Yet, only he knows that this headgear appeared after he ate a specific blue mushroom.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
投出爆炸樱桃炸毁你的防线！

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>60/3秒，1000/3秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>向本行最左侧的植物投掷子弹，前5次为篮球，后20次为爆炸樱桃，叶子保护伞弹开爆炸樱桃时受到100伤害。全部投完后前进</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Throws explosive basketballs to destroy your defenses!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>60/3s (basketballs), 1000/3s (explosive cherry basketballs)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Throws 5 basketballs, then launches explosive cherry basketballs (has 20 in total). Explosions deal 100 damage to Umbrella plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>哦，完美，这下捂着脑袋也不管用了，在他的篮球用完前你还是快跑吧。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Warning: If you see him running low on basketballs, it's already too late! His explosive shots aren’t just for scoring points—they’re for total chaos! Better start running!</color>

zombie_fields.source:
骑乘红鲸越过三个植物，自身还能发射豌豆。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>20</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极快，失去红鲸后变为慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有白鲸骑士的特点。每0.75秒发射1颗豌豆</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A variant of the Beluga Rider Yeti!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>20/0.75s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Shoots peas at your plants before and after jumping.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“你相较于白海豚什么特别的点呢？”豌豆红鲸骑士总回答道“我比较喜欢玩《回旋镖》”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>When asked what sets him apart from the Beluga Rider Yeti, Pea Rider simply shrugs and grins. "Oh, nothing much. I just really, really love playing Boomerang."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
全副武装的铁豌豆射手僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>80</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350+1100（一类）+1100（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每1.5秒发射一颗铁豌豆，会击退魅惑僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Buckshooter Zombie has acquired some new equipment: a bucket and a screen door!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>80/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350 + 1100 (Type 1) + 1100 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Constantly shoots iron peas at your plants whilst having decent defense. These can knock back hypnotized zombies.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>戴上坚固的铁制帽子，拿上定制的不锈钢门，铁豆僵尸把自己全身上下都武装了起来。现在，他很有信心击败面前的植物——一个平平无奇的大嘴花。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Screen Door Buckshooter Zombie loves piling on layers of iron gear, much to the confusion of his fellow zombies. "If Magnet-shrooms can yank off our helmets, why not just wear MORE metal?" he reasoned. His logic seemed sound—until he met the Magnet Blover and learned that sometimes, less is more.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
能压扁身边的植物！

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>500</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>接触植物时，头部脱离身体（死亡），压扁一格非飞行植物。受到僵尸火爆辣椒效果时变为火爆窝瓜僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Crushes the first plant nearby and dies.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>500</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Crushes the first non-flying plants it encounters. Converts to a Spicy Squash Zombie when affected by the explosion of a Jalapeno Zombie.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“嗯？嗯！”窝瓜僵尸们总是奋不顾身的向前冲去并且压扁前方的植物，众僵尸都为他们的牺牲精神感动。但真实情况是，窝瓜僵尸们是猫瓜的粉丝，而他们看到猫瓜压扁火红莲的样子便忍不住想试试压扁其他植物。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"Hmm? Hmm!" That’s all the warning you get before the Squash Zombies charge forward, flattening everything in their path. Other zombies admire their dedication, mistaking it for selfless bravery. In truth, they’re just die-hard fans of Nyan Squash—and after watching her crush the Endoflame, they couldn’t resist copying their idol.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
能砸扁身边的植物并释放僵尸火爆辣椒效果！

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1500</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>彩蛋僵尸。接触植物时，头部脱离身体（死亡），压扁一格非飞行植物并释放僵尸火爆辣椒效果，处于寒冷状态下则不会释放</color>
<color=#3D1400>僵尸火爆辣椒：</color><color=red>秒杀本行所有植物（100万伤害），不会伤害魅惑僵尸，不会清除冰道</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Leaps and destroys a whole lane of plants!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1500</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Crushes the non-flying first plants it encounters and sets the whole lane on fire, destroying all plants affected. Does not set fire if chilled. Does not damage hypnotized zombies or clear ice trails.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>火爆窝瓜僵尸是僵尸中的急性子，他登场时第一步是什么呢？ 当然是撞开其他僵尸！ 原本他想站在显眼的位置大喊“烈火燎原，寸草无生！”，下一步才是把头甩出去，可惜他的头比他还急。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>No zombie is as hot-headed as Spicy Squash Zombie—literally. The second he stomps onto the scene, he shoves others aside, ready to stand tall and declare, "Ashes to ashes!" Unfortunately, his head had other plans… and launched itself off before he could finish.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
一段时间后释放火焰烧掉一整排的植物！

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>500</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>有概率释放僵尸火爆辣椒效果</color>
<color=#3D1400>僵尸火爆辣椒：</color><color=red>秒杀本行所有植物（100万伤害），不会伤害魅惑僵尸，不会清除冰道</color>
zombie_fields.english:
This zombie explodes and destroys a whole lane of plants after a while.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>500</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Explodes and destroys a whole lane of plants after a while (1M Damage). Does not damage hypnotized zombies or clear ice trails.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>辣椒僵尸渴望其他僵尸和他交流，然而没一个僵尸愿意跟这个一不小心就火大的催泪弹说话。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>With a fiery leap, Jalapeno Zombie cannonballs into the pool, sizzling on impact. The other zombies groan. "Fantastic. Now we're marinating in spicy broth."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
持续发射大量豌豆攻击你的植物！

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+1400（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每0.1秒发射一颗豌豆</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Unleashes a relentless barrage of peas at your defenses!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>20/0.1s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 1400 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Constantly shoots volleys of peas at your plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“呼…呼……”机枪橄榄结束了一天的晨跑，回到家中补充豌豆电解质，而这却让跟在他身后的僵尸苦不堪言。“本来晨跑跑不过他也就算了，还要接一脸的豌豆，这有理吗？”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>They say fate is unpredictable, and Pea Commando Zombie would have to agree. One second, he's in a vegetarian batting cage. The next? He's accidentally ingested a high-powered pitching machine. Now, his new un-life is just one endless round of rapid-fire peas.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
装备了铁气球装置的铁豌豆射手僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>80</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350+500（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行（持有气球）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>飞行时，本体不会受到伤害且免疫三叶草效果。每1.5秒发射一颗铁豌豆，可击退魅惑僵尸。死亡时掉落铁桶</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Buckshooter Zombie hanging from a rotor.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>80/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350 + 500 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color><color=#4B0082>Medium Fast</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to Blover. Fires iron peas at your defense, these can knock back hypnotized zombies. </color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>面对僵尸们的质疑，铁桶豌豆气球僵尸企图用僵尸集体照来证明自己的元老身份。“可是”，众僵尸说，“你在哪儿呢？”他拿着黑白胶片，也疑惑着。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Faced with doubts from fellow zombies, Buckshoot-copter tried to prove his veteran status with an old group photo. "But… where are you in this?" they asked. He stared at the black-and-white film, just as puzzled.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
一段时间后产生爆炸，摧毁一定范围的植物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>入场一段时间后自爆，释放3×3范围的僵尸毁灭菇爆炸，造成1800点伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>毁灭坚果</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Doom-shroom zombie? Aw man!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Self-destructs after a while and creates a Doom-shroom explosion that deals 1800 damage to plants in a 3×3 area.
<color=black>Weakness: </color><color=#4B0082>Doom-nut</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>僵尸受够了被毁灭菇炸成灰的日子，如今他们终于制造了核反击的武器，让植物们吃点苦头。虽然僵尸的身体只能承受三分之一的毁灭力量，但是总比没有强，不是吗？
</color>
zombie_fields.english:
<align=left><color=black>The zombies have had enough of being blown to ashes by Doom explosions. Now they've finally built a nuclear counterattack weapon to make the plants suffer for a change. Although a zombie's body can only carry a third of the Doom-shroom's full payload, it's still better than nothing, right?

- Written by Mr. Etc.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
头戴的盲盒隐藏了巨人僵尸的眼睛颜色。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000+1100（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>巨型</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>盲盒破碎后随机出现一个巨人僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Who knows what's waiting for us under that paper mask?

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000 + 1100 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Giant zombie. Smashes plants and turns into a random Gargantuar when his mask is destroyed.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>想找到一个让巨人顺利套在头上的纸袋子可不容易，毕竟巨人连小心翼翼地拿起纸袋都很难做到，不过作为一个巨人，蛮力谁都有，相比之下精准更为重要，因此这个纸袋便成了精英们的象征，直到某一天，巨人学会了让小鬼帮忙。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Mystery Gargantuar stumbles with a box on his head, maybe to keep you guessing, or maybe to shield his rare, patchwork eyes from the world. Whatever's inside, it's a mystery wrapped in a smash waiting to happen.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
行动迅捷且擅长突进的巨人僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>巨型</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>攻击速度、移动速度和投掷小鬼的速度均为普通巨人僵尸的2倍</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Fast-moving Gargantuar.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Giant zombie. Has ×2 the attack speed, movement speed and throwing speed of a regular Gargantuar.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>蓝眼巨人僵尸永远为了新鲜的脑子冲在最前。因为他的杰出战绩，埃德加博士曾亲自为他颁发二级墓碑勋章。可惜作为一名优秀的战士，他永远没有参加僵尸阅兵式的机会，因为他的步调总是和其他僵尸不一致。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Turbo Gargantuar is always at the forefront in pursuit of fresh brains. Thanks to his outstanding record, Dr. Zomboss once personally awarded him the Second-Class Tombstone Medal. Sadly, as an exemplary warrior, he never gets to join the zombie parade, as his stride just never matches the others.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
砸扁植物时，从其遗体中生息出小鬼僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>巨型</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>锤击每成功秒杀一个植物，生成1个小鬼僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Gargantuar that summons Imps with every smash.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Giant zombie. Every time he successfully smashes a plant, an Imp is summoned.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>绿眼巨人僵尸挥起电线杆，地下的小鬼们蜂拥而上。这些小鬼为召唤师巨人的生活增添了许多乐趣，也带来了烦恼——特别是他刚刚把核桃砸开的时候。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Shepherd Gargantuar swings his power pole, and Imps swarm out from under the ground. These little troublemakers bring plenty of fun, but headaches, too, to their master's life… especially right after he's cracked open a Wall-nut.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
重伤时，将背上潜伏的大量小鬼僵尸一并散射而出。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>巨型</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>血量低于50%时，一次扔出5个小鬼僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Gargantuar with more Imps hiding on his back.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Giant zombie. Throws 5 Imps at once.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>黄眼巨人僵尸在进攻花园前，是高杆绣球满分选手，“我的五个绣球都能完美的穿过圆环！”由于习惯，黄眼巨人僵尸还是更喜欢背着五个小鬼僵尸，时刻准备再创纪录。
</color>
zombie_fields.english:
<align=left><color=black>Volley Gargantuar is a descendant of the Sloth Gargantuar from the Frostbite Caves. Those before him have thrown different things, from throwing Jack-in-the-box Zombies to throwing other Gargantuars. He thought he should go back to the roots and throw more Imps, 5 to be exact, a testament to his lineage.

-Written by Medineer Gaming</color>

zombie_fields.source:
皮实肉厚的跑酷爱好者，找到状态后，变向加速冲刺。
<color=blue>笑笑苏联动僵尸，砸罐子/随机模式专属</color>

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>9527</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>血量低于2/3时，速度提升至3倍并立即换行</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A tough, smug parkour enthusiast who, once locked in, swerves and sprints with a burst of speed.

<color=blue>Xiaoxiaosu Collab Zombie, exclusive to Vasebreaker and Gacha Modes</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>9527</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Switches lanes and speeds up by 3× when HP drops to 2/3.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>他因为炫酷的动作和精湛的技艺闻名于世，但这些对他来说完全不重要，毕竟只有人类才会有因为名声和技艺就称叔称爷的习惯，关他这个僵尸什么事？
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>He's world-famous for his flashy moves and masterful skills, but none of that matters to him. After all, only humans care about handing out fancy titles for fame and talent. What's that got to do with a zombie?</color>

zombie_fields.source:
无惧烈焰，但冰菇之寒是其弱点。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+2200（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢，逐渐加快至中等</color>
<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>100</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫红温。免疫火爆辣椒效果。受到的寒冰菇效果会转化为1/3倍韧性的真实伤害。移速会随着行动时间而增加，最多增加至初始移速的2倍</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Unafraid of the trials of fire, but particularly vulnerable to the cold.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>100</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 2200 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to enflamed debuff and Jalapeno effects. Receives true damage equal to 1/3 of his max HP when affected by an Ice-shroom. Movement speed increases over time after appearance, up to 2× its initial speed.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>火焰高坚果僵尸怒气冲冲，这并非是他脾气暴躁或者参加了吃辣椒比赛，而是他和他的兄弟寒冰高坚果僵尸发生了分歧。他的兄弟喜欢生吃冰冷的蘑菇，而他认为蘑菇需要烤熟了再吃。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Flame Tall-nut Zombie is seething with rage, not because he has a bad temper or entered a chili-eating contest, but because he's had a falling-out with his brother, Frost Tall-nut Zombie. His brother prefers to eat mushrooms raw and frozen, while he insists mushrooms should be properly grilled before eating.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
冰火交融使其坚硬无比，但辣椒和寒冰菇仍是其弱点。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1500+4500（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>200</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫红温、寒冷、冻结。拥有900点护甲。受到的寒冰菇效果和火爆辣椒效果会转化为1/3倍韧性的真实伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合要素及场景：</color><color=red>寒冰高坚果僵尸+火焰高坚果僵尸。两者位于同一格时会产生融合</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Forged by ice and fire into extreme hardness, but Jalapenos and Ice-shrooms remain his weakness.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>200</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1500 + 4500 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to chill, freeze and enflamed. Has an innate DR value of 900. Receives true damage equal to 1/3 of his max HP when affected by an Ice-shroom or a Jalapeno. When a Frost Tall-nut Zombie and a Flame Tall-nut Zombie are in the same tile, they fuse into an Obsidian Tall-nut Zombie.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>经过冰霜与火焰的淬炼，黑曜石高坚果僵尸的头变得坚不可摧！
……当然，前提是温度变化不要太快。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Tempered by both frost and flame, Obsidian Tall-nut Zombie's head has become nearly indestructible!…That is, as long as the temperature doesn't change too quickly.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
定期消耗你的阳光。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+1100（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每行动15秒，扣除25阳光</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Periodically drains your sun.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 1100 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Drains 25 Sun from the player every 15s not stunned or frozen.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>不同于其他僵尸，阳光坚果僵尸只需要晒晒太阳就能够满足自己绝大部分的生理需求，至于阳光坚果僵尸为什么还要像其他僵尸那样狂热地追求大脑，大概是因为食脑对于僵尸的意义远大于正常的生理需求吧。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Unlike other zombies, Solar-nut Zombie can satisfy most of its physiological needs simply by basking in sunlight. As for why it still obsessively chases brains like every other zombie - perhaps the craving for brains means far more to zombies than ordinary survival needs ever could.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
消耗你的阳光来限制受到的伤害。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+1100（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫灰烬斩杀。每行动15秒，扣除25阳光。受伤时，免疫该伤害，固定受伤20并扣除5阳光</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合要素及场景：</color><color=red>阳光坚果僵尸+坚果僵尸。两者位于同一格时会产生融合</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Consumes your sun to reduce incoming damage.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 1100 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Drains 25 Sun from the player every 15s not stunned or frozen. When taking damage, negates that damage and instead takes a fixed 20 damage while draining 5 Sun from the player. When a Wall-nut Zombie and a Solar-nut Zombie are in the same tile, they fuse into a Twin Solar-nut Zombie.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>比起周围的同伴，阳光帝果僵尸拥有更加华丽的长相、更加坚硬的头颅、更加强大的能力，这一切都让他鹤立鸡群。但最让他骄傲、并且帮他夺得了“墓碑节最特殊僵尸”奖项的优点的是，他有四只眼睛。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Compared to his peers, Twin Solar-nut Zombie boasts a more splendid appearance, a harder head, and far greater power, standing head and shoulders above the rest. But the trait he's most proud of, and the one that earned him the "Most Unique Zombie" award at Tombstone Festival, is this: he has four eyes.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
发射多发豌豆攻击你的植物。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>20</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>500</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每1.5秒发射四颗豌豆</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Fires multiple peas at your plants.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>20×4/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>500</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>他的强大火力让他在任何时候，都能用最帅气的姿态迎接挑战。不管你承不承认，这已经是他在僵尸们面前的标签了。在公共场合，大家最先记起的不是他的名字，而是“那个带着奇怪头套的家伙”，这难免让他有些受伤。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>His overwhelming firepower lets him face any challenge in the coolest way possible. Whether you admit it or not, that's become his defining trait among zombies. In public, people don't even remember his name, just "that guy with the weird headgear," which honestly stings a bit.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
发射多发寒冰豌豆冻结你的植物。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>20</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>500</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每1.5秒发射四颗寒冰豌豆。有概率对植物施加攻击冻结，对冻结的植物伤害×4</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Fires multiple Snow peas at your plants and freezes them.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>20×4/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>500</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Has a chance to freeze plants; deals 4× damage to frozen plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>寒冰机枪射手僵尸非常怕冷，他裹上了厚厚的棉袄，一刻不停地把体内的寒气包裹在豌豆上发射出去，甚至拒绝食用低于20摄氏度的脑子，但是依然被冻得浑身发抖。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The Gatling Snow Zombie is extremely sensitive to cold. He bundles up in thick clothing and constantly fires the chill inside him out through his peas. He even refuses to eat brains below 20°C, yet he's still shivering non-stop.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
以绝对的防御力在场上闲庭信步，离场时会留下礼物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>160000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫伤害。出场一段时间后逃跑，处于地图左半场时立即逃跑。被魅惑后伤害×10，血量降低至1%且失去免疫伤害的能力。死亡时，有75%概率掉落惊喜礼盒卡牌，否则掉落模仿者卡牌</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Wanders across the battlefield with absolute defense, leaving behind a gift when it departs.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>160000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to damage. Runs away after being on the field for a period of time, and immediately flees on reaching the left half of the lawn. When hypnotized, damage ×10, health is reduced to 1%, and loses invincibility. Upon death, has a 75% chance to drop a Plant Giftbox; otherwise drops an Imitater.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>不朽高坚果雪人僵尸很后悔自己当初的好奇心，他只是顺手把这颗高坚果戴在头上，却再也摘不下来，现在他永远只能透过高坚果看世界。雪上加霜的是，这株高坚果的眼睛是闭上的。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Bedrock Tall-nut Yeti deeply regrets his curiosity back then. He only put this Tall-Nut on his head for fun, but it became impossible to remove. Now he can only see the world through the Tall-Nut forever. As if that wasn't bad enough, this Tall-Nut's eyes are closed.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
根据压到的植物数量，召唤窝瓜类僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1500</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>接触植物时，头部脱离身体（死亡），压扁一格非飞行植物，然后根据该格植物数量，在该格：生成同等数量的窝瓜僵尸（最多3个）；若数量不小于3，再生成1个火爆窝瓜僵尸；若数量为0，则会满血复活</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Summons Squash Zombies based on the number of plants crushed.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1500</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>When she encounters a plant, her head detaches from her body and crushes all non-flying plants in the tile. She then summons Squash Zombies in that tile equal to the number of Plants there (up to 3) and dies. If there are 3 or more Plants, she also summons one Spicy Squash Zombie. If she fails to squash any plant, she revives at full HP.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>植物僵尸和他们对应的植物往往关系很僵，但猫瓜僵尸和猫瓜的关系相当好。她们经常一起聊天、一起唱歌、一起买新的装扮。有的时候，她还会帮猫瓜寻找草坪上的火红莲。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Zombotanies and their corresponding plants often have a rather strained relationship, but Nyan Squash Zombie and Nyan Squash get along remarkably well. They often chat, sing, and shop for new outfits together. Sometimes, she even helps Nyan Squash with hunting for Endoflames to squash on the lawn.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
机鱼公司研发的水面大杀器。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>激流勇进：机械海豚和超级机械海豚移速翻倍</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>复合装甲：机械海豚和超级机械海豚减伤50%</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Gfishtus Corps proudly presents...

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Charges at a fast speed through your pool defenses, instantly crushing plants that are not immune to it, dealing 500 Damage to anti-crush plants.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Zombarines and Sharkmarines now have double the movement speed
2.  Zombarines and Sharkmarines now gain a 50% Damage reduction</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“优秀的潜水员不应止于潜水，还要会驾驶超级潜艇！”超级机械海豚驾驶员说着便将潜艇的马力加快了一档。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"An excellent diver should not only be able to dive but also drive a super submarine!" declared Sharkmarine Zombie as he increased the submarine's horsepower by one gear.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
驾驶特制雪橇冰车的舞王僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>12000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有雪橇冰车僵尸的特点。死亡时始终生成雪橇车、舞王、雪橇冰车僵尸各1个</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>火爆辣椒、地刺</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>巡游车队：每轮都会出现舞王冰车，且死亡时额外召唤1个舞王指挥官</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>风驰电掣：舞王冰车和舞台巡演车速度x5</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Extremely high defense and immunity to slow.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>12000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Upon death, automatically spawns a Michael Zombie, Zomboni, and Bobsled Zomboni.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Michael Zomboni now appears in every wave and spawns an extra Superstar Zombie on death
2.  Michael Zombonis and Jackson Worldwides have their movement speed ×5</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>舞王冰车上其实不止一只僵尸，它们是一个团队，冰车僵尸制造场地，雪橇车僵尸提供出场效果，至于舞王僵尸嘛…它因为没有驾驶证所以被迫下车，迎接他那狂热的植物粉丝们，不过他们的豌豆似乎有些太过热情了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Michael Zomboni isn't just a one-zombie act—it takes a whole team to put on the show! Zomboni preps the stage, Bobsled Zombie brings the flashy visuals, and Michael Zombie? Well, he had to step out of the car since he technically didn't have a driver's license. He wanted to greet his adoring plant fans, but... the peas looked a little too enthusiastic.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>超级三叉戟僵尸是名渔夫，他抛出的四支三叉戟精准无比，因此成为了渔王。“其实我之前还兼职过标枪运动员来着……”超级三叉戟僵尸如是说到。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Giga Trident-nut Zombie is a skilled fisherman known for his exceptional accuracy with the four tridents he throws, earning him the title of the king of fishermen. "In fact, I used to be a part-time javelin thrower..." Giga Trident-nut Zombie admitted.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
专注阅读的博学者，极度危险，请勿打扰。

<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>400</color>
<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1500+1500（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有学者僵尸的特点。失去报纸后，每0.5秒发射4颗爆炸樱桃子弹</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>势不可挡：失去报纸后移动无视植物阻挡</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>怒不可遏：免疫状态异常</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Deals immense damage.

<color=black>Damage:</color><color=#4B0082>400 (biting) 1000 (cherries)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1500 + 1500 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Invulnerable until his newspaper is destroyed. Becomes temporarily invincible after its newspaper's broken, and proceeds to shoot 4 explosive cherries every 0.5s.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Now ignores plants when enraged
2. Now immune to status effects</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“老了老了……” 樱桃机枪读报僵尸念叨着走在路上，而他身上的威压即使封锁千万，那残留的一丝亦压的场上的植物与僵尸抬不起头。“也就那家伙还能让我有战斗的欲望了……”收起报纸，走在街道，不自喃喃……
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"I'm getting old..." Gatling Cherry Newspaper Zombie lamented while walking through the street. Despite containing his pressure, it was enough to keep both plants and zombies down. "Only that guy can still inspire me to fight..." he muttered as he put away the newspaper and ambled on.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
黑夜中潜藏的无畏冲锋者，一个杀戮机器。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>100</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000+12000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>伤情恶化：黑橄榄或将军啃咬时使植物失去回血能力，持续1秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>深度创伤：黑橄榄或将军啃咬时使植物受到3倍伤害，持续1秒</color>
zombie_fields.english:
An old friend? Maybe, perhaps we have met him before.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>100</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000 + 12000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Plants bitten by Giga Football-nut Zombies and Giga Football Strikers cannot regenerate HP for 1 second
2. Plants bitten by Giga Football-nut Zombies and Giga Football Strikers receive triple the damage for 1 second</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>从黑暗中走出的黑橄榄高坚果僵尸，强大、冷酷、邪恶，并且拒绝分享他强大的秘诀，自称只有在最黑暗的黑暗中才能造就他这样的强者。
“我的油漆哪儿去了?”埃德加博士疑惑地看着自己的实验室。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Stepping out of the shadows, the Giga Football-nut Zombie radiates power, coldness, and a sinister vibe. He adamantly keeps the secret of his strength to himself, asserting that only the darkest darkness can create a being as formidable as he. "Where is my paint?" Dr. Edgar asked, looking perplexed in his laboratory.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
机鱼公司研发的空中母舰。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每3秒召唤一个迷你基洛夫作战。被磁力仙人掌、究极杨桃大帝子弹击中20次后坠机</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>防风引擎升级：飞艇、基洛夫飞艇和裂空机甲免疫三叶草效果，飞艇和基洛夫飞艇移速x5</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>钢铁蜂群：迷你基洛夫血量提升至25000</color>
zombie_fields.english:
An aircraft carrier being developed by Gfishtus Corps.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Summons a Kirov Drone into action every 3s. Crashes if hit 20 times with Magnet Cactus or Magnetar projectiles.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Zomppelins and Kirov Zomppelins now have their movement speed ×5 and become immune to Blovers
2. Each Kirov Drone Toughness increased to 25k</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>一个巨大的飞行物？不了！而是一个巨大的飞艇，不仅有着更坚硬的外壳。而且似乎有着释放战斗机群的能力。不过飞艇在被击毁后仍然容易伤害周围的任何生物，这使得其他僵尸都不愿意靠飞艇太近，生怕飞艇一个坠机把自己送到极乐世界……
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Was that a huge flying object? No, it was actually a gigantic airship, featuring a sturdy shell and the ability to release a squadron of fighters. Even when destroyed, the airship could still wreak havoc on surrounding creatures, causing other zombies to keep their distance, fearing that a crash might send them to their demise.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
小型轰炸机，向植物扔下小玩偶匣！

<color=#3D1400>炸弹伤害：</color><color=red>500</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>500</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫寒冷和三叶草效果。每3秒向下方植物扔下炸弹，造成玩偶匣爆炸伤害。被磁力仙人掌、究极杨桃大帝子弹击中3次后坠机</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Kirov drones fly faster, releasing bombs over the plants they fly over.

<color=black>Bomb Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>500</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>500</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to chill and Blovers. Drops Jack-in-the-Box Bombs to the plants directly below every 3s. Crashes if hit 3 times with Magnet Cactus or Magnetar projectiles.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>这不是一般的飞机，这是经过注水压缩后的特殊飞机。虽然不知道采取什么方式将其压缩，但在战场上的实力也不逊色于一般轰炸机。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>This is no ordinary aircraft; it is a special plane that has been compressed through water pressure. While the exact method of compression remains a mystery, its battlefield strength rivals that of conventional bombers.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
经典的白色西装，极速的太空滑步。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出场3秒内滑步进场，期间减伤90%，抵达第五列右侧或被植物阻挡时结束。随后召唤4个舞王撑杆僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>迅捷恶魔：改为召唤白色撑杆舞王</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>幽灵舞步：舞王和舞王指挥官滑步进场时无视植物阻挡</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>黄油保护伞</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A fast-moving zombie that slides into your defense, a tough opponent to face.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Slips into the battlefield, reduces damage by 90% while sliding, then summons 4 Dancing Pole Vaulters.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Michael Zombies and Superstar Zombies now ignore plants when entering the lawn
2. Now summons 4 Super Dancing Pole Vaulters instead</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>作为僵尸偶像界的一代天王，舞王指挥官一直对自己要求很严格。完成埃德加舞蹈学院的进修后，他受益匪浅。其中他最得意的就是他新掌握的超级太空步，被评为“僵尸界的第六大奇迹”，为他圈粉无数。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Superstar Zombie, a legendary idol in the zombie world, has extremely high standards for himself. After completing his studies at Edgar's Dance Academy, he mastered the Super Moonwalk, which was named "The Sixth Wonder of the Zombie World," earning him a large fanbase.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
沉睡千年的大人物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>500（非啃咬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每8~14秒，无视植物突进2格，对穿过的植物造成500伤害，首次突进间隔减半。死亡后造成500玩偶匣爆炸伤害。不会伤害南瓜中的植物</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>煞气爆发：死亡时的爆炸改为造成物理伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>猛鬼追魂：普通攻击伤害x3，突进间隔降为1/3</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A wraith from a thousand years ago, with immense strength.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>500</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Every 8~14s, dashes forward 2 tiles, dealing 500 damage to plants in its path (first dash is ×2 faster). Upon death, deals 500 Jack-in-the-Box explosion damage to plants in a 3×3 area, excluding Pumpkin-protected plants.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. On-death explosion now deals physical damage (cannot be immunitized against)
2. Dash CD reduced to 1/3, base attack damage x3</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>此乃东方一千年之骸，长七八尺，锦缎披垂，出入有光。经雷击不死，力大如熊，不喜嗜脑，曾隐于山野，现云游世间，偏安一隅之地，只求一方之魂安宁。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>This monster survived the harshest conditions and possesses enormous strength. It avoids brains and roams the world in search of a secluded place.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
跳杆里藏着一触即发的炸弹。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+4400（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有瓜跳僵尸的特点。被击杀时，若持有跳杆则自爆变成小丑王僵尸并释放玩偶匣爆炸。在水路生成时变为小丑爆破王</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>在劫难逃：死亡时必定自爆，瓜跳僵尸和小丑跳跳王大跳蓄力时间降为0.5秒；小丑爆破王的炸弹伤害+500</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>连环爆炸：所有的玩偶匣爆炸会将小丑王和小丑僵尸变为小丑跳跳王；小丑爆破王的炸弹伤害+500</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>保护伞融合植物、磁力菇王</color>
zombie_fields.english:
The bomb is hidden in his pogo stick.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720 + 4400 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Inherits traits from Melon Pogo Zombie. If he dies while holding his pogo stick, he'll explode and transform into a King Jack-in-the-Box Zombie.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. On-death explosion is now guaranteed | Melon Pogo Zombies and Clown-on-the-Pogo Zombies have their charge time reduced to 0.5s
2. Jack-in-the-Box Zombies affected by the explosion will turn into Clown-on-the-Pogo Zombies
<color=black>Weakness: </color>Umbrella fusions</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>其实我的装扮只是想追寻潮流。在谈论到自己很酷的外形时，小丑跳跳王总是耸耸肩。但大家都知道，他曾有一段刻苦铭心的恋爱史。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"What, this? Just fashion, my friend," Clown-on-the-Pogo Zombie smirks whenever his appearance is brought up. But those who've known him long enough don't buy it. His look isn't just about style—it's a quiet, unspoken tribute to a love that once meant everything. Some trends fade, but some memories never do.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
机鱼公司研发的电力滚地机器人。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有机械保龄球僵尸的特点，但死亡时只会掉落超级机械碎片</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>缓冲保护：所有僵尸前50次受伤降为1点伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>受击保护：所有僵尸前100次受伤后0.2秒内只会受到高于受伤值的伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>叶子保护伞</color>
zombie_fields.english:
The new electric steam roller robot designed by Gfishtus Corps.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color><color=#4B0082>Extremely Fast</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Inherits traits from Mecha-nut Zombies. Drops a Giga Mecha-nut Fragment upon defeat.
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. For the first 50 hits, all zombies take only 1 damage
2. All zombies gain 0.2s of damage immunity after each hit to any damage that does not exceed the previous one; this triggers up to 100 times
<color=black>Weakness: </color>Umbrella fusions.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>巨人僵尸一直想要一个保龄球，小鬼听说后连夜改造。实际上他只是在外面涂了一层油漆，并趁机把里面的零食拿出来了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"Fish balls? Mecha armor? That's all that matters," says Giga Mecha-nut. Sporting an impressive mechanical suit, he feels that's all he really needs.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
由超级机械坚果召唤，搁浅的超级机械海豚。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>20/0.02秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>超级机械坚果（生成者）血量的1%</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>不会移动</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有900点护甲。对超级机械坚果使用坚果卡片生成魅惑地鱼，该超级机械坚果再次召唤或死亡时地鱼立即死亡</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A failed example of a Sharkmarine test.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>20/0.02s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1% of Giga Mecha-nut's HP</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Sharkmarine, but on land and immobile. Has 900 innate DR value. Using a Wall-nut seedpacket on a Giga Mecha-nut summons a hypnotized Sharkmarine. The Grounded Sharkmarine dies instantly if the Giga Mecha-nut summons again or is destroyed.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>全新Z科技让地鱼可以在任意地形畅游，只是仿生系统过于优秀，使其在土中只会模仿机鱼睡觉。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Why is it here? Did it emerge from the ground? Or did it fall from the sky? No one really knows. What is certain is that those displaced dirt looking thingies are definitely camouflage.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
旅行尽头的巨人。身披黑曜重铠，令全军坚如磐石。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>32000+32000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>领袖，巨型</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫击退，受到的控制时间减半。在场时，全场僵尸获得500点护甲。锤击范围2.5格，对魅惑僵尸伤害7200。锤击时生成1~3个黑曜石小鬼僵尸。本体半血后扔出机械保龄球僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条：</color><color=red>御驾亲征：死亡时召唤僵王博士</color>
zombie_fields.english:
An ancient, eldritch and insidious threat.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>32000 + 32000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Mini-boss, giant zombie. . While present, provides +500 DR value to all zombies on screen, spawns 1-3 Abyssal Imps when he smashes the ground, and throws a Mecha-nut Zombie at half health. His smashing range is 2.5 tiles in front of him and deals 7200 damage to hypnotized zombies.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Summons Dr. Zomboss on death</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>曾有僵尸言道：根据古老文献记载，那身暗紫铠甲，只有经历了极寒与炽热双重考验的身躯才能承受，每当僵尸一族处于水深火热之中，在最惨烈的战场中心就有可能出现他的身影。“动静太大了，小心把沉睡在大地中的巨人吵醒。”这是对植物们的忠告。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>By ancient writ, it is recorded that the abyssal obsidian armor may only be borne by a body tempered through trials of bitter frost and searing flame. When the kin of zombies art plunged into utmost peril, his visage may yet appear at the heart of the dreadest battlefield. 'Stir not great commotion, lest ye rouse the giant that slumbereth beneath the earth.' A warning to the plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
冲刺进你的防线大杀四方。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>200</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1500</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>登场时向前冲刺2.7格，冲刺时不会被命中但可被伞类植物的大招击飞</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Abyssal Imp can easily infiltrate your defense.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>200</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1500</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Charges forward 2.7 tiles on appearing, cannot be targeted during the charge but can be flung away by Ultimate moves from Umbrellas.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>翅翼铡刀加死亡翻滚的帅气出场，是黑曜石小鬼僵尸为他出演好莱墓新片《侏罗纪僵尸》中迷你翼龙精心设计的动作。没人知道其实他只是不小心被甩出去了而已。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Blades whirling, wings flaring, Abyssal Imp delivered a death-defying stunt straight out of Hollytomb's next big hit, Jurassic Zombies. Critics called it "a masterpiece of aerial choreography." The truth? He had been flung out by mistake and was just rolling with it. Literally.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
骑乘武装红鲸越过三个植物，发怒时会发射大量爆炸樱桃。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1500</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极快，失去武装红鲸后变为慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有白鲸骑士的特点。出场3秒后狂暴，每1.5秒发射4颗爆炸樱桃子弹</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Jumps into and demolishes from behind your defense by shooting explosive cherries!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>1000</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1500</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Starts to shoot 4 explosive cherries every 1.5s, 3s after entering your lawn.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>樱桃机枪红鲸骑士的起床气奇大无比，更不要说他还有个拽着他冲去上班的白鲸搭档。所以他准备怒气冲冲地炸飞所有拦着他的植物，然后去睡个回笼觉。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Gatling Explode-o-rider Zombie always wakes up in a terrible mood — especially when a whale riding colleague drags him to work. Fueled by rage, he's ready to blow away any plants in his path before heading back for a nap.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
钻石光泽的盲盒，里面一定藏着不得了的东西！

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>20000+1100（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防具损坏或本体死亡时退场，召唤随机的究极僵尸，随机血量为0.8/1/1.2倍。防具损坏时有1%概率开出随机词条，然后冷却60秒，盲盒类僵尸共用冷却</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Randomly spawns one of your worst nightmares, or a blessing perhaps?

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>20000 + 1100 (Type 1)
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>After the box falls off, spawns a random Odyssey zombie with 80/100/120% Toughness. Also has a chance to unlock an Odyssey Modifier when defeated, up to 1 per minute.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
向你的防线倾泻三叉戟！

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1350+4400（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每次攻击发射4个三叉戟，装填后可再发射一次，然后前进。三叉戟固定落点在前方5到7格</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>锋雨无阻：免疫控制，每次发射数量x5</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>先箭之明：提前发射三叉戟</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Launches a salvo of tridents at your defense each volley!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1350 + 4400 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Each attack launches 4 tridents in quick succession, then after a brief pause, he fires another 4 tridents, for a total of two volleys. The tridents don't target plants directly; instead, they are launched at a fixed angle and speed, dealing damage to any plants they hit.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Immune to status effects, now fires ×5 the amount of Tridents
2. Can now launch Tridents from off-screen</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>三叉戟冲车营是究极渊海三叉戟统帅的一支特殊部队。由于部队的三叉戟供应不足，他们不得不抢劫友军。“我们也是被逼无奈，”被送到军事法庭的他们说，“都怪那个抠门的发射架子。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The Trident Hwacha Zombie is a "perfectionist" of the undead. He thinks his vehicle is a bit shabby, so he starts loading it up with tridents. But true to his perfectionist nature, he won't stop until every slot is filled.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
撑杆翻身做舞王！

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有舞王撑杆僵尸的特点，但是能翻越2格</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Can jump over two tiles. Blockable by tall plants.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Inherits all other traits from Michael Zombie.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>所有僵尸都很惊叹为什么白色撑杆舞王为什么有那么好的撑杆能力。
“天赋可不会给你猎豹般的敏捷，”他笑着说，“如果你在凌晨五点的时候推开窗户，就能看见我在楼下的小路上一边训练一边向你问好。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The zombies cheer as Super Dancing Pole Vaulter defies gravity yet again. "Oh, you know, just talent," he winks. But behind that effortless showmanship? He's clocking in two shifts a day, training until even his undead legs ache. The secret to greatness? "Twice the grind, twice the air time!"</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>它来自渊海，启于神话世代，所跨越的时间不可胜计；它是永恒的，不灭的，即使击毁它，也是暂时的胜利，它永远追随浪潮——这些都是说三叉戟，而不是它那一次性的发射架子。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The sea splits apart as Pozeidon ascends, water cascading from his mighty form. His trident, crackling with the fury of the deep, is already poised to strike. "The tides are mine to command," he roars, his voice carrying over the howling winds. With a swift motion, the weapon hurtles forward, crashing into enemy lines like a tidal wave. "Run if you wish—but no one outruns the sea."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
机鱼公司的铁幕装置。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>300000，限伤300</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>领袖</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有超级机械保龄球僵尸的特点。为所有其他僵尸承伤（盲盒类僵尸除外），但其他僵尸仍会受到1点伤害</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Secret artifact of the Gfishtus Corps.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>300000</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color><color=#4B0082>Extremely Fast</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss.
<color=black>•</color> Inherits traits from Giga Mecha-nut.
<color=black>•</color> Takes a maximum of 300 damage per hit after damage reduction calculations.
<color=black>•</color> The Ultra Mecha-nut Zombie Zombie reduces the damage taken by all other zombies (except Mystery-box Zombies) to 1, but redirects the original damage to itself.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>究极机械保龄球自被设计出来后广受僵尸们的赞誉，“它就像是我们的盾牌一样。”僵尸们如此说到，其实保龄球并不会保护他们，只是它自己太大了把植物的火力全吸引走了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: The Ultra Mecha-nut Zombie was meant to be a smaller, precise Giga Mecha-nut, but a blueprint mix-up made it much bigger. The engineers noticed too late—so they just rolled with it.

zombie_fields.source:
负旗陷阵的猛将，截断植物生机，致其坐困愁城。

<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>200</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>24000+24000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>领袖</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫击退。受到植物方回血量0.1倍且至多为1%韧性的伤害，以阻止植物回血。通过啃咬，可以将植物变为黑橄榄高坚果僵尸。每行动3秒，攻击力x2（最高100万），防具回血6000，速度增加0.3倍（最高3倍）</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条：</color><color=red>战意激增：每次成长所需的行动时间减半</color>
<color=#3D1400>不会被其啃咬转变的植物：</color>
<color=#3D1400>①</color><color=red>坚实植物</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>大蒜类植物，魅惑菇类植物</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Giga Football Striker can tear down your defense with ease!

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>200</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>24000 + 24000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss. Immune to knockbacks.
<color=black>•</color> Disables plant healing, converting it to 0.1× damage against himself, capped at 1% of his max HP.
<color=black>•</color> Instantly kills non-defensive plants when he bites them, turning them into Giga Football-nut Zombies.
<color=black>•</color> Every 3s, damage ×2 (stackable, max 1M), restores 6000 armor HP, and increases speed by 30% (max 3 times the original speed).</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Now gains buffs 2× faster</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>他是经历尸山血海的将军，是僵尸一族的战神。他曾于败军之际率残部殊死抵抗，突出重围。身后的旗帜记录着那一战被消灭的敌军的姓名，也禁锢着他们的灵魂。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>A general forged through countless bloody battles, the God of War of the zombie horde. When his army was defeated, he managed to lead the remnants in a desperate last stand, fighting their way out through the encirclement. The banners behind him bear the names of the enemies slain in that battle, their souls forever shackled within.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
是裂空机甲！裂空机甲升空了！

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>15000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极快，升空后变为慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压（升空前）
飞行（升空后），领袖</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫击退、定身。2/3血时进入短暂无敌然后升空。升空后每3秒在最右侧召唤1列基洛夫飞艇，并向前方发射炮弹，炮弹落地释放玩偶匣爆炸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Lift off! We have a lift off!

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>15000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss. Immune to knockbacks and being downed by Magnet Cactus's special traits.
<color=black>•</color> Very fast on land, crushes plants.
<color=black>•</color> At 2/3 Toughness, it briefly becomes invincible then takes off, summoning a fleet of Kirov Zomppelins every 3s and dropping Jack-in-the-Box bombs.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“我们融合！”两位杰出的驾驶员喊道，刺眼的红光过后，硕大的飞艇盖压整片天空。“长官，剩下的零件怎么办？”“制成炸弹，投向植物。”新任领袖淡淡地说道。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The battlefield trembled as Skystrider Mecha rolled in, its mechanical frame gleaming under the dim light. "Engaging ground assault," it announced, crushing plants like twigs. But the true horror began when it took to the skies. "Aerial dominance achieved," it declared, summoning Kirov Zomppelins and dropping bombs with surgical precision. "Your defenses are obsolete."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
用演出炒热气氛，他是流行乐的王。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>48000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>领袖，碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫击退、寒冷、冻结、定身、红温、蒜毒、换行。受到的扎胎效果会变为1%韧性的伤害。使附近的僵尸免疫寒冷和冻结。每10次摇摆动作，召唤4个舞王指挥官和4个白色撑杆舞王。死亡时解体为2台舞王冰车和1个舞王指挥官</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条：</color><color=red>合金舞台：获得50%减伤</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Jackson Worldwide has dedicated his entire life to the passion of stage performance and touring.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>48000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss. Immune to all status effects.
<color=black>•</color> Crushes plants.
