<color=black>•</color> Takes a maximum damage of 480 when affected by spikeweed-like attacks.
<color=black>•</color> Grants cryo-immunity to zombies nearby and summons 4 Superstar Zombies and 4 Super Dancing Pole Vaulters every 10 dance movements.
<color=black>•</color> Spawns 2 Michael Zombonis and a Superstar Zombie upon death.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Now gains a 50% incoming Damage Reduction</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>这是精心搭建的舞台，在舞台解体前，究级舞台巡演车僵尸终于可以无视一切诽谤，全心投入到他的表演中，为植物和僵尸们献上最后的歌与舞蹈。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The spotlight flickered as Jackson Worldwide stepped forward, his grin sharp and his voice low. "You think this is a game?" he said, snapping his fingers. Superstar Zombies materialized, their instruments screeching. "This garden's my stage now. Let's see how long you last."

zombie_fields.source:
静坐读报的博学者，一旦触怒，便教化群樱授你一课。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000+15000（一类）+3000（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快
失去报纸后变为极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>领袖，碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫击退、换行。受到扎胎效果时，立即失去报纸，然后移速归零
报纸会使本体和一类防具免疫伤害。失去报纸时，立即教化附近最多30个僵尸，随后自身发射、投掷爆炸樱桃攻击植物，期间会教化最多30个离场的僵尸，并使爆炸樱桃命中植物后额外产生十字爆炸，造成300物理伤害</color>
<color=#A86A44>教化：</color><color=red>将僵尸转化为失去报纸的樱桃机枪读报僵尸（进化模式中会转化为樱桃机枪硕士僵尸）</color>
<color=#A86A44>备案：</color><color=red>拥有1张备用报纸，本体血量低于50%时，取出报纸并重置自身状态。在旅行生存模式的炼狱或诅咒难度中，每少选取[势不可挡][怒不可遏]中的1个，就额外携带1张备用报纸</color>
<color=#A86A44>教化对象：</color><color=red>可以是魅惑僵尸。不能是载具、巨型、BOSS和领袖、水生、飞行僵尸或毁灭机枪读报僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A scholar who calmly reads the newspaper, but when provoked, he teaches you a lesson with a swarm of cherry-picked students.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>1000</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000 + 15000 (Type 1) + 3000 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss. Immune to knockbacks.
<color=black>•</color> Invulnerable until his newspaper is destroyed. Upon losing it, he briefly becomes invincible and converts up to 30 zombies (including hypnotized ones) into enraged Gatling Cherry Newspaper Zombie. During this process, he can convert up to 30 zombies that have left the battlefield, and Explosive Cherries that hit plants also trigger a cross-shaped explosion dealing 300 physical damage. He then fires a cherry barrage, catapulting cherries to the last column while accelerating forward. He cannot convert vehicles, flying zombies, aquatic zombies, giant zombies, mini-bosses, bosses or Gatling Doom Newspaper Zombies.
<color=black>•</color> Stops only upon encountering Spikeweed, which instantly destroys his newspaper.
Professor Cherryz has the following 2 skills:</color>
<color=#A86A44>Enlightenment: </color><color=#4B0082>Converts zombies into enraged Gatling Cherry Newspaper Zombies (in Evolved Modes, Gatling Cherry Doctor Zombies).</color>
<color=#A86A44>Backup: </color><color=#4B0082>Carries 1 spare newspaper. When his HP falls below 50%, he takes out the newspaper and resets his state. In Purgatory or Cursed difficulty in Odyssey Survival Mode, he carries 1 additional spare newspaper for each of [Breakthrough] and [Absolute Immunity] modifiers that was not selected.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>作为埃德加博士的恩师，究极Z教授的谈吐都透露出一股儒雅随和的气质。你如果详备地问他问题，他是不会生气的。当然倘若是拿走他的报纸，那就另当别论了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>As Dr. Edgar's mentor, the esteemed Prof. Cherryz exudes an air of refined calm and grace in his speech. But he is obsessed with the studying of scientific artifacts, especially explosives; rumor has it that Cherrizilla was originally his creation...</color>

zombie_fields.source:
每当巨型玩偶匣开启，小丑的爆炸派对便会迎来高潮。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>48000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>领袖，碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫定身、冻结。每8秒开启玩偶匣，从以下效果中随机释放一种：
·在第五列及更右侧每格召唤已进入自爆状态（免疫伤害）的小丑王僵尸
·在第五列及更右侧每格召唤小丑跳跳王（水路自动变为小丑爆破王）
·在本体所在列的每一格释放1次造成物理伤害的玩偶匣爆炸
死亡时，释放造成物理伤害的玩偶匣爆炸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Queen Jill-in-the-Box is very keen on creating "explosive scenes."

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>48000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss. Immune to freeze and stuns.
<color=black>•</color> Crushes plants.
<color=black>•</color> Explodes on death, dealing physical damage.
<color=black>•</color> Emerges from her box at regular intervals, causing one of the following effects at random:
1. Summons Clown-in-the-Box zombies on every tile of the fifth column and each column to its right.
2. Same but summons Clown-on-the-Pogo Zombies instead.
3. Releases an explosion in her column, dealing physical damage.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>皇后的威仪不容置疑，只需一个眼神，周围的仆从者便已开始颤栗。但与此同时，究极玩偶匣皇后也很喜欢分享，她的礼物盒里除了炸弹还准备好了给小孩子们的礼物，而她已经迫不及待要把这些礼物送出去啦。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The Queen's gaze alone is enough to make her servants tremble. None dare defy her. But power is not her only delight—she loves to give. Within her ornate gift box, toys and trinkets await young hands... along with bombs primed to surprise. And oh, how she loves surprises.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
无畏战士！不会停下他的脚步！

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>80</color>
<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>100</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000+3000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫击退。每0.1秒发射一颗铁豌豆，可击退魅惑僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>死亡行军：移动时会无视植物</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>帅令加身：改为发射诅咒铁豌豆</color>
zombie_fields.english:
An unstoppable warrior. Fearless and peerless.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>80/0.1s; 100 (bite)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000 + 3000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to Knock backs. Fires iron peas at your defense at a ridiculous rate, which can knock back hypnotized zombies. </color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Now ignores plants when moving
2. Now shoots Cursed iron peas instead</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>机枪黑橄榄僵尸是钢铁般的战士，拥有钢铁般的身躯、钢铁般的意志、钢铁般的子弹，以及被同事投诉后钢铁般的态度，他坚信僵尸们会被自己的子弹击退一定是因为没有经历钢铁般的训练。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Buckshot Commando Zombie is a warrior made of iron — iron body, iron will, iron bullets, and an ironic attitude towards complaints from his colleagues. He firmly believes that the zombies being knocked back by his bullets must simply lack the kind of iron-refining training he’s undergone.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
在同生共死的战友倒下前，可以多次死里求生并突进反击。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>500×2（非啃咬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000+6000（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫魅惑。以队伍的形式出场，一队有2名队员。一名队员死亡时，另一名队员也会死亡。受到致命伤害时，可以保留1点血量并进行紧急休整</color>
<color=#3D1400>紧急休整：①</color><color=red>原地蹲踞10秒，免疫击退且不会被索敌。结束后，回满本体血量，无视植物突进2.5格，对沿途的每个植物造成500伤害、释放一次延时的玩偶匣爆炸</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>只能紧急休整2次。首次休整时，免疫伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>同一队的队员全都处于此状态时，全体死亡</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条：</color><color=red>不屈：阿尔法小队的休整次数没有限制，休整时始终免疫伤害</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Typically operating in pairs, with elite members deploying as a full squad when necessary.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>500 × 2 (Non-bite)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000 + 6000 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to being hypnotized. Appear in pairs. When appearing as a mini-boss, 5 spawn in one lane at once, with their health increased by 5×.
<color=black>•</color> If they take fatal damage while any member of the group is still alive, they become incapacitated (up to 2 times). Otherwise, the whole squad dies simultaneously.
<color=black>•</color> While incapacitated, they're immune to damage and knockback (only for the first time), block projectiles, but won't be targeted by plants.
<color=black>•</color> After 10s of incapacitation, they revive with full health, charge forward 2.5 tiles, which deals 500 damage to all plants they collide with, and trigger a Jack-in-the-Box Explosion.
<color=black>•</color> If killed by Chompers or other insta-kill methods, both they and their squad immediately perish.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Now always invincible when incapacitated
2. Can now appear as a Mini-boss: Omega Assassin Squad</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>他们是僵尸特种部队的年轻血液。他们面对任何危险的敌人，他们踏足所有恶劣的环境，他们在战斗中相识，立志成为究极阿尔法小队的队长。他们吹奏战歌，在战场的迷雾中互相指引方向，约定的歌声一直吹奏到生命的尽头。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The Alpha Assassin Squad moves like shadows, striking faster than a breath and leaving no trace behind—except for the occasional zombie body, of course. They never miss a target, and they never leave anyone alive to tell the tale.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
拥有锋利的雪爪，伤害很高。

<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>300</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>270+1100（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>究极大喷菇和究极仙人掌攻击产生魅惑效果时，改为生成魅惑寒冰雪爪僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Frost Tall-nut Zombies with icy claws. They pack a punch.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>270 + 1100 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Inherits traits from Frost Tall-nut Zombie. Transformed from regular zombies by Doominator and Thornminator.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>与其他雪原僵尸不同，寒冰雪爪僵尸并不喜欢住在冰屋里躲避严寒。这不仅仅是因为他拥有寒冰高坚果的抗寒体质，最主要的原因其实是他硕大的头颅和狭小的冰屋并不相配。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Unlike other zombies that live surrounding the snow, Frost Tall-nut Iceclaw Zombie doesn't like hiding in igloos to escape the freezing winds. Not because his consitution allows for resistance to the cold... but because his head's too big!</color>

zombie_fields.source:
如苍茫雪原上不休的风霜，无情覆尽每度荒凉的境遇。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>64000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>领袖，碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫寒冷、冻结、击退、定身。出场时发动斩击，此后每3秒攻击一次。血量低于[1,1/2,1/6]倍时，每[20/10/2]次普通攻击后斩击一次。每轮斩击后第5次普通攻击额外发动祈雪
伤害均施加5秒攻击冻结</color>
<color=#A86A44>普通攻击：</color><color=red>向本行发射4发冰剑造成伤害</color>
<color=#A86A44>斩击：</color><color=red>对本列及前方全场植物造成伤害（受南瓜保护），然后在本列周围释放5个对3×3范围造成伤害的重型雪球</color>
<color=#A86A44>祈雪：</color><color=red>召唤大量白雪球攻向左半场，若场景为雪原，则使场上立即出现暴风雪效果</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Sovereign of the Frozen Tundra.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>1000</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>64000</color>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss. Immune to chill, freeze, knockbacks and stuns.
<color=black>•</color> Crushes plants. All damage dealt applies a 5s Attack Freeze.
<color=black>•</color> Upon entering, performs a slash that damages all plants in her column and in front of her (can be protected by Pumpkin), then releases 5 heavy snowballs around her lane, each damaging a 3×3 area.
<color=black>•</color> Afterwards, attacks every 3s. When HP is below [1, 1/2, 1/6]×, performs a slash after every [20, 10, 2] normal attacks.
<color=black>•</color> Normal attacks launch 4 ice swords along her lane.
<color=black>•</color> After each round of slashing, her 5th normal attack also triggers a special attack, summoning a large number of white snowballs toward the left half of the field.
<color=black>•</color> On Snow map, this special attack also instantly summons a blizzard.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>以寒冰为利刃，以风雪为战袍，用残躯铸造神像，用意志塑造神威。她是人造的神明，她是雪原的幽灵。不知炼狱再见之时，能否为故人吹上一曲战歌？
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>With blades of ice and a cloak of blizzard, she carves statues from shattered flesh and molds divine power with unyielding will. An artificial deity, a specter of the tundra. When hell reunites us, will she remember this land of sorrow?</color>

zombie_fields.source:
统御铁骑的大帅，施植物以诅咒，致其不治则亡。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>80</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>36000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>快，冲锋时变为极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>领袖，碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫击退、冻结、定身。每0.1秒，发射1发诅咒铁豌豆并回血200。如果没有植物阻挡，最多能直接从第五列右侧出场。冲锋撞到植物时原地短暂修整，10秒后再度发起冲锋。血量归零时落马，清除诅咒状态并使植物流失层数100%的血量，然后变为机枪黑橄榄大帅</color>
<color=#A86A44>施咒：</color><color=red>每0.1秒，有1/3概率对全场植物施加0.2%基数的诅咒。子弹命中时施加0.5%基数的诅咒。冲锋结束时，对5×5范围植物施加10%基数的诅咒
基数为[(植物血量+韧性)/2]</color>
<color=#3D1400>诅咒状态：</color><color=red>使满血植物受伤。层数不为0时，每1秒增加1层。植物血量低于层数时，立即死亡。治疗会优先抵消等量层数，再回复血量</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条：</color><color=red>血镰绽放：落马时，将战马化为镰刀。每0.1秒为防具回复200血量。不再啃咬植物，而是挥舞镰刀攻击
<color=#A86A44>挥舞：</color><color=red>每1.35秒使本格和前方5格植物（可被南瓜阻挡）流失等同于自身啃咬伤害的血量，并削减伤害50%的韧性，自身回复伤害10%的血量。该效果每作用到一个植物，就使自身各项伤害永久增加10%
<color=#A86A44>冲击：</color><color=red>每10秒，若在地图第四列及其右侧，可飞跃至第二列，依次释放1、4、8次伤害分别为1500、1200、1000的爆炸（可被南瓜阻挡），随后翻越至最右侧一列，重复释放上述爆炸一轮</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Commands the calamitous wrath of the cursed iron cavalry.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>80/0.1s</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color><color=#4B0082>Fast; Extremely Fast during Charge</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>36000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss. Immune to chill, knockbacks and stuns. Crushes plants. 
<color=black>•</color> Heals for 200 HP every 0.1s.
<color=black>•</color> Without plants blocking his way, he can appear in as far as the fifth column from the right and then charges, riding a warhorse that crushes plants.
<color=black>•</color> When its charge hits a plant, it pauses for ~1.5s, then charges again every 10s.
<color=black>Curse Application</color> Every 0.1s, 1/3 chance to apply [0.1%×(Plant HP + Toughness)] curse stacks to all plants. Bullet hits apply [0.25%×(Plant HP + Toughness)] stacks. Upon collision, applies [5%×(Plant HP + Toughness)] stacks to plants in a 5×5 area.
<color=black>Curse: </color>Damages a plant at full health. When stacks are not zero, increases by 1 stack every 0.1s. If the plant's HP is lower than the stack count, the plant dies immediately. Healing first cancels an equal number of stacks, then restores HP.
<color=black>Odyssey Modifier:</color> When dismounting, transforms the steed into a scythe. Recovers 200 HP for its armor every 0.1s. No longer bites plants, but attacks by swinging the scythe.
Swing: Every 1.35s, causes plants in its current tile and the 5 tiles ahead (can be blocked by Pumpkins) to lose HP equal to its own bite damage, and reduces their Toughness by 50% of the damage dealt, while recovering 10% of the damage as HP for itself. For each plant this effect acts upon, all its damage permanently increases by 10%.
Charge: Every 10 seconds, if in the 4th column or to its right on the map, it can leap to the 2nd column, sequentially releasing 1, 4, and 8 explosions with damages of 1500, 1200, and 1000 respectively (can be blocked by Pumpkins), then vaults to the rightmost column to repeat the aforementioned explosion sequence once.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>究极黑橄榄大帅与究极黑橄榄将军相识了很久，他们一起进攻花园，一起训练士兵，相互争夺副将。闲暇之余，他们也会来一盘紧张刺激的真人中国象棋，让下属扮演棋子，两位将帅居中指挥，虽然他们总是忍耐不住跑出九宫。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Giga Football Striker and Archduke Deathrider have known each other for a long time. They have attacked gardens together, trained soldiers together, and competed for vice-generals. In their spare time, they also play a tense and exciting game of live-action Chinese chess, letting their subordinates act as the pieces while the two commanders direct from the center, although they always can't resist running out of the palace.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
虽是落马之帅，不负领袖之威。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>100</color>
<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>500</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>18000+18000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>领袖</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫击退、冻结、定身。每0.1秒发射一发诅咒铁豌豆，施加[0.5%×(血量+韧性)/2]层诅咒并造成击退</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A fallen commander, no longer wielding power.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>100/0.1s; 500 (bite)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>18000 + 18000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color><color=#4B0082>Medium Fast</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Immune to knockbacks, freeze, and stuns. Fires a bullet every 0.1s that applies [0.5×(HP + Toughness)/2] curse stacks and causes knockbacks.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>战争，是刻在大帅身体里的烙印，他是天生的战场主宰，无论什么都无法阻拦他的进攻。铜墙铁壁拦截，便永不疲倦地射击，紧随的部下溃败，便孤身一人继续作战，心爱的坐骑倒下，便亲自踏上地面为它报仇。手中紧握的镰刀是他的武器，也是为爱马预订的墓碑。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>War is a brand etched into the Archduke's body; he is a born master of the battlefield, and nothing can stop his advance. If an impenetrable wall blocks his path, he fires tirelessly; if his troops are routed, he continues fighting alone; if his beloved steed falls, he personally steps onto the ground to avenge it. The scythe he grips is his weapon, and also the tombstone he has reserved for his steed.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
来吧！我死去的战士，带走他们的灵魂！

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>90000</color>
<color=#3D1400>剑气伤害：</color><color=red>500</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>秒杀接触的植物和魅惑僵尸。通常只在最右侧一列上下移动。在场时，每过一段时间释放一次技能</color>
<color=#A86A44>技能1：</color><color=red>摇动旗帜，在每行随机召唤一只僵尸</color>
<color=#A86A44>技能2：</color><color=red>向前冲刺并释放剑气，随后转头再次释放剑气</color>
<color=#A86A44>技能3：</color><color=red>向前方散射三道大范围剑气</color>
<color=#A86A44>技能4：</color><color=red>在每行最右侧召唤一个幽魂骑士，向左冲锋，对沿途植物造成1000伤害</color>
<color=#A86A44>技能5：</color><color=red>跳跃到左半场和中半场随机位置，秒杀植物，然后返回右侧</color>
zombie_fields.english:
"Come, my fallen warriors - take their souls!"

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>500 (sword slash)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>90000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Boss. Crushes plants and instantly defeats hypnotized zombies. Normally moves up and down in the rightmost column. Periodically uses one of the following skills:
<color=black>1.</color> Waves his banner to summon 1 zombie in each lane.
<color=black>2.</color> Charges forward, releasing a sword slash, then turns and releases another.
<color=black>3.</color> Fires three wide sword slashes ahead.
<color=black>4.</color> Summons a Phantom Archduke at the far right of each lane that charges left, dealing 1000 damage to plants along the way.
<color=black>5.</color> Leaps to a random spot in the left or middle area, crushing plants, then returns to the right side.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>战争是名将最好的磨刀石。曾经的失败阻挡不住脚步，被降职为骑士消磨不了意志，经历痛苦与地狱般的训练之后，黑橄榄尸骑士带着他的坐骑卷土重来，他将用敌人的尸体、铸成自己新的帅台。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>War is the finest whetstone for a commander. Once demoted and defeated, the Archduke Deathrider returned from hellish training with his steed, ready to rebuild his command platform from the corpses of his enemies.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
如同无声无息的幽灵，快速贯穿你的防线。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>15000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫冻结、定身、击退。无视植物，从右向左冲锋，对经过的植物造成1000伤害，秒杀接触的魅惑僵尸。到达最左侧时不会使游戏结束</color>
zombie_fields.english:
An army of holograms that tear through defenses despite being mere projections.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>15000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to chill, freeze, stun, and knockback. Ignores plants while charging left, dealing 1000 damage to all plants it passes through and instantly defeating all hypnotized zombies.
<color=black>•</color> Does not trigger Lawn-mowers or game overs.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>大帅回来了！僵尸们敬畏地列队欢迎。大帅回来了！植物们惊恐地聚集防御。只有埃德加博士满意地摆弄着自己的实体投影仪，他相信这项技术一定会在僵尸的复仇战中大放异彩。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"He has returned!" cry the zombies in awe. "He has returned!" panic the plants. Meanwhile, Dr. Zomboss tinkers proudly with his hologram projector, confident it will shine in the zombie war of vengeance.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
全副武装的巨人僵尸，不同的眼睛颜色标示不同的抗性与能力。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>16000+16000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>巨型</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>锤击对僵尸伤害为3600。出场时随机获得一种外表，拥有外表对应的能力和抗性</color>
<color=#A86A44>红眼：</color><color=red>免疫红温。拥有200点护甲</color>
<color=#A86A44>蓝眼：</color><color=red>免疫寒冷、冻结、击退。速度×2。每次锤击会对植物造成5次伤害判定</color>
<color=#A86A44>黄眼：</color><color=red>免疫定身。锤击后，向前跳跃小段距离，并额外攻击一次</color>
<color=#A86A44>绿眼：</color><color=red>免疫蒜毒。锤击后回复10%韧性的血量</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>武艺贯通：整合四种外表对应的特殊能力</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>震地呼唤：锤击每击中一株植物，就召唤一次外表对应的武装小鬼僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A fully armed Gargantuar zombie with eye color indicating their elemental affinity.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>16000 + 16000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Giant zombie. Does not throw Imps. Smashing deals 3600 damage to hypnotized zombies. Gains one of four appearances (eye colors) at spawn, each with unique elemental affinity:
<color=red>• Flame-forged Gargantuar:</color> Immune to Enflamed; has inherent +200 DR value.
<color=blue>• Tide-tempered Gargantuar:</color> Immune to chill, freeze, and knockback; has double speed; each smash counts as 5 attacks.
<color=yellow>• Wind-charged Gargantuar:</color> Immune to stun; jumps a short distance forward after each smash and does an additional smash.
<color=green>• Soil-bound Gargantuar:</color> Immune to poison; recovers 10% max HP after smashing.
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Appearance no longer matters, now has the extra abilities of all four affinities at once
2. Smashing now causes corresponding Element-infused Imps to appear</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>特种武装巨人们总表示他们的友谊坚不可摧，但蓝眼总受到他们的排斥。“我们刚好可以组成信号灯，他来就多余了！”绿眼这么说。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Long ago, Master Zomboss sought to train more versatile soldiers by infusing his Gargantuars with the powers of the four elements - fire, water, air, and earth. The experiment was a success… mostly. While the Fire-forged, Wind-charged and Soil-bound Gargs quickly bonded over their newfound strength, the Tide-tempered Garg found himself left out. "We already make a perfect set of signal colors without you," the other three grumbled. "Red, yellow, green - you're just… extra blue."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
航路尽头的小鬼。坐镇金鸡豪艇，令全军行如魅影。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>48000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等，在陆地上变为极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>领袖，碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫定身。使全场僵尸速度增加20%，且有33%概率闪避伤害（只受到1点伤害）。死亡时，将小鬼国王僵尸弹射至附近地面</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条：</color><color=red>国王特权：闪避时回血500</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Final Imp at the end of your Odyssey. Pilots the luxurious Ark of the Duck, leading the undead fleet.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>48000</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color><color=#4B0082>Medium; Extremely Fast on Land</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss. Immune to stun and tangle.
<color=black>•</color> Crushes plants rapidly.
<color=black>•</color> While present, grants +400 DR value to all zombies.
<color=black>•</color> When present, all zombies gain a 20% movement speed boost and a 33% chance to reduce incoming damage to 1.
<color=black>•</color> Upon death, ejects the Imperor onto nearby land.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Now recovers 500 HP every time he dodges an attack</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>作为孩子们的老大，在小鬼头的世界里，他就是王。不必如学者僵尸一样知识渊博，无需像舞王僵尸一般风度翩翩，只要做让自己开心的事就好了：骑上心爱的快艇，给讨厌的植物们制造点大麻烦。那么，无需多言：出发，掌握你的冒险！
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>As the boss of all Imps, he reigns supreme in their world. No need to be as knowledgeable as Scholar Zombie, nor as elegant as Michael Zombie - he just does what delights him: riding his beloved golden speedboat nicknamed Ark of the Duck and causing major trouble for those pesky plants. There's no need for explanation: let's set sail and embrace the adventure!</color>

zombie_fields.source:
败退的小鬼国王。但若逃出生天，便会卷土重来。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>12000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>领袖</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫定身、击退。场上每有1种其他领袖，自身受伤额外降低20%。落地后，调转方向，无视植物向右移动。移动至最右侧离场后，会获得一艘新的金鸡豪艇，以究极小鬼国王的姿态重新入场</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Imperor in retreat, but once he escapes, he'll surely return.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>80/0.1s; 100 (bite)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>18000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss. Immune to stun and knockback.
<color=black>•</color> For every other mini-boss present, gains a 20% incoming damage reduction for himself.
<color=black>•</color> Upon landing, turns around and retreats, ignoring plants.
<color=black>•</color> Upon exiting the lawn, he re-enters on a new Ark of the Duck.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>即便是在激烈的战争中，小鬼国王僵尸也想拥有一点空闲的时间，不去贪求脑子、也不用管那些讨厌的植物，一边散步、一边思考万圣节时给子民们表演什么节目。直到身为国王的责任让他重新坐上王座、再度发起进攻。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Even amidst fierce battles, Imperor still wishes for some leisure time: no brains to chase, no plants to fight, just a quiet walk, pondering over what trick to perform on his subjects at Halloween. But the call of duty as a member of royalty always brings him back to the throne, ready to lead the next charge.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
装备着两种经典的科幻武器。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>每2秒一次，锁定半径2.5格内最近的植物进行激光打击，造成300伤害，优先锁定主位植物。靠近植物后，停留该格上方，发动能量光束，每0.02秒对该格所有植物造成10伤害，被魅惑时此伤害改为等量治疗</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>远距离锁定：激光打击将选择攻击范围内最远的植物</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>范围打击：能量光束作用范围从本格扩大至3×3范围</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Equipped with two classic sci-fi weapons.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Every 2s, locks onto the nearest plant within a 2.5-tile radius and fires a Dissolver Beam, dealing 300 damage, prioritizing non-pumpkin, non-pot, non-flying plants.
<color=black>•</color> When close to a plant, hovers directly above it and unleashes a Siphon Drainer that deals 10 damage every 0.02s to all plants on that tile. If hypnotized, the damage becomes healing instead with equal the amount.
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Dissolver Beams now target the farthest plant within range
2. Siphon Drainer's range: 1 Tile → 3×3 Area</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>这种新型的飞碟装有强大的反重力波发射器，能够自动飞行与攻击，驾驶员不需要任何操作、甚至可以在驾驶舱中睡觉。那么，为什么还要保留驾驶员呢？“总有一些僵尸愚蠢到无论做什么都会坏事，新飞碟是最适合的岗位。”埃德加博士一边说，一边焊死了飞碟门。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>This new model of the Freezer Disc is equipped with an advanced anti-gravity emitter and plant sensor that allows full autonomous flight and combat. Its pilot doesn't even need to operate it, or stay awake. So why keep a pilot at all? "Some zombies are too stupid to do anything else," Dr. Edgar Zomboss said, as he welded the cockpit shut.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
用己方樱桃的能量来强化自身动力。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>9000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>碾压被抵抗时只受30%击退。僵尸方爆炸樱桃命中植物且产生溅射时，受爆炸影响的樱桃鲸鱼重艇回血150并增加0.3倍速度，最多增加8倍。自身水草值不会超过10</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Harnesses allied cherry explosions to boost its own power.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>9000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Sinks plants.
<color=black>•</color> When a zombie-side cherry explosion hits plants and causes splash damage, any affected Bombeluga Sub restores 150 HP and gains 0.3× movement speed, stacking up to 8×.
<color=black>•</color> Tangle value on this zombie will not exceed 10.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>用粉色油漆涂抹，不是能让这艘有强大威胁性的重艇藏于超级机械海豚僵尸中，更不容易被发现吗？可惜，所有粉色油漆都被僵尸当成了脑汁，现在一罐也不剩了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Painted pink, this massive vessel was meant to be hidden among the Sharkmarines, but all the pink paint was mistaken for brain juice and eaten by zombies. Not a single drop left.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
乘骑着雪兽，将你的防线向后压制。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>9000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1，免疫冻结。接触植物时，若其免疫碾压或为巨型植物，造成碾压，被抵抗时退缩0.22格；否则，将所有接邻的植物向左推移1格，如果不能推移（有巨型植物或左侧没有空地），则先秒杀最左侧植物来创造空地。飞行植物不参与推动。血量低于一半时，无视植物向前方跳跃2.2格</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Rides a Snowfur that pushes your defenses backward.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>9000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to Chill and Freeze. Vulnerable to Deep Chill.
<color=black>•</color> Upon contact with a Pot, crush-immune or Titan plant, attempts to crush it. Otherwise pushes all connecting plants in the lane one tile left.
<color=black>•</color> If unable to push (blocked by Titans or no space), instantly destroys the leftmost plant to make room.
<color=black>•</color> Flying plants are unaffected by the push.
<color=black>•</color> When below half max HP, leaps 2.2 tiles forward ignoring plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>成年的雪兽会本能地照顾族群中的幼小个体，利用这一习性，雪兽骑士僵尸假扮成小雪兽成功混入雪兽群中驯服了一只雪兽，而这么做的代价是，雪兽骑士僵尸以后大概要像一只真正的雪兽一样生活了。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Adult Snowfurs instinctively protect the young in their pack. Taking advantage of this trait, the Beastmaster disguised himself as a Furling and successfully tamed one. The price? He'll probably have to live like a Furling for the rest of his unlife.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
用改造后的跳杆实现水上跳跃，快速冲向植物并丢出大量炸弹。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>被植物阻挡时立即死亡，并向半径3.5格范围扔出落地时释放玩偶匣爆炸的炸弹，该爆炸伤害为500，共扔出(接触植物个数×地图行数)个。死亡时始终释放玩偶匣爆炸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Uses a modified pogo stick to jetski across water lanes, rushing at plants and littering a cluster of Jack-in-the-Boxes.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Very fast. When stopped by a plant, dies instantly and litters bombs that detonate like Jack-in-the-Boxes within a 3.5-tile radius, for a total of (plants hit × map lanes) bombs, each dealing 500 damage.
<color=black>•</color> Always triggers a Jack-in-the-Box explosion on death.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Bomb damage +500
2. Bomb damage +500</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>小丑爆破王是第一个能在水上使用蹦蹦竿和小丑盒子的僵尸。问他是怎么做到的？“科学！牛顿第三定律加上硝化甘油！别忘了弹簧！欧——耶！”他是天才还是疯子？谁知道呢！
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The first zombie to use pogo sticks and Jack-in-the-Boxes on water. How did he do it? "Science! Newton's third law, nitroglycerin, and springs! Oh yeah!" Is he a genius or a maniac? Who knows!</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>当不同谱系的巨人僵尸在战场上相遇，他们会用低沉的咆哮互聊家常，而堡垒三叉戟巨人总能在这时挺直腰杆。他头顶的堡垒如同一块充满荣耀的徽章——那是累计砸扁三百个坚果才能拥有的荣誉证明。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>When Gargantuars of different lineages meet on the battlefield, they exchange pleasantries with deep roars, and the Trident Jugger-nut Gargantuar always straightens his back at such moments. The Jugger-nut atop his head is like a badge filled with glory - proof of honor earned only after smashing three hundred Wall-nuts.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
重伤时变得诸法不侵，召唤分身，并在其掩护下获得震天撼地的力量。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>18000+18000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>锤击伤害：</color><color=red>4800</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢，巨化后变为极慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>巨型</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫魅惑、击退。本体血量首次低于1%时，回复5%韧性的血量。本体血量首次低于50%时，净化身上的红温、余烬、中毒、寒冷、冻结状态，每净化一项，回复5%韧性的血量，随后永久免疫这五种异常和定身。同时在本列每行召唤一个韧性为自身1/3倍的特种武装巨人分身，分身存在期间本体免疫伤害。若15秒后仍有分身存在，将其全部吸收并巨化（韧性和攻击力翻倍），并重击一次：额外对全场所有植物造成攻击力20%×吸收分身数量的伤害</color>
zombie_fields.english:
When heavily wounded, becomes impervious to all effects, summons clones, and gains sky-crumbling power under their cover.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>4800 (smash)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>18000 +18000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Giant zombie. Immune to hypnotization and knockback. When the main body's HP first drops below 50% max, Enflamed, Irradiated, Poison, Chill, and Freeze debuffs are removed; for each debuff removed, recovers HP equal to 5% of its maximum toughness, then permanently gains immunity to all five and butter. At the same time, summon one Element-infused Gargantuar clone in each row of this column, each with 1/3 of the main body's toughness. While any clone exists, the main body is immune to damage. If any clones remain after 15s, Celestial Gargantuar absorbs them all, enters gigantified state with double Toughness and Attack Power, and afterward each of his attack additionally deals damage equal to (20% of Attack Power × [number of absorbed clones]) to all plants on the field.
<color=black>•</color> When the main body's HP first drops below 1% max, recover HP equal to 5% of its max toughness.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>特种黄金巨人很讨厌制式盔甲，他认为自己需要更加能彰显地位的装备、以便和其他铠甲巨人区分开。
“这是不可能的。”埃德加博士断然拒绝了他的要求，“制式盔甲不仅制造方便，而且能有效防止你们这些巨人吃的太胖。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>When the old Master Zomboss refined the Elemental Gargantuars, he believed their training incomplete - he felt something invisible behind their powers he could not fully grasp. That unseen medium was Aether, the fifth element whispered of in forgotten notes, the substance that carries force, binds matter, and fills the space between. By anchoring the element into a Gargantuar's body, Dr. Zomboss created a titan that does not merely wield the elements, but moves through them as though the world itself were obliged to make way.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
发射难以熄灭的毁灭子弹，能通过削减寿命强行治疗自身。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1500+1500（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>400</color>
<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢，破报后变为极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有学者僵尸的特点。失去报纸后，每0.5秒发射4发余烬毁灭菇子弹。子弹对植物会造成总计5次伤害，每次间隔1秒。受伤时，在对植物造成伤害后回复等量的血量，并削减自身1%的韧性</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Fires hard-to-extinguish Irradiated Shells and can forcibly heal himself by reducing his own lifespan.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>400 (bite) 1000 (doom shell)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1500 +1500 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Inherits traits from Scholar Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> After losing his newspaper, fires 4 Irradiated Shells every 0.5s. These each deal a total of 5 instances of damage to plants, with 1s between each instance of damage. After dealing damage to plants, recovers an equal amount of HP when taking damage but reduces own max HP by 1%.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>毁灭机枪读报僵尸在爆炸学和原子物理学都颇有造诣，为科学奉献半生的他如今选择深藏功与名，现在只想好好享受他的纵横字谜。但如果有人想打扰他的读报时光，他也不介意展示下他当年的毕业设计。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Gatling Doom Newspaper Zombie is highly accomplished in both explosives science and nuclear physics. After dedicating half his life to science, he now chooses to hide his achievements and simply enjoy his crossword puzzles. But if anyone dares to disturb his reading time, he does not mind showing off his old graduation project.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
集结整编的精锐阿尔法小队。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>500×2（非啃咬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>30000+30000（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>领袖</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>不会对秒杀级伤害限伤。以队伍的形式出场，一队有(行数×5)名队员。受到致命伤害时，可以保留1点血量并进行紧急休整</color>
<color=#3D1400>紧急休整：①</color><color=red>原地蹲踞10秒，免疫击退且不会被索敌。结束后，回满本体血量，无视植物突进2.5格，对沿途的每个植物造成500伤害、释放一次延时的玩偶匣爆炸</color>
<color=#3D1400>②</color><color=red>只能紧急休整2次。首次休整时，免疫伤害</color>
<color=#3D1400>③</color><color=red>同一队的队员全都处于此状态时，全体死亡</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Elite Assassin Zombies that deploy as a coordinated unit.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>500 × 2 (Non-bite)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>30000 +30000 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Comes in a unit with 5 in each lane.
<color=black>•</color> Has no resistance against insta-kills. When taking fatal damage, if another squadmate in the same unit is not incapacitated, they remain at 1 HP and enter an incapacitated state instead (up to 2 times).
<color=black>•</color> While incapacitated, they're immune to damage and knockback (only for the first time), block projectiles, but won't be targeted by plants.
<color=black>•</color> After 10s of incapacitation, they revive with full health, charge forward 2.5 tiles, which deals 500 damage to all plants they collide with, and trigger a Jack-in-the-Box Explosion.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>他们的利刃无坚不摧，他们能够渗透进一切防线，他们彼此之间的默契与配合早已达到巅峰，当他们出动之时，便成为足以扫平一切障碍的军团，花园所谓坚不可摧的防线在他们面前形如虚设。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Their blades can cut through anything. They can infiltrate any defense. Their coordination and teamwork have long since reached perfection. When they mobilize, they become a legion capable of sweeping aside all obstacles, rendering the garden's so-called impregnable defenses completely meaningless.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
拘器遣灵，敕令万万年不死长生。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>15000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>不会移动</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>领袖</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫击退、冻结、蒜毒、定身、换行、压扁。以被封印在剑匣中的形态出场，降临在地图右侧中央，由护剑人守护。剑匣会秒杀接触的魅惑僵尸。共有四个阶段，血量归零时，转换阶段，暂时免疫伤害并回满血量，在原地释放多次玩偶匣爆炸。在每个阶段，会夺取玩家的不同道具，并使用对应的能力。使用道具的频率会受寒冷减速幅度影响</color>
<color=#3D1400>阶段一：</color><color=red>夺取锤子，攻击全场所有植物，伤害1000。此后每3秒一次，攻击每行血量最高的1株植物</color>
<color=#3D1400>阶段二：</color><color=red>夺取手套，每4秒一次，将每行最右侧的1个非领袖非飞行僵尸向前挪动2格</color>
<color=#3D1400>阶段三：</color><color=red>夺取铲子，每5秒一次，铲除卡牌阳光价值最低的1株植物</color>
<color=#3D1400>阶段四：</color><color=red>破封而出，同时夺取上述三种道具，每5秒使用一次</color>
<color=red>死亡时，以卡牌的形式解放所有被其铲除的植物</color>
zombie_fields.english:
"Bind the body, release the spirit; I command thee immortality for a millennium."

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>15000 × 4</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to knockback, freezing, poison, stunning, redirection, and crushing.
<color=black>•</color> First appears in its sealed form, guarded by the Millennium Warden. Any hypnotized zombies will immediately die when coming in contact with the coffin.
<color=black>•</color> There are 4 phases in total, each having 15k HP total. When its HP reaches 0, it will transition to the next phase, temporarily becoming invincible and restoring its full health. Each phase has a separate set of abilities, those being:
<color=black>  • </color><color=#8a4700>Phase 1 (Hammer): </color>Steals the player's Mallet. Attacks all plants on the field, dealing 1000 damage (100 in any non-Odyssey mode). After that, every 3s, it will target the plant with the highest HP in each row.
<color=black>  • </color><color=#0e6900>Phase 2 (Glove): </color>Steals the player's Gloves. Every 4s, it will move the rightmost non-mini-boss, non-flying zombie in each row forward by 2 tiles.
<color=black>  • </color><color=#ab8e74>Phase 3 (Shovel): </color>Steals the player's Shovel. Every 5s, it will dig up the plant that costs the lowest amount of sun on the field.
<color=black>  • </color><color=#ff0000>Phase 4 (Dragon): </color>Now unsealed, uses all attacks from previous phases every 5s. When defeated, drops seed packets of all the plants it shoveled previously.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>是岁秋，有龙携剑分天，藤须为身，锁尸为侍，竖剑为标。见草木繁茂，曰：“吾万年前初得道时，不曾见此怪异。”以须指之，霎时见破，飘然去。今人不知其或尸或植或龙，只称万年不化骨。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <color=black>Once upon a time, a dragon bearing a sword split the heavens during a peaceful autumn. Its body was formed from vine tendrils, with a corpse bound as its attendant and a sword erected as its coffin. Beholding the lush vegitation, it declared, "When I first attained enlightenment ten thousand years ago, I never witnessed such strange wonders." Pointing with its tendrils, it shattered the landscape in an instant and drifted away. To this day, people remain uncertain whether it was a corpse, a plant, or a dragon; merely calling it the millennium-old undecaying bones.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
散布磁场来屏蔽植物的承伤援助，并强化僵尸体质。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>4500</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>位于其下方的植物1秒内无法被承伤，曾位于其下方的僵尸获得100点护甲（不可叠加）</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Emits a magnetic field to block plant damage absorption and bolden the resilience of zombies underneath it.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>4500</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Plants beneath it cannot have their damage absorbed for 1 second.
<color=black>•</color> Zombies that were previously under the D.A.M.P. Disc gain +100 DR value (unstackable).</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>经过改装后的特种机械飞碟，无论硬度、威力、续航时间、环保评分，都有了明显的提升，被埃德加博士称为自己上个星期最伟大的科技进步。“我剔除掉了老型号所有的缺陷，”他说道，“包括那个驾驶员。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>This modified Frost Legion Frayer Disc; titled the "Damage Absorption Mitigation Platform" Disc (or D.A.M.P. Disc for short), has been significantly improved in terms of its toughness, strength, durability, and eco-friendliness. Dr. Edgar Zomboss has called it his greatest technological advancement of the past week. 'I've eliminated all the flaws of the old model,' he said, 'including the pilot.'</color>

zombie_fields.source:
在远处盯梢后方植物，单独行动，六响毙命。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000+3000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>远程伤害：</color><color=red>500</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫魅惑、击退。移动到地图最右侧一列后开始攻击，每约2秒狙击本行最左侧的非载体植物（受南瓜保护和寒冷减速影响）。每第6次狙击造成强制击杀，受到换行效果时重置计数</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Stakes out targets from a distance; operates solo; and takes down enemies with certainty after 6 shots.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>500 (Sniper)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000 +3000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to hypnotization and knockback.
<color=black>•</color> Begins attacking once he reaches the farthest-right column of the lawn. Every 2 seconds, he will snipe the left-most plant in his lane that is not a pot (prioritizing pumpkins -> plants -> drones).
<color=black>•</color> Every 6th shot will instantly kill the plant he is targetting, regardless of damage absorption or reduction. If he is forced to switch lanes (excluding the zombie gloves), the shot count is reset.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>他是僵尸特种部队的阴影猎手。他蛰伏于最暗的角落，他瞄准于最静的瞬间，他决心成为究极阿尔法小队的爪牙。他倾听战歌，在迷雾的尽头为之接续余音，熟悉的旋律一直传唱到临终的刹那。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>He is the shadow hunter of the Zombie Special Forces. He lurks in the darkest corners, takes aim in the stillest moments, and is determined to become the ultimate member of the elusive Alpha Squad. He listens to the battle hymns, echoing their final notes from the edge of the mist — a familiar melody sung until his final breath.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
拥有锋利的黑曜石雪爪，伤害很高。

<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+4400（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>防寒等级1</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Possesses sharp obsidian iceclaws that deal tremendous damage.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>1000
<color=black>Toughness: </color>720 + 4400 (Type 1)
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium
<color=black>Traits: </color>Immune to Chill and Freeze. Vulnerable to Deep Chill.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>黑曜石雪爪僵尸喜欢沉思。他喜欢找个安静的地方坐下，用爪指轻抚自己饱经风霜的黑曜石脑袋，发出悦耳的沙沙声。任由思绪随时间飘散，又在某个时刻重新聚集，把他拉回现实。他看着自己刮下的黑曜石粉末，不由得感慨道：“哇哦，我帅到掉渣了！”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Obsidian Tall-nut Iceclaw Zombie loves to meditate. He likes to find a quiet place to sit down, gently stroking his weathered obsidian head with his claws, producing a pleasing rustling sound. He lets his thoughts drift with time, only to gather again at some moment, pulling him back to reality. Looking at the obsidian powder he scraped off, he can't help but exclaim: "Wow, I'm so cool I'm literally flaking!"</color>

zombie_fields.source:
驭巨鲸游弋阵前，激怒时暴起，并赋予樱桃瓦解之力。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>300（樱桃）
1000（爆炸樱桃）</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>300（非啃咬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>48000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等，狂暴时变为快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>领袖</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫冻结、定身。出场时为平静状态，此后每10秒在该状态和狂暴状态之间切换。进入狂暴状态时，无视植物向前跳跃3格。每0.5秒，视自身状态在随机一行获得1发对应子弹的火力支援</color>
<color=#3D1400>平静状态：</color><color=red>每2秒发射4发粉樱桃</color>
<color=#3D1400>狂暴状态：</color><color=red>速度翻倍。每1秒发射4发爆炸樱桃，且僵尸方爆炸樱桃在直击或溅射造成伤害前，施加“脆弱”效果
脆弱：每层持续15秒，最多叠加100层。每层使植物受到的伤害增加3%，受到樱桃爆炸时流失0.3%子弹攻击力的血量</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Harnessing the fury of the ancient giant whale, it leaps into the frontline, infusing Explosive Cherries with devastating power.

<color=black>Projectile Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>300 (Cherry)
1000 (Explosive Cherry)
<color=black>Damage: </color>300 (Non-bite)
<color=black>Toughness: </color>48000
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium; Fast when Enraged
<color=black>Traits:</color>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss. Immune to freeze and stuns.
<color=black>•</color> Starts in a Calm state upon entering the field, and thereafter switches between this state and the Enraged state every 10s.
<color=black>•</color> When entering the Enraged state, it ignores plants and leaps forward 3 tiles.
<color=black>•</color> Every 0.5s, depending on its current state, it receives 1 corresponding projectile as fire support in a random lane.
<color=black>Calm State: </color>Fires 4 Cherries every 2s.
<color=black>Enraged State: </color>Movement speed is doubled. Fires 4 Explosive Cherries every 1s. Furthermore, before the zombie's Explosive Cherry deals direct or splash damage, it applies the "weakened" effect. Each stack of "weakened" lasts 15s, stacking up to 100 times. Each stack increases damage taken by 3%, and causes plants to lose HP equal to 0.3% of the projectile's attack power when hit by explosive cherry explosions.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>少有人知晓暴烈的樱桃火山究竟在哪，但埃德加博士最终还是找到了它的位置，并从中带出了远古时期的樱桃巨鲸。一名勇敢的骑士接下了驯服它的任务，从此博士的部队中便总能传来震耳欲聋的爆炸声。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Few know the exact location of the raging Cherry Volcano, but Dr. Zomboss eventually found it and brought forth an ancient Cerasocetus. A brave knight took on the task of taming it, and since then, deafening explosions have constantly echoed through the doctor's ranks.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
召唤同位体上前吸引火力，自身则在空中潜行干扰。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000+6000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢，同位体则为快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行（持有气球）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>出场时在本列生成一个时空同位体</color>
<color=#3D1400>本体：</color><color=red>免疫三叶草效果。在空中时使3×3范围植物减少90%攻击力。被击落时在3×3范围内随机传送，获得韧性为2000的一类防具</color>
<color=#3D1400>同位体：</color><color=red>免疫伤害，速度×3，被击落、吹走或移动到地图左侧第二列时直接消失</color>
<color=#3D1400>弱点：</color><color=red>仙人掌坚果、仙人掌保护伞、究极黑曜石高坚果</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Summons an alternate self to step forward and draw fire, while he himself sneaks in the air to wreak havoc.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000 + 6000 (Type 1)
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Slow; Alternate Self is Fast
<color=black>Traits: </color>Spawns a spacetime alternate self in its lane upon entering the field
<color=black>Main Body: </color>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to Blover effects.
<color=black>•</color> While in the air, reduces the attack power of plants in a 3x3 area by 90%.
<color=black>•</color> When shot down, randomly teleports within a 3x3 area and gains a Type 1 armor with 2000 Toughness.
<color=black>Alternate Self: </color>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to damage, movement speed ×3.
<color=black>•</color> Disappears immediately when shot down, blown away, or moved to the second column from the left of the map.
<color=black>Weakness: </color>Thorn-nut, Umbrella Thorn, Obsidian Tall-nut</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>在被时空乱流拍扁又吹圆无数次后，超时空气球僵尸终于从异时空带回了另一个自己。“请问您为什么宁愿把异时空的自己带来，也不愿意到异时空去吃脑子？”答案是——异时空的他正是这么想的，现在，那个他正在帮他吸引火力。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>After being flattened and blown round countless times by spacetime turbulence, Astro Bucknut-copter Zombie finally brought back another version of himself from an alternate dimension. "Excuse me, why would you rather bring your alternate self here instead of going to the alternate dimension to eat brains?" Well now, this parallel version of him is helping by drawing fire away from him. He can eat more brains this way!</color>

zombie_fields.source:
驾驭着诅咒铁骑，一鼓作气冲向植物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>本体3000+战马6000（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快
冲锋时变为极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫击退。冲锋出场，撞到植物时施加该植物[5%×(植物血量+韧性)/2]的诅咒层数。随后稳步前进，碾压时施加[1%×(植物血量+韧性)/2]的诅咒层数。战马或本体被击杀时下马，回满并保留本体血量，变为黑橄榄僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>铁蹄荡川：冲锋结束时，施加诅咒的范围扩大至3×3</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>紧追不放：碾压类僵尸的碾压被抵抗时，受到的强制击退量减半</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Charges at plants riding a cursed steed in iron armor.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000 + 6000 (Type 2)
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium Fast; Extremely Fast when Charging
<color=black>Traits:</color>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to knockback.
<color=black>•</color> Rides a steed that crushes plants.
<color=black>•</color> Enters by charging; upon hitting a plant, applies [0.05 × (Plant HP + Toughness) / 2] curse stacks to that plant. Then advances steadily, applying [0.01 × (Plant HP + Toughness) / 2] curse stacks when crushing.
<color=black>•</color> When the steed is defeated, dismounts, fully restores HP, and transforms into a Giga Football Zombie.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Charging now applies curse stacks to plants in a 3×3 area
2. All crushing zombies now receive only half the knockback from anti-crush plants</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“这不公平！橄榄球就是要对抗的！难道我仅仅因为撞人太狠就要被判犯规吗？”黑橄榄骑兵僵尸愤愤不平道。“哦，当然不是。犯规的是您的马，您还是可以继续参赛的。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"This is unfair! Football is a contact sport! Am I really being penalized just for tackling too hard?" Black Knight Zombie grumbled indignantly. "Oh, certainly not. It was your horse that committed the foul; you may continue to participate in the match."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
驾驭着诅咒铁骑稳步推进，情势不利时召集部下进攻。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>80</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>本体4500+战马9000（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫击退。每1.5秒发射6发铁豌豆。碾压时，施加[1%×(植物血量+韧性)/2]的诅咒层数。本体血量低于50%时召唤一列黑橄榄骑兵僵尸。战马或本体被击杀时下马，回满并保留本体血量，变为机枪黑橄榄僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Advances steadily riding a cursed steed in iron armor, summoning his subordinates to attack when the situation turns unfavorable.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>80x6/1.5s
<color=black>Toughness: </color>4500 + 9000 (Type 2)
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium Fast
<color=black>Traits:</color>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to knockback.
<color=black>•</color> Rides a steed that crushes plants.
<color=black>•</color> When crushing, applies [0.01 × (Plant HP + Toughness) / 2] curse stacks. When base HP falls below 50%, summons a column of Black Knight Zombies. When the steed is defeated, dismounts, fully restores HP, and transforms into a Buckshot Commando Zombie.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>装备射程超远的强力机枪，为自己和坐骑穿戴坚韧的橄榄球服，用三份脑套餐买来骑士爵位，用旗帜指挥配合自己的战友，机枪黑橄榄骑兵团长从身体到名字都已经全副武装。“或许我们应该给他起一个简单点的名字，叫做坦克。”埃德加博士说道。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Equipped with a powerful, long-range Gatling gun, and clad in tough football gear for himself and his mount, Buckshot Knight Captain Zombie bought his knighthood with three brain combo meals. Using his flag to command and coordinate with his comrades, he is fully armed from body to name. "Perhaps we should give him a simpler name, like Tank," Dr. Zomboss remarked.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
可以向你的后排投掷被诅咒的玩偶匣。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>720+4400（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>持有不可被吸取的炸弹，一段时间后小概率自爆，大概率向最后列植物投掷。炸弹爆炸时释放玩偶匣爆炸，被扔出时仅造成1000物理伤害。炸弹会对炸到的植物（可被南瓜阻挡），或对将其弹走的叶子保护伞，施加[10%×(植物血量+韧性)/2]层诅咒</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>恶贯满盈：炸弹施加的诅咒量翻倍，且投掷6秒后重新获得诅咒玩偶匣</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>大变活尸：炸弹不会被保护伞弹走，且落地时召唤一个黑袍小丑王</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Can throw cursed Jack-in-the-Boxes from a distance.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720 + 4400 (Type 1)
<color=black>Traits: </color>
<color=black>•</color> Her Jack-in-the-Box cannot be attracted by magnets.
<color=black>•</color> Has a small chance of self-detonation after a short period of time, but a higher probability of throwing it at the last column of plants.
<color=black>•</color> When it self-detonates, it triggers a Jack-in-the-Box explosion, but the bomb box only deals 1000 physical damage when thrown. Either way, the bomb applies [10% × (Plant HP + Toughness) / 2] curse stacks to plants caught in the explosion or Umbrellas that have deflected the bomb.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:
</color><color=#4B0082>1. Curse stacks applied by the Bomb Box ×2 and regenerates a Bomb Box every 6s
2. Bomb Boxes are now immune to Umbrella deflection and spawns another Devil-in-the-Box Zombie upon landing</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>黑袍小丑王简直是墓园里的大忙人。她参加将军和大帅的棋局对弈，在每周末的中世纪歌剧表演中扮演铁面人，担任篮球队的中锋，假扮羊角魔鬼吓唬那些在河边乱跑的小鬼僵尸，剩下的时间都用来缝补自己在上述活动中扯破的衣服。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Devil-in-the-Box Zombie is practically the busiest zombie in the graveyard. She participates in chess matches between the Striker and the Archduke, plays the Man in the Iron Mask in the weekly medieval opera performances, serves as the center for the basketball team, and disguises herself as a horned devil to scare the Imp Zombies running around by the river. The rest of her time is spent mending the clothes she tore during these activities.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
护卫将帅，至死方休。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>18000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800（非啃咬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>巨型</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>仅在旗帜波登场。免疫魅惑、击退。不论阵营，为究极黑橄榄将军和究极黑橄榄大帅承伤。每第12次攻击造成碾压，并向前推动脚边的非boss僵尸0.74格</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>结群：一次出场3只</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>拱卫：每只在场时，全场领袖僵尸获得100点护甲</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Guards the General and Commander until death.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>18000
<color=black>Damage: </color>1800
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Slow
<color=black>Traits: </color>
<color=black>•</color> Only appears in Flag waves.
<color=black>•</color> Giant zombie. Immune to knockback and being hypnotized.
<color=black>•</color> Regardless of where it comes from, takes damage on behalf of the Giga Football Striker and Archduke Deathrider.
<color=black>•</color> Every 12th attack causes a crush, pushing non-mini-boss zombies at its feet forward by 0.74 tiles.
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers: </color>
1. Spawns in groups of 3
2. For each one present on the field, all Mini-boss Zombies gain 100 DR Value</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>在综合考虑墓园大小和物资补给后，埃德加博士决定黑橄榄巨象最多以三只为一小队。但将军和大帅对此提出了异议，三只象根本不够他们开一局象棋。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>After comprehensively considering the graveyard's size and material supplies, Dr. Zomboss decided that War Elephant Zombies should be deployed in squads of at most three. However, the Striker and the Archduke raised objections, arguing that three elephants are simply not enough for them to play a game of Chinese chess.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
将一队机枪黑橄榄僵尸运往战场。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫击退。无视植物。每行动0.1秒流失1%韧性的血量。会在第四列及其左侧立即死亡，死亡时生成4个机枪黑橄榄僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>防雪镀层：免疫冻结和黄油</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>驰援突进：迅速进场，但速度会逐渐降低</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Delivers a squad of 4 Buckshot Commando Zombies to the battlefield.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium
<color=black>Traits: </color>Immune to knockback. Ignores plants.
<color=black>•</color> Loses HP equal to 1% of its Toughness every 0.1 seconds.
<color=black>•</color> Instantly dies upon reaching the fourth column and to its left, spawning 4 Buckshot Commando Zombies upon death.
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
1. Now has immunity to Freeze and Butter
2. Now enters the battlefield rapidly, but its speed gradually decreases</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>四位机枪黑橄榄僵尸用他们一年的工资集资买下并改造了这辆加长款动力雪橇。虽然它的前任主人对冰上舞蹈颇有造诣，但比起《四小天鹅》，他们现在只打算给植物们表演“四大金刚”。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Four Giga Football-nut Zombie pooled a year's worth of salary to buy and modify this extended motorized sled. Although its previous owner was quite skilled in ice dancing, rather than performing the 'Dance of the Little Swans', they now only intend to perform the 'Four Heavenly Kings' for the plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
以翻滚穿隙入阵，凭利爪撕碎防线。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000+6000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>100</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等偏快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有80%击退抗性。啃咬会附加等于攻击力的诅咒层数。首次啃咬后进行翻滚，向前无视植物移动2.7格</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条1：</color><color=red>先声夺魁：黑武士及团长出场时立即翻滚一次</color>
<color=#3D1400>词条2：</color><color=red>乘胜追击：黑武士及团长每次翻滚后攻击力翻倍</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Rolls through gaps in the defenses and tears through plants with razor-sharp claws.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>100 (bite)
<color=black>Toughness: </color>3000 + 6000 (Type 1)
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium Fast
<color=black>Traits: </color>
<color=black>•</color> Has 80% knockback resistance. Bites apply Curse stacks equal to his attack power.
<color=black>•</color> After his first bite, performs a roll, moving forward 2.7 tiles while ignoring plants.
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
1. Roll once immediately on appearance
2. Deal ×2 damage after rolling</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>从小，旗帜黑橄榄武士最大的梦想就是收集所有比赛、对手和战斗中赢得的旗帜，并将它们佩戴在身上，以此展现自己的力量和技巧。虽然他至今还没能收集齐所有旗帜，但有一点可以肯定：他已经拥有了不少，而且每一面旗帜背后都有一段关于他如何获得它的漫长故事。
</color>
zombie_fields.english:
<align=left><color=black>Ever since Giga Football Acrobat Zombie was a kid, his biggest dream was to collect all the flags from his matches, enemies, and battles, and wear them as a way to show his power and skill. He still hasn't collected all the flags, but one thing is for sure: he's got quite a few of them, and each one carries a long story about how he obtained it.

-- Written by clarkstacks</color>

zombie_fields.source:
更强劲的黑橄榄武士，会以翻滚为号，召集部下进攻。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000+12000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>200</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>拥有80%击退抗性。啃咬会附加等于攻击力的诅咒层数。首次啃咬后进行翻滚，向前无视植物移动2.9格并召唤一列旗帜黑橄榄武士</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A stronger Football Acrobat Zombie who rallies his troops and launches attacks with his rolls.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>200 (bite)
<color=black>Toughness: </color>3000 + 12000 (Type 1)
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium Fast
<color=black>Traits: </color>
<color=black>•</color> Has 80% knockback resistance. Bites apply Curse stacks equal to his attack power.
<color=black>•</color> After his first bite, performs a roll, moving forward 2.9 tiles while ignoring plants, and summons a column of Giga Football Acrobat Zombies.
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
1. Roll once immediately on appearance
2. Deal ×2 damage after rolling</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>学习翻滚最需要的是什么？是天赋、技巧，还是夜以继日的苦练？“都不是！”黑橄榄高坚果武士团长给出了最终的答案，“学习翻滚需要的，是一颗足够坚硬的脑袋！”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>What is the most important thing for learning how to roll? Talent, technique, or tireless practice day and night? "None of those!" Giga Football-nut Acrobat Zombie gave the final answer: "What you need to learn how to roll is a head hard enough to withstand it!"</color>

zombie_fields.source:
被特种武装巨人召唤时，获得召唤者外表对应的能力。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1500</color>
<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>200</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>中等</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>根据召唤者（特种武装巨人）的外表，获得对应的能力
红眼：韧性×2
蓝眼：速度×2
黄眼：伤害×2
绿眼：一次出场两只</color>
zombie_fields.english:
When summoned by an Element-infused Gargantuar, gains abilities based on the summoner's appearance.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>200 (bite)
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1500</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Gains corresponding abilities based on the appearance of the summoner:
<color=red>• Flame-forged Imp:</color> Toughness ×2.
<color=blue>• Tide-tempered Imp:</color> Speed ×2.
<color=yellow>• Wind-charged Imp:</color> Attack damage ×2.
<color=green>• Soil-bound Imp:</color> Always come in twos.</color></color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>据说特种武装小鬼的铠甲是由一尊雕像雕刻时余下的边角料制成，质地坚硬，还有某种特殊的保护效果。绝大多数僵尸只把它当作一个故事，而那些选择相信的小鬼僵尸则会去沉睡的究极不朽高坚果身上敲打一番，希望能敲下一块来。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>It is said that the armor of the Element-infused Imps was made from leftover scraps carved from a statue. It is incredibly tough and possesses some kind of special protective effect. Most zombies dismiss it as nothing more than a story, but those Imps who choose to believe it will visit the sleeping Bedrock Tall-Nut Yeti and chip away at it, hoping to knock off a piece for themselves.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
以含苞姿态携着生机接近，于绽放时显露狰狞与死兆。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>48000 </color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>100</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极慢
绽放状态变为中等</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>领袖</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫寒冷、冻结、定身、击退。无视植物移动。以花苞状态出场，定期在该状态与绽放状态间切换。在场时，肥料不会在地图中生产，且只能用于解除火封，解除火封所需吸收的子弹数量提升至[245+5×自身韧性的立方根]。死亡时，解除全场植物的火封状态</color>
<color=#3D1400>花苞状态：</color><color=red>持续15秒。免疫伤害。每吸收[49+自身韧性的立方根]发子弹后，掉落一份肥料、流失3%血量、向后退缩、换行</color>
<color=#3D1400>绽放状态：</color><color=red>持续30秒。被攻击时略微退缩，幅度随伤害量提升。每5秒，使地图左上角生产一份僵尸肥料，并喷射火焰对前方6格所有植物造成伤害（飞行植物除外）</color>
<color=#3D1400>僵尸肥料：</color><color=red>火封一格植物。5秒内未使用时，也会随机对场上一株主位植物使用。无法对免疫火封的植物使用</color>
<color=#3D1400>火封：</color><color=red>巨型植物、火系植物、超级机械坚果免疫火封。期间不可与植物交互。吸收25发子弹或受到肥料效果后解除。由僵尸方解除火封时，对应植物会变为僵尸火红莲</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Approaches in a budding form, carrying signs of life, only to reveal its sinister nature and harbinger of death upon blooming.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>100 (Non-bite)
<color=black>Toughness: </color>48000
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Extremely Slow
<color=black>Traits:</color>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss. Immune to chill, freeze, knockback and stuns.
<color=black>•</color> Ignores plants while moving. Enters the battlefield in Bud Form and periodically switches between Bud Form and Bloomed Form.
<color=black>•</color> While present, prevents the lawn from producing plant Fertilizer, and increases the number of projectiles required to remove Wisped to [245 + 5 × the cube root of its Toughness]. Upon death, removes Wisped from all plants.
<color=black>Bud Form: </color>Lasts 15s. King Necroflame is immune to damage in this form. Disables using plant Fertilizer on plants. For every [49 + the cube root of its Toughness] projectiles absorbed, drops a bag of plant Fertilizer, loses 3% max HP, retreats backward, and changes lanes.
<color=black>Bloomed Form: </color>Lasts 30s. Slightly recoils when attacked, with the distance increasing based on damage taken. Every 5s, produces one Zombie Fertilizer in the top-left corner of the lawn and sprays flames forward, damaging all plants within 6 tiles (excluding flying plants). Check the mechanics almanac for explanations on Wisped effect and Zombie Fertilizer mechanics.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>在丛林深处，有着一株世纪之花：它的根茎连接着智慧树，喷出的焰蓝深火可焚烧万物，身体里藏着无数的灵魂欲火。起初大家都只把它当成一个传说，直到僵尸们真的发现了一根无边无际望不到尽头的黑黄根茎……
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Deep within the jungle lies a century-old flower: its roots are connected to the Tree of Wisdom, its blazing azure flames can burn all things, and countless souls filled with burning desires are hidden within its body. At first, everyone dismissed it as nothing more than a legend, until the zombies truly discovered an endless black-and-yellow root that stretched beyond sight....</color>

zombie_fields.source:
你那高墙和锐器不过是虚无缥缈的泡影。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>90000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>免疫冻结、定身、换行，会秒杀接触的魅惑僵尸。出场时为冲阵状态，此后每次入场随机改变状态</color>
<color=#A86A44>冲阵状态：</color><color=red>向前方插入三支将旗。通过接触，将植物转化为黑橄榄副将。移动至第二列时，重新入场</color>
<color=#A86A44>滚动状态：</color><color=red>移速固定。将接触的植物转化为究极黑橄榄将军。在场上来回滚动，每当移动至第二列或最右侧一列时换行。20秒后重新入场</color>
<color=#A86A44>将旗：</color><color=red>每5秒召唤一次橄榄类僵尸，共5次召唤</color>
zombie_fields.english:
<color=red>Your towering walls are nothing but fleeting illusions.</color>

<color=black>Toughness: </color>90000
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Fast
<color=black>Traits:</color>
<color=black>•</color> Boss. Immune to freeze, knockback, stuns, and lane-switching effects. Instantly kills any hypnotized zombies it touches. Enters in Charge Formation state when spawned, then changes state each time he re-enters.
<color=black>• Charge Formation:</color> Enters from the right side of the field, planting 3 banners ahead of himself. Each banner spawns a Football-type zombie every 5s for 5 and lasts 5 summons. Attacks convert plants into Giga Football-nut Leader Zombies. Retreats and re-enters the field upon reaching the 2nd column.
<color=black>• Acrobat Formation:</color> Rolls back and forth across the lawn, changing lanes whenever he reaches the 2nd or rightmost column and converts all plants encountered into Giga Football Strikers. Retreats and re-enters the lawn after 20s.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>战争是永不落幕的盛大戏剧。这是将军重临战场的诺言。他解放禁锢在战旗中的冤魂，释放深藏于体内的力量。战败后的复仇？亦或是胜利后的追击？将军都不在意，他享受的，是战争本身。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=red>War is a grand drama with no final act. This is Last Striker's promise to return to the battlefield. He frees the vengeful spirits bound within his war banners and unleashes the power buried within him. Revenge after defeat? Or pursuit after victory? He cares not. It is the war itself that he enjoys.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>这是世界巡演的终站，这是舞台传奇的绝唱，全世界的歌迷都聚集于此，参加这最后的疯狂。歌舞一遍遍重来，谁都不愿意就此结束，舞台的烟雾腾起，只为遮挡住不舍的目光。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=red>This is the final frontier of his world tour, the swan song of a stage legend. Fans from around the galaxy have gathered for one last show of madness. The songs and dances go on again and again; no one wants it to end. Stage smoke rises, if only to hide the reluctant eyes of those who cannot bear to say goodbye.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>冰封三叉戟僵尸是生活在北极圈最著名的渔夫。他的鱼叉用来捕捉冰层下最新鲜的活鱼，高坚果脑袋用来敲开保存了几十年的冻鱼。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Harpooneer Frost Tall-nut Zombie is the most famous fisherman in the Arctic Circle. His harpoon is used to catch the freshest live fish beneath the ice, while his Tall-nut head is used to crack open frozen fish that have been preserved for decades.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
发怒时会发生大量爆炸樱桃的学者僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>400</color>
<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>1500+1500（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>1级僵尸。拥有学者僵尸的特点。失去报纸后，每0.5秒发射4颗爆炸樱桃子弹</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Fires a rapid barrage of explosive cherry rounds when angered.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>400 (bite) 1000 (explosive cherry)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1500 + 1500 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 1 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Inherits traits from Scholar Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> After losing his paper, fires 4 explosive cherry bullets every 0.5s.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“总有什么比眼前的数学游戏更重要，比如楼外的蒹葭，比如今晚的夜色”，樱桃机枪学者僵尸喃喃道，“等我解决完这道数独，一定要去亲自感受。不过嘛，它实在是有些难度。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"There's always more to life than just math puzzles… like the reed outside the window… or tonight's moonlight," mumbles Gatling Cherry Scholar Zombie. "But first, I really need to solve this Sudoku. It's… surprisingly hard."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
不发怒时也能发射爆炸樱桃的学者僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>400</color>
<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000+3000（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>2级僵尸。拥有樱桃机枪学者僵尸的特点。失去报纸前，每1.5秒发射4发爆炸樱桃子弹</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Fires explosive cherries even before getting angry.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>400 (bite) 1000 (explosive cherry)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000 + 3000 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 2 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Inherits traits from previous tier(s).
<color=black>•</color> Fires 4 explosive cherries every 1.5s even before losing his newspaper.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>樱桃机枪学士僵尸是僵尸国际大学的著名爆炸学讲师，如果不是Z教授一再邀请并且保证花园里有他喜欢的东西，他可不会放下身段来这里。“好在Z教授没说错，”樱桃机枪学士僵尸说，“我最喜欢的三样东西，樱桃派，爆破，以及玩祖玛，这里都能满足。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>A renowned demolition lecturer at Zombie International University, Gatling Cherry Bachelor Zombie only agreed to come after Professor Cherryz promised three things: cherry pie, big explosions, and Zuma. "Good ol' Cherryz wasn't wrong," he says.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
背上乃是毕业所制，若有触怒后果自负。

<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>400</color>
<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000+6000（二类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>3级僵尸。拥有樱桃机枪学士僵尸的特点，破报时会抄起背后的弹匣，然后每0.5秒额外发射1发子弹</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Graduated magna cum bombis — ready to show it.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>400 (bite) 1000 (explosive cherry)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000 + 6000 (Type 2)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 3 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Inherits traits from previous tier(s).
<color=black>•</color> When angered, picks up his ammo pack and fires 1 extra cherry every 0.5s.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>为了在爆炸学领域进一步发展，樱桃机枪硕士僵尸准备去遥远的地方求学，看他背后背着的一筐樱桃派就知道，他已经做好了背井离乡的准备。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>To advance in explosive sciences, Gatling Cherry Doctor Zombie is heading abroad. His cherry pie stash strapped to his back? Just part of being prepared.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
装备着新式漆黑盔甲的橄榄球员。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000+6000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>1级僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A linebacker geared for stealth.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000 + 6000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>Tier 1 Evolved Zombie.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>也许是厌倦了万众瞩目的感觉，黑橄榄僵尸刻意抹去了身上一切的鲜红，换上更易在黑夜中遁藏的黑色橄榄球服。不过这身装扮让他看起来不像什么好人，每当他路过银行的时候，门口的保安都会不自觉地攥紧了警棍。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Tired of the spotlight, Giga Football Zombie swapped out his bright red jersey for a pitch-black one that blends into the night. Unfortunately, the new look makes him resemble a bank robber more than a footballer.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
黑夜中无畏的冲锋者，一个精锐的战士。

<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>100</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>12000+12000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>2级僵尸。每3秒回复5%韧性的血量</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A hardened warrior, fearless in the dark.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>12000 + 12000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 2 Evolved Zombie. 
<color=black>•</color> Regenerates 5% max HP every 3s.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>从神秘而幽暗的诡境秘闻中走来，黑暗，凶险，混乱已成为黑橄榄队长深不可测的代名词。无人知晓他来自何方，无人敢于探听他的过往。对于这两点，他本人其实也不知之甚详，所谓的过去对他而言不过像一场长久的清醒梦，在天明日出之际，又如同雾霭般散去。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Emerging from the depths of an eerie realm, Giga Football-nut Elite Zombie is a living mystery. He embodies being dark, dangerous, and disoriented. Even he can't recall his origins, only that the past feels like a lucid dream that fades with dawn.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
将军的得力副手之一，近程攻击极其残忍。

<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>200</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>24000+24000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>3级僵尸。免疫击退、寒冷、冻结、黄油。每3秒回复5%韧性的血量，啃咬会使植物1秒内无法回血且受到伤害×3</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Tears through the frontlines with ruthless power.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>200 (bite)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>24000 + 24000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 3 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Inherits traits from previous tier(s).
<color=black>•</color> Immune to knockback, chill, freeze, and butter.
<color=black>•</color> Bites disable plant healing and make victims receive triple damage for 1s.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>作为黑橄榄将军最得力的辅助者，军队武官中的二号人物，黑橄榄副将一直备受上级的器重和下属的爱戴。他能力出群，忠心耿耿，对每一个指令都深信不疑，除了一件事：为什么表彰会上颁发的是勋章而不是新鲜的脑子？
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Right-hand zombie to the Striker, Giga Football-nut Leader is admired by subordinates and trusted by command. He's loyal, skilled, and confused why commendations never come in the form of fresh brains.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
将军的得力副手之一，远程火力如雨倾泻。

<color=#3D1400>子弹伤害：</color><color=red>80</color>
<color=#3D1400>啃咬伤害：</color><color=red>200</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>24000+24000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>3级僵尸。免疫击退、寒冷、冻结、黄油。每0.1秒发射一发铁豌豆子弹</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Suppressive fire that doesn't cease.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>200 (bite) 80/0.1s (iron pea)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>24000 + 24000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 3 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Immune to knockback, chill, freeze, and butter.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>黑橄榄机枪副将在战场上所向披靡、铁面无私、令人生畏。而在战场外，他却是饱受士兵们喜爱的长官，他最喜欢向士兵们表演自己的绝技——旗帜藏子弹。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Feared on the battlefield, beloved off it. Giga Buckshot Leader dazzles troops with his signature trick: hiding bullets in his banner.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
与伴舞者一同换上白色西装的舞王僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>1级僵尸。出场3秒内太空步进场，随后召唤4个白色撑杆舞王</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Enters in moonwalk with backup dancers.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 1 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Enters with 3s moonwalk, then summons 4 Super Dancing Pole Vaulters.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>作为僵尸歌界的绝对巨星，白衣舞王僵尸无论走到哪里都被一群粉丝拥簇。他最近正在考虑去学习一下舞蹈步伐，既是为了配合自己即将要进行的全球巡演，也是为了能够快速躲避不理智的狂热粉丝。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Zombie pop idol and fan-favorite, Sergeant Michael Zombie can't go anywhere without a swarm of screaming fans. He's learning new moves not just for his global tour, but to dodge fangirls.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
以太空滑步疾驰入场的白衣舞王僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>2级僵尸。出场3秒内滑步进场，抵达第四列右侧或被植物阻挡时结束。随后召唤4个白色撑杆舞王</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Moonwalks in style, then rallies the crowd.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 2 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Enters with a 3s sliding moonwalk. On reaching 4th column or being blocked, ends moonwalk and then summons 4 Super Dancing Pole Vaulters.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>美丽的步伐，鬼魅般的舞姿。埃德加舞蹈学院这种二流货色已经不能满足这位天才。从杰克逊舞蹈学院学成归来的舞王将会拍一部MV宣告他的蜕变。别忘记把他的拿手绝技——45°鞠躬拍下来——如果你能打过他的追秒草保镖……
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>At the peak of fame, power, and performance, Commander Michael Zombie just needs a stage to share his joy with the world.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
土豪金拉风入场，伴舞团八方而至。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>12000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>3级僵尸。出场3秒内无视植物滑步进场，抵达第四列右侧时结束。随后会在周围召唤8个白色撑杆舞王</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Stylish arrival, dazzling encore.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>12000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 3 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Ignores plants for 3s while sliding in with a moonwalk to the 4th column. Then summons 8 Super Dancing Pole Vaulters.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>现在登场的，是名声、技术、体能都处在巅峰时刻的绝对巨星！是闪光灯下最耀眼的那一抹亮色。巡演舞王指挥官现在需要的，仅仅只是一座精心搭建的舞台，让他把快乐传递给所有爱他的人。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Dashing steps, haunting twirls. The dance prodigy has outgrown the Edgar Academy. Now, fresh from Jackson Dance Academy, he's shooting an MV with his bodyguard's help. Don't forget to film his signature 45° bow — if you survive.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
机鱼公司研发的新式舰艇。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>1级僵尸</color>
