zombie_fields.english:
Edgar's latest mass-produced submarine unit.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 1 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Moves swiftly in water lanes, crushing any plants in its path, dealing 500 Damage to anti-crush plants.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>来自机鱼公司敌对企业的仿制品，据说拥有和原版潜艇完全一样的性能，但机鱼公司坚称这个仿制品会漏水。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>A knockoff developed by a rival of Gfishtus Corps. It's said to perform identically to the original, but Gfishtus insists this model leaks.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
装备近程玩偶匣炮弹，持续轰炸前排植物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>2级僵尸。每1.5秒向前方2格发射一枚炮弹，命中时释放玩偶匣爆炸</color>
<color=#3D1400>炮弹特点：</color><color=red>受到1000伤害后消除</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Lobs bombs nonstop at the frontline.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 2 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Fires 1 bomb every 1.5s aimed at 2 tiles ahead. The bomb explodes like a Jack-in-the-Box explosion but can be shot down if it takes 1000 damage mid-air.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“完美无缺”的武器被高估了，海量导弹编织成的空中全覆盖弹幕火力网才能真正帮助僵尸们导向胜利！而这张大网的编织者，便是这种由布雷艇改装而来的水中移动导弹发射井。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"Flawless" weapons are overrated. A true victory lies in overwhelming missile fire raining from the skies. This modified mine-layer submarine functions as a mobile underwater missile silo, the starter of that fire.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
配备了涡轮动力引擎，能在水路迅速冲锋。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>2级僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Blitzes the water lanes at reckless speed.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 2 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Rushes down water lane plants with extreme speed.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>冲锋机械舰艇僵尸的作战目标是快速冲入并扰乱敌方阵型，为后续部队提供火力盲区。一些学者指出这种潜艇为了速度舍弃了太多其他性能，不过它的设计者埃德加博士却不以为然——毕竟他所需要的只有“前进，前进，不择手段的前进”。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>This turbo-powered sub's sole purpose: charge into and disrupt enemy lines, creating weak spots for allies to attack. Critics say it sacrifices too much for speed, but Edgar shrugs—"All I need is moving forward, at all costs."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
装备远程巡航导弹，上浮时精准打击后排植物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>12000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>3级僵尸。默认处于潜水状态，前方有植物时上浮并停止移动，每1.5秒向最后一列植物发射2枚炮弹，命中时释放造成物理伤害的玩偶匣爆炸</color>
<color=#3D1400>炮弹特点：</color><color=red>受到1000伤害后消除。可被三叶草效果吹飞</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Rises to bombard the backline with cruise missiles.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>12000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 3 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Enters the field submerged. Surfaces when there are plants in its lane and stops moving.
<color=black>•</color> While surfaced, fires 2 missiles every 1.5s aimed at the last column. The missile explodes like a Jack-in-the-Box explosion but can be shot down if it takes 1000 damage mid-air or blown away by Blovers.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>这是极致的战场主宰，这是埃德加博士与机鱼公司智慧的结晶，它诞生之日，天空都忍不住降下雷霆庆贺。在解决了炮弹进水的问题后，这艘兵器再也没有了缺陷。“是的，除了水草缠绕螺旋桨的老问题外，再也没有缺陷了。”埃德加博士说。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The ultimate battlefield dominator, this submarine is the brainchild of Edgar and Gfishtus Corps. After solving the missile flooding issue, it's now flawless, except for seaweed occasionally jamming the propeller.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
水路的钢铁猛兽，宛若战场之矛。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>12000</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>极快</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>3级僵尸。出场0.3秒后1次，使半径1.5格僵尸的速度×2（至多叠加2次）</color>
zombie_fields.english:
The steel spear of the water lanes.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>12000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 3 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Charges at extreme speed, cutting through water lane plants.
<color=black>•</color> Once per unit, 0.3s after its appearance, doubles movement speed of all zombies in a 3×3 area (stackable up to 2 times).</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>作为埃德加博士苦心孤诣多年研发的最新科技，这种舰艇无疑代表了僵尸界最高的智慧结晶。由于它启动时超高的加速度，登上它的全体艇员都被要求通过严苛的离心机测试——“好像有十个机械巨人僵尸压在身上一样”，一位有幸参与过的僵尸说道。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Edgar's proudest innovation, designed for maximum acceleration. All crew must pass brutal G-force centrifuge tests. "It's like ten Gargantuars sat on you," says one survivor.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
向最后排植物扔出三叉戟。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000+3000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>1级僵尸。出场6~9秒或被植物阻挡后，向最后一列植物连续投射共4发三叉戟。三叉戟造成植物当前血量20%的伤害，最低60</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Throws tridents at your backline.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000 + 3000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 1 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> 6-9s after entering or when blocked, throws 4 tridents at the last column.
<color=black>•</color> Each trident causes damage to plants equal to 20% (minimum of 60) of their current Toughness.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>穿上防水的渔衣，带上锋利的鱼叉，再细心擦拭干净代表好运的水靴，新一轮的捕鱼开始了。哦，别忘了戴上头盔，防备来自没捕到鱼的同行的背刺。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Wearing waterproof overalls and wielding a shiny trident, he's ready to fish. Don't forget the helmet — it's less for protection from plants, more for defense against jealous fishermen.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
随机扔出三叉戟，被它瞧上也只好听天由命。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000+6000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>2级僵尸。出场6~9秒或被植物阻挡后，向4格外植物连续随机投射共8发三叉戟（不会被宝石伞类吸引）。自身扔出的三叉戟基础伤害增加100</color>
zombie_fields.english:
You can't dodge what he targets.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000 + 6000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 2 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> 6-9s after entering or when blocked, throws 8 tridents at random plants 4 tiles ahead (unaffected by Umbrellas).
<color=black>•</color> Base trident damage +100.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>带上增强视力的滴眼液，准备好足够数量的鱼叉，再戴上保护自己的高坚果头盔，新一轮的捕鱼开始了。捕鱼的诀窍在于背刺那些能捕到鱼的同行。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Armed with eye drops and a reinforced Tallnut helmet, he's ready to spear the catch of the day, or his rivals.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
强而有力地扔出散射的集束三叉戟。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>12000+12000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>3级僵尸。出场6~9秒或被植物阻挡后，奋力投射共12发集束三叉戟，掷出后会对4格外每格植物分裂出1发三叉戟。自身扔出的三叉戟基础伤害增加300</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Tridents rain down in scattershot.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>12000 + 12000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 3 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> 6-9s after entering or when blocked, throws 12 cluster tridents.
<color=black>•</color> Splits into 1 extra trident for each plant 4 tiles ahead. 
<color=black>•</color> Base trident damage +300.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>深海三叉戟骁将原本应该是驾驶冲车的精英部队，看他携带的三叉戟数量就知道。但他没能通过头部大小测试、有摇头导致冲车侧翻的危险，因此依然是一个步兵。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>A mighty warrior once slated for forklift duty — until he failed the helmet size test. So now he simply hurls more tridents, harder.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
使用下界合金锻造的装备的矿镐僵尸，挖掘速度极快。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000+3000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>1级僵尸。每次攻击都会赋予植物1000挖掘值，累计挖掘值超过植物血量时将其秒杀</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Fastest digger in the Nether mines.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000 + 3000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 1 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Each attack adds 2000 mining progress to the plant. If mining progress exceeds the plant's HP, the plant is instantly destroyed.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>下界合金制造矿镐，下界合金制作的许可证，矿镐僵尸开始了他的煤炭事业，想在火红莲女王那里卖个高价。但是猪灵集团的凋零骷髅产业链似乎更胜一筹。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>With a netherite pickaxe and forged mining license, this zombie set off to strike a coal deal with Queen Endoflame — though Piglin Corp's Wither Skeleton trafficking ring might prove stiff competition.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
可以挖掘地道，只是容易找不着北。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000+6000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>2级僵尸。每次攻击赋予2000挖掘值。在地下时，会在3~9列随机出土</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Digs tunnels but gets easily lost.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000 + 6000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 2 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Each attack adds 4000 mining progress to the plant.
<color=black>•</color> Digs underground and his drill cannot be pulled by Magnet-shrooms while underground.
<color=black>•</color> Emerges randomly between columns 2-8.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>下界合金钻僵尸在最近的几次挖掘大赛上表现亮眼，他当众表扬了自己的装备——下界合金制造的、用岩浆驱动的钻头。不过他没有告诉大家的是，他的头盔也是下界合金制造的。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Praised at excavation contests for his lava-fueled netherite drill. Though he always forgets to mention that his hoe is also netherite, the dedication!</color>

zombie_fields.source:
可以携带其他僵尸在地道中前进。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>12000+12000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>3级僵尸。每次攻击赋予4000挖掘值。出场时携带附近的非载具僵尸一起潜入地下，会与携带的僵尸一同在3~9列出土</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Leads other zombies underground in one big dig.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>12000 + 12000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 3 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Each attack adds 8000 mining progress to the plant.
<color=black>•</color> Inherits traits from previous tier(s).
<color=black>•</color> Enters underground with nearby non-vehicle zombies. They emerge together later.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>他是僵尸挖掘大队的队长，每次出场都前呼后拥，据说这家伙正野心勃勃地准备建造属于自己的挖掘帝国。但埃德加博士对这个说法不屑一顾：“那只是因为头盔遮住了视线，让他总是挖穿其他僵尸的墓地，所以僵尸才一直跟着他。”
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Head of the Zombie's Nether Mining Bureau followed by hundreds of eager, labor-worthy zombies, he dreams of a mining empire. Edgar scoffs: "He just keeps tunneling into other zombies' graves since he's blinded by his helmet. That's why they're always chasing him."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
驾驶坚固战车的舞王僵尸。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>1级僵尸。拥有100点护甲。死亡时生成一个舞王僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Disco zombie driving a reinforced vehicle.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 1 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Crushes plants. Has an inherit +100 DR value.
<color=black>•</color> Spawns a standard Michael Zombie upon death.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>冲锋，再冲锋，碾压一切！舞装战车僵尸所向披靡，无人能挡，直到他遇到了草坪中间的大河。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Charge, charge again, crush everything! The Zomboni plowed through the field with unstoppable momentum, until it met the pond in the middle of the lawn.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
驾驶的舞装战车嵌套了一层备用轻胄外壳。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>12000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>2级僵尸。拥有200点护甲。死亡时生成一个舞装战车僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Michael Zombie's vehicle now includes an extra layer of light armor.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>12000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 2 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Crushes plants. Has an inherit +200 DR value.
<color=black>•</color> Spawns a Plated Michael Zomboni upon death.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“我们给车头配上了更多的分层！”新改装车让舞王僵尸爱不释手，唯一可惜的是每一层的夹缝不足以塞下更多的伴舞。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"We've added more layers to the front armor!" The newly refurbished vehicle is now the pride of Michael Zombie, though he regrets that the gaps between the armor layers still aren't wide enough to stuff in more backup dancers.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
驾驶的舞装战车嵌套了两层备用重甲钢板。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>24000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>3级僵尸。拥有300点护甲。死亡时生成一个轻甲舞装战车僵尸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Michael Zombie's vehicle now includes two layers of heavy steel armor.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>24000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 3 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Crushes plants. Has an inherit +300 DR value.
<color=black>•</color> Spawns a Armored Michael Zomboni upon death.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>这辆车极为厚重的装甲为它赢得了“陆地战列舰”的美称。最近，舞王僵尸又诞生了一个改装构想：把底盘换成传动履带，在车上安装上层炮塔与长管火炮——他认为这将是伟大的新发明。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>This vehicle's extremely thick armor has earned it the nickname "Battleship on Land". Lately, Michael Zombie has come up with yet another bold new design: swap the base for treads, install a multi-layer turret, and mount a long-barreled cannon. He believes this will be a truly original invention.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
使用新式炸弹跳杆的跳跳僵尸，磁性偏弱且不易脱手。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000+3000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>1级僵尸。拥有跳跳僵尸的特点，弹跳杆不会因伞类击退而失去。被击杀时，若持有弹跳杆则释放玩偶匣爆炸</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Pogo zombie with a modern explosive-loaded pogo stick. Only slightly magnetic and difficult to disarm.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000 + 3000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 1 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Inherits Clown-on-the-Pogo Zombie traits.
<color=black>•</color> Does not lose pogo stick if knocked back by Umbrellas.
<color=black>•</color> If killed while still holding the stick, triggers a Jack-in-the-Box explosion.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>不要去打扰他，这家伙最近正处在恋爱期，不要和他谈任何关于这场恋爱的悲观话题，不然的话，会收获爆炸一般的报复。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Don't bother him—he's in love. He's not in the mood to hear your pessimistic take on his romance, and if you try, you'll be met with an explosively emotional response.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
为炸弹跳杆加装了一次性蓄力弹射装置。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000+6000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>2级僵尸。拥有玩偶匣跳跳僵尸的特点。在右半场生成时，蓄力5秒后，大跳约4格远</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Equipped with a single-use charger for his explosive pogo stick.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000 + 6000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 2 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Inherits the traits of Knight Clown-on-the-Pogo Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> If spawned on the right half of the field, charges up for 5s and then makes a long leap of about 4 tiles.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>他曾经面临着玩偶匣，西瓜，跳跳杆滞销的难题，于是向投篮车僵尸求教，“你得把西瓜与玩偶匣联系起来想一想。”看得出来，他获得了爆炸性的成功。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>He once struggled with poor sales of pogo sticks, watermelons, and jack-in-the-boxes. So he consulted Catapult Zombie. "You've got to imagine the watermelon and jack-in-the-box as one," the advice went. Judging by the explosive success, it worked.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>在花费了许多时间后，他终于从失恋的痛苦中走出。现在这家伙打扮得花枝招展，正准备向新的女神献爱。可怜的家伙，他的新目标是究极玩偶匣皇后，希望他的承受能力比过去强。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>After much time, he's finally overcome the pain of his breakup. Now he's dressed in flashy colors and ready to court a new goddess. He's now pursuing Queen Jill-in-the-Box. Hopefully, his emotional stamina has improved.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
定期投下玩偶匣炸弹的基洛夫飞艇。

<color=#3D1400>炸弹伤害：</color><color=red>500（玩偶匣）</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>1级僵尸。每1.5秒投下炸弹。被究极星星子弹命中20次时坠机</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A Kirov airship that periodically drops Jack-in-the-Box bombs.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>500/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 1 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Crashes if hit 20 times with Magnet Cactus or Magnetar projectiles.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>配件可不是大风刮来的，对于小规模的战术轰炸，也许更加轻量化的小型飞艇更加适合。也许机鱼公司在设计飞艇的时候应该和埃德加博士打个招呼，这样还能少吃一个官司。
</color>
zombie_fields.english:
<align=left><color=black>Since top-of-the-line parts aren't windfall, Gfishtus Corps thought it would be cost efficient to make a simplified model for lower scale attacks. Though ultimately they just made an airship that is uncannily similar to Dr. Zomboss' original model...

- Written by Mr. Etc.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
搭载了特制迷你基洛夫的空中母舰。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>2级僵尸。每3秒召唤1个自身0.1倍韧性的迷你基洛夫。被究极星星子弹命中30次时坠机</color>
zombie_fields.english:
An aerial mothership that deploys Kirovs Drones.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 2 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Every 3s, summons a Kirov Drone with 0.1× its own HP.
<color=black>•</color> Crashes if hit 30 times with Magnet Cactus or Magnetar projectiles.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>基洛夫母舰飞艇是机鱼公司的核心产品，机鱼公司声称这些无人机运用了最新技术。可是如果仔细观察僚机残骸的话，总会发现一些用红色油漆喷涂的CCCP字样。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The Kirov mothership is a core product of Gfishtus Corps, and the company claims it uses cutting-edge drone technology. But if you examine the debris of its minions closely, you'll often find "Recycled" painted in red.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
搭载了极速物理轰炸机的空中母舰。

<color=#3D1400>炸弹伤害：</color><color=red>300</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>12000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>飞行</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>3级僵尸。每3秒发射2个极速轰炸机，迅速轰炸前方一行植物。被究极星星子弹命中40次时坠机</color>
zombie_fields.english:
An aerial supremacy that deploys rapid carpet bombers.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>300/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>12000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 3 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Every 3s, summons 2 Supersonic Bombers to quickly decimate the lane.
<color=black>•</color> Crashes if hit 40 times with Magnet Cactus or Magnetar projectiles.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>高空突防！察打一体！火力覆盖！无人信息化作战！机鱼重工隆重推出小型飞艇2.0！它简直毫无缺点，除了过短的航程让它不得不作为更大的空中母舰的僚机，而母舰的费用则是单独结算的。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>High-altitude infiltration! Integrated recon and assault! Total firepower coverage! Fully digitalized unmanned combat! Gfishtus Corps proudly presents Kirov 2.0! It's the ultimate beast, except for the ridiculously short flight range that relegates it to being a mere frigate under a larger mothership. The mothership, of course, is sold separately.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
阴煞凝尸，僵体爆而草木伤。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>250（非啃咬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>1级僵尸。被击杀时，对3×3范围造成125伤害</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A reanimated spirit that explodes upon death, harming all green life in its wake.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>250 (Non-bite)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 1 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> When killed by damage, deals 125 damage to all plants in a 3×3 area.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>余自幼家贫，幸赖富商解囊、得以致学。后入朝为官，强项直言，朝野皆言昏君无道，然余所奏，陛下虽不纳、亦无责罚，以为并非昏庸无度。后得知，乃昏君耳背之故也。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Born into poverty, I was fortunate to be sponsored by a wealthy patron and gained an education. I later served as an upright official, speaking frankly at court. People said the Emperor was a tyrant, yet though he ignored my counsel, he never punished me. Only later did I learn: the Emperor was deaf.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
翻堂越户，飞僵起而阴风至。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>500（非啃咬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>2级僵尸。每4~8秒，无视植物突进2格并造成伤害。被击杀时，对3×3范围造成250伤害</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A phantasmal spectre that cuts through barriers with ghostly force.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>500 (Non-bite)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 2 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Every 4-8 seconds, dashes forward for up to 2 tiles, ignoring plants and dealing damage.
<color=black>•</color> When killed by damage, deals 250 damage to all plants in a 3×3 area.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>飞僵夜行，群友皆散，路遇两植拦路。飞僵怒，以手抢之，一植卧地，一植以身阻拦。飞僵暴起，穿植而过，又数击以灭之。植亦强矣，而顷刻两毙，其能几何哉？止增笑耳。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>The night wraith soared, scattering all allies. Two plants stood in its path. Enraged, it struck — one fell, and the other tried to resist. The wraith burst forward, piercing both, and finished them off with brutal strikes. Brave they were, but both perished in an instant. What more could they do? Laughable.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
穿雷掠影，伏尸现而鬼将避。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1000（非啃咬）</color>
<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>12000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>3级僵尸。在右半场时每4~8秒，可以无视至多4格植物以尽可能穿梭至本行植物最后方，且对沿途造成伤害，若没有可无视的植物则穿梭1格。在左半场尝试穿梭时会封印此技能。被击杀时，对3×3范围造成500伤害</color>
zombie_fields.english:
A wraith that phases through plants and strikes with imperial wrath.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>300/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>12000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 3 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> On the right side of the lawn, every 4-8 seconds, phases through up to 4 tiles ignoring plants, reaching as far into the row as possible and dealing damage along the way. If no bypassable plants are present, dashes forward 1 tile instead.
<color=black>•</color> On the left side, attempting to phase disables this skill.
<color=black>•</color> When killed by damage, deals 500 damage to all plants in a 3×3 area.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>史望者，酆都人也。幼时语人：“吾能见彼处玉玺，乃吾家之宝。”闻者皆笑。年二十四，岁大饥，史望揭竿而起，定酆都，自王。受玺，相玺脱手，绝面。彼岁又大饥，已而复为义军所逐，幸得亡走。其舌为玉玺所伤，人问名姓，讷讷言“尸皇”而已。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Li Chi-hsing, a native of Fengdu, once said as a boy, "I can see a jade seal there — it belongs to my family." Everyone laughed. At 24, amid famine, he rose in rebellion and declared himself king of Fengdu. When he received the jade seal, it scorched his face. The next year brought another famine. He was ousted, barely escaping with his life. His tongue wounded by the seal, when asked his name, he could only mumble: "I'm Li..ch.."</color>

zombie_fields.source:
倾泻少量三叉戟。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>1级僵尸。每次攻击发射4个三叉戟，装填后可再发射一次，然后前进。三叉戟固定落点在前方5到7格</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Unleashes a small wave of tridents.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 1 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Attacks by firing 4 tridents at once, can reload and fire again once, then resumes moving forward and crushing plants. Tridents land 5-7 tiles ahead.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>“正当梨花开遍了天涯，河上飘着柔曼的轻纱”轻装三叉戟冲车从泛黄的书中看到了这首歌谣，和它背后的的传奇故事。不过他似乎忘了火箭弹需要发动机提供动力，否则根本飞不远。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>"When pear blossoms bloom across the land, the river flows beneath soft gauze." Trident Light Hwacha read this ballad in a yellowing book, moved by the legend behind it. Unfortunately, it did not understand that rockets need engines to fly far.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
倾泻大量三叉戟。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>3000+3000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>2级僵尸。拥有轻装三叉戟冲车的特点，每次发射的三叉戟数量增至14发</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Unleashes a larger wave of tridents.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000 + 3000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 2 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Inherits traits of Trident Light Hwacha but fires 14 tridents per salvo.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>冲车的三叉戟投掷训练十分特别。由于无法调整弹道，驾驶员只能调整冲车位置进行打靶训练。“微调……再微调……”啪！冲车翻进了旁边的池塘。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Training with the Trident Medium Hwacha involves unique precision drills. Since the tridents can't change trajectory mid-air, the driver must reposition the entire cart for aiming. "Adjust slightly… more… just a bit—" Splash! The cart tumbles into a nearby pond.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
倾泻大量三叉戟，装载的三叉戟拥有殉爆式散射能力。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>6000+6000（一类）</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>碾压</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>3级僵尸。拥有重装三叉戟冲车的特点。死亡时，未投射的三叉戟会在本行半径约3.5格内随机散落并伤害植物</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Unleashes tridents that scatter on death.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>6000 + 6000 (Type 1)</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 3 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Inherits traits of Trident Medium Hwacha.
<color=black>•</color> Upon death, unused tridents scatter randomly within 3.5 tiles in its lane, damaging all plants hit.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>一名精英三叉戟战士带着丰富的经验和优秀的战绩来到冲车营，作为新的驾驶员。他曾在雪原捕猎过雪兽，也曾在湿地与鳄鱼以命相搏。现在他来到了你的面前，准备与你大战一场。来吧！你可闪得过此一击？
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>A veteran trident warrior, decorated and seasoned, has joined the Hwacha Division as its newest unit. He has hunted Snowfurs in the tundra and fought crocodiles in the swamps. Now he stands before you, ready to battle. Let's see — can you dodge this?</color>

zombie_fields.source:
利用獠牙迅速捣毁植物。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>18000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>1800</color>
<color=#3D1400>移速：</color><color=red>慢</color>
<color=#3D1400>特性：</color><color=red>巨型</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>一级僵尸。免疫击退、魅惑</color>
zombie_fields.english:
Uses its tusks to quickly crush plants.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>1800 (Non-bite)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>18000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 1 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Giant zombie. Immune to knockback and hypnotization.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
<color=#3D1400>火山之旅是僵尸旅行社的爆款项目，那些僵尸象们十分钟爱在硫磺气雾中泡澡，或是在飞溅的火花中散步。结果显而易见，黝黑的皮肤明显让他们在黑橄榄部队的选拔中有着更高的成功率。
</color>
zombie_fields.english: <align=left><color=black>Volcano tours are the hottest attraction offered by the Zombie Travel Agency. Zombie elephants absolutely love soaking in sulfurous fumes or strolling through showers of sparks. The result is obvious: their darkened skin gives them a significantly higher success rate when being selected for the Giga Football forces.</color>

zombie_fields.source:
在猛攻时踏平植物，并把僵尸送入防线。

<color=#3D1400>韧性：</color><color=red>36000</color>
<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>3600</color>
